paper.title: Unveiling the Secret of AdaLN-Zero in Diffusion Transformer
paper.abstract: Diffusion transformer (DiT), a rapidly emerging architecture for image generation, has gained much attention. However, despite ongoing efforts to improve its performance, the understanding of DiT remains superficial. In this work, we delve into and investigate a critical conditioning mechanism within DiT, adaLN-Zero, which achieves superior performance compared to adaLN. Our work studies three potential elements driving this performance, including an SE-like structure, zero-initialization, and a

summary.core_problem: 解释 DiT 中 adaLN-Zero 为什么比普通 adaLN 更有效，并把分析转化为更好的初始化和条件注入设计。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型训练机制分析和初始化改进。它不直接研究语言模型，但 zero-init、条件归一化和深层 Transformer 优化稳定性对多模态预训练有可迁移参考。
summary.technical_approach: 作者拆解 adaLN-Zero 的三个候选因素：类似 SE 的结构、零初始化、以及“gradual”更新顺序；分析认为零初始化最关键。基于该结论提出 adaLN-Gaussian 初始化，并受 SE-like 结构启发提出 SE-adaLN-Zero 条件机制。
summary.experiments: 在 Diffusion Transformer 图像生成设置中做系统消融，比较 adaLN、adaLN-Zero、adaLN-Gaussian 和 SE-adaLN-Zero；摘要称新初始化稳定提升优化效率，改进条件机制也带来一致收益。摘要未列出参数规模、数据集和具体 FID/训练步数收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why adaLN-Zero works better than standard adaLN in Diffusion Transformers and turns the analysis into improved initialization and conditioning mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism and optimization study for generative Transformers. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but its findings on zero initialization, conditional normalization, and Transformer training stability can transfer to multimodal pretraining setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors decompose adaLN-Zero into three possible drivers: an SE-like structure, zero initialization, and a gradual update order. They identify zero initialization as the dominant factor, then propose adaLN-Gaussian and an SE-adaLN-Zero conditioning mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: The paper runs ablations in DiT image-generation settings, comparing adaLN, adaLN-Zero, adaLN-Gaussian, and SE-adaLN-Zero. The abstract reports consistent optimization-efficiency gains, but does not include model sizes, datasets, or exact FID/training-step numbers.

recommendation.zh: 只看 zero-init 消融和 adaLN-Gaussian 结果；这类初始化结论可迁移，但别把 DiT 图像设置直接外推到 LLM。
recommendation.en: Read only the zero-init ablation and adaLN-Gaussian results; the initialization lesson transfers, but the DiT setup should not be overgeneralized to LLMs.

paper.title: Post-Grokking Collapse at the Representation-Readout Interface in Muon-Trained Transformers
paper.abstract: Under the standard split, Muon gets hidden matrices and AdamW embeddings/output head. Muon groks modular addition faster, but its solutions do not hold. All nine configurations on $(a+b) \bmod 113$ grok and later lose generalization. Across five seeds the selected AdamW reference falls below threshold on four, reaching 27.59%. Instability persists across two moduli, two widths, two training fractions, subtraction, and depth. The failure arises at the representation-readout interface, identified

summary.core_problem: 使用 Muon 优化器训练 Transformer 时，模型在模加法（modular addition）等可解释的 grokking 任务上能更快达到泛化阈值，但在 grokking 之后会出现测试精度和训练精度同步崩塌的后 grokking 塌陷现象；论文试图定位这种不稳定性的机制来源，特别关注将 hidden 权重交给 Muon、embedding 与输出头交给 AdamW 的分优化器路由是否会在表征与 readout 的接口处破坏对齐。
summary.importance: Muon 正被越来越多地作为大模型训练优化器讨论，这类工作多关注其收敛速度和谱性质。本文指出“更快 grok”不等于“稳定持有解”，并把失效定位在 residual stream 基矢自由度上：hidden 层和 embedding/unembedding 被不同优化器更新时，会沿着损失不敏感的可逆变换方向发生漂移，最终导致表征与读出矩阵之间的接口失配。这个观察对实际大模型训练中“分参数分组优化”“输出头/embedding 独立学习率与 weight decay”“训练后期稳定性”都有直接参考价值，也为理解 grokking 后的长期训练动态提供了可干预的小任务探针。
summary.technical_approach: 以 (a+b) mod 113 等模块化算术任务为实验场，系统比较 Muon 与 AdamW 在不同 modulus、宽度、训练数据比例、运算类型、层数下的训练轨迹。使用模加法任务上已建立的 Fourier 电路分析工具，追踪模型使用的频率分量、有效秩与奇异谱，区分“算法家族没变但基矢漂移”与“电路本身被破坏”两类失效。通过在相同 bit-identical 参数状态处分叉轨迹、扫描输出头学习率和 weight decay，并结合 residual stream 基矢不确定性分析（即 h 与 W_U 只通过乘积 W_U h 被损失约束，存在任意可逆 R 下 (Rh, W_U R^{-1}) 的等价类），把塌陷归因到表征-readout 接口上的基矢失配，而非单纯的泛化机制失效。
summary.experiments: 在 9 组 Muon 配置上，模型全部先 grok，随后全部出现泛化丢失，最差时测试精度跌破 1%，并可在数十万步内反复崩塌与恢复。AdamW 并非免疫：在 sweep 中 7 个 grok 的配置里有 4 个也出现后期塌陷；输出头学习率从 1e-3 提高到 1e-2 时，低于阈值的评估次数从 0 增加到 918。与已有 anti-grokking 不同，本文的塌陷伴随训练精度从 100% 跌至 21.12%、训练损失从 1.53e-7 飙升到 57.5，说明不是只在测试集上失效，而是已学到的函数本身在接口处被破坏。消融显示，Muon 的归一化正交化路径会把非恒定谱上的色散从 326 个有效共轭对压缩到 4 个，但模型计算所处的 Fourier 家族并未改变；塌陷随深度增加而加重，扫 output head 的学习率（5 倍范围）和 weight decay（0 到 0.5）只能改变出现时机和严重程度，无法消除。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看 introduction 中关于 post-grokking collapse 的现象描述、Figure 里训练/测试精度同步崩塌的轨迹、以及对 residual stream 基矢等价类和 split optimizer 路由如何切断 writers/readers 共同固定基矢的分析。对优化器研究者而言，值得深挖的点是：为什么 Muon 在所有配置下都触发，而 AdamW 只在较大学习率下触发；这是否与 Muon 倾向更高有效秩、更各向同性谱有关。不必纠结模加法本身的电路细节，但要抓住“表示层和读出层之间存在损失不约束的自由度，不同更新规则会让它们沿着这个自由度漂移”这个机制。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Transformers trained with Muon, when hidden weights are assigned to Muon while embeddings and the output head are left to AdamW, reach the grokking threshold faster on modular arithmetic, but the grokked solutions are not stable: generalization is consistently lost after grokking, and the paper investigates where this post-grokking collapse originates, with particular attention to the representation–readout interface created by the split-optimizer routing.
summary_en.importance: Muon is increasingly discussed as a promising optimizer for large-scale training, largely on the basis of faster convergence and favorable spectral properties. This paper shows that faster grokking does not imply stable retention of the solution, and localizes the failure to a basis-freedom issue in the residual stream: when hidden layers are updated by one optimizer while embeddings and the unembedding are updated by another, they can drift along invertible directions to which the loss is insensitive, eventually breaking coordination between representations and the readout. This is directly relevant to practical LLM training design, including parameter-grouped optimization, separate learning-rate or weight-decay settings for embeddings/heads, and late-stage training stability, and it offers a small, intervenable testbed for studying post-grokking dynamics more generally.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper uses modular addition and subtraction as a mechanistically understood grokking testbed, sweeping modulus, width, training-data fraction, operation type, and depth for both Muon and AdamW. It applies the established Fourier-circuit analysis for modular arithmetic to track the frequency basis used by the model, effective rank, and singular spectra, distinguishing changes in basis from changes in the underlying algorithmic family. Starting from bit-identical checkpoints, it branches trajectories, sweeps output-head learning rate and weight decay, and uses the residual-stream gauge argument: logits depend on the final representation h and unembedding W_U only through W_U h, so the pair is determined only up to an invertible map (Rh, W_U R^{-1}), and the loss exerts no direct pressure to fix R. The collapse is attributed to a mismatch at this representation–readout interface rather than to a purely generalization-side failure.
summary_en.experiments: Across a nine-point Muon sweep on (a+b) mod 113, every run grokked and every run subsequently lost generalization; in the worst cases test accuracy fell below 1% and then partially recovered, repeatedly, over hundreds of thousands of steps. AdamW was not immune: four of seven AdamW configurations that grokked also lost generalization afterward, and severity increased monotonically with learning rate, from zero sub-threshold evaluations at 1e-3 to 918 at 1e-2. Unlike previously reported anti-grokking, here training accuracy fell alongside test accuracy, dropping from 100% to 21.12% in the same evaluation window while training loss rose from 1.53e-7 to 57.5, indicating that the learned function itself broke rather than merely failing to generalize. Ablating Muon’s normalized-orthogonalization path collapsed dispersion over the non-constant spectrum from 326 effective conjugate pairs to 4 while leaving the Fourier family the model computed through unchanged. Instability increased with depth; sweeping the output-head learning rate over a factor of five and weight decay from zero to 0.5 changed timing and severity but did not eliminate the collapse.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read this as a useful mechanistic case study rather than a production optimizer paper. Focus on the introduction for the core phenomenon, the training curves showing simultaneous train/test collapse, and the basis-freedom argument connecting split-optimizer routing to the writers/readers of the residual stream. For optimizer researchers, the key question is why Muon exhibits the instability across all tested configurations while AdamW only does so at larger learning rates, and how this relates to Muon’s higher effective rank and more isotropic spectra. The modular-arithmetic circuit details are secondary; the mechanism to carry away is that representations and readouts share loss-invisible degrees of freedom, and mismatched update rules can exploit them. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Muon 在 grokking 后负 step-size elasticity 导致 representation 漂移这个发现很关键，做优化器或长程训练稳定性的人应看 §4 的冻结实验和 elasticity 测量。
recommendation.en: The finding that Muon's negative step-size elasticity after grokking drives representation drift is key—optimizer and long-run stability researchers should read the freezing experiments and elasticity measurements in §4.

paper.title: The Tamed Subgradient Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm beyond Convexity
paper.abstract: We study the problem of sampling from target distributions whose potentials are simultaneously non-smooth, subject to superlinear gradient growth, and non-convex. We introduce the Subgradient Tamed Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm (SG-TULA), a discretisation of the Langevin diffusion that operates directly on subgradients, without relying on computationally demanding smoothing procedures. To handle the superlinear regime, taming techniques are employed to produce a stable, explicit scheme. We deriv

summary.core_problem: 解决非凸、非光滑且梯度超线性增长目标下，基于 Langevin 的采样/优化方法难以稳定工作的理论与算法问题，并尝试连接到 GPT-2 风格预训练目标。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是优化理论与采样算法：提出可处理 subgradient 和 superlinear growth 的 SG-TULA，并给出显式非渐近收敛界。对 LLM 预训练的价值在于它把一个更接近实际正则化预训练势函数的目标纳入可分析框架，但离主流大规模训练 recipe 仍有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Subgradient Tamed Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm，在离散 Langevin 更新中直接使用次梯度，并通过 taming 机制抑制超线性梯度导致的不稳定；同时给出 Wasserstein-2 收敛界和 excess risk 界。论文还验证 GPT-2 谱系的正则化预训练势函数满足其假设，并讨论 boosted coordinate-wise 变体。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出标准 LLM 规模实验细节，只说明在 GPT-2 lineage 的 regularized pretraining potential 上验证假设，并称 boosted coordinate-wise SG-TULA 可预训练。若正文没有大规模对照，这更像理论可行性展示，而非可直接迁移到生产训练的 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses stable sampling/optimization for objectives that are simultaneously non-convex, non-smooth, and have superlinear gradient growth, with an eye toward GPT-2-like pretraining potentials.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is in optimization theory and sampling algorithms: SG-TULA handles subgradients and superlinear growth with explicit non-asymptotic guarantees. Its relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect but nontrivial because it analyzes a regime closer to realistic regularized pretraining objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces the Subgradient Tamed Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm, which directly uses subgradients in a Langevin discretization and applies taming to stabilize updates under superlinear gradients. It derives Wasserstein-2 convergence bounds and excess-risk guarantees, and checks the assumptions for a GPT-2-lineage regularized pretraining potential.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report standard large-scale LLM training experiments. It mainly claims assumption verification for GPT-2-like objectives and pretraining with a boosted coordinate-wise SG-TULA variant, so the empirical value likely depends on whether the paper includes convincing optimization comparisons.

recommendation.zh: 偏理论，离主流 AdamW 训练很远；但若你在想非平滑正则、采样式优化或 loss spike 稳定性，先看假设验证那节再决定要不要深读。
recommendation.en: Theory-heavy and far from mainstream AdamW training, but worth checking the assumption-verification section if you care about nonsmooth regularization or sampling-style stabilization.

paper.title: MALT: Lightweight Curvature-Aware Muon via Diagonal Preconditioning
paper.abstract: Muon has recently emerged as a promising alternative to AdamW for language model pretraining by orthogonalizing momentum matrices using Newton-Schulz iterations. Although Muon mitigates gradient anisotropy, it does not explicitly account for the curvature geometry of the loss landscape and may therefore remain sensitive to curvature anisotropy. We bridge this gap by proposing MALT (Muon Augmented by Lightweight Two-sided Preconditioning), which uses lightweight diagonal preconditioners to reduce

summary.core_problem: 现有用于LLM预训练的矩阵优化器Muon仅通过Newton-Schulz迭代正交化动量来缓解梯度各向异性，但未显式建模损失景观的曲率各向异性（即Hessian矩阵条件数过大、不同参数方向的损失曲率差异悬殊的问题），在病态损失景观下收敛速度会显著下降。
summary.importance: 该工作补充了Muon类矩阵优化器的曲率感知设计维度，提出的轻量对角预条件方案几乎不增加显存和训练耗时，为大模型预训练优化器的迭代提供了低开销的改进路径；“预条件正交化+噪声自适应步长”的组合思路，也为后续优化器设计提供了可复用的范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MALT（带轻量双边预条件的Muon）及自适应变体MALTER：1）基于损失的局部二次近似，推导预条件空间下的Muon公式，用正定曲率代理构造变换空间使二次项各向同性，先对预条件后的动量正交化再映射回原参数空间，同时解决曲率与梯度各向异性问题；2）设计轻量双边对角预条件器：维护行/列平方梯度范数的指数移动平均（EMA），分别构造左、右对角预条件矩阵，保留参数的矩阵结构且额外开销极低；3）用范数嫁接（norm grafting）稳定更新尺度；4）MALTER额外在预条件空间中引入基于Adam式范数噪声自适应的标量步长，提升对随机梯度噪声的鲁棒性；同时给出了随机非凸优化场景下的收敛性保证。
summary.experiments: 在GPT-2 Small、Medium、Large三个尺寸的语言模型预训练任务上评估：MALT和MALTER的显存占用、单步训练耗时与Muon基本持平，但性能一致优于Muon；其中MALTER整体表现最优，其相对Muon的性能提升幅度，与Muon相对AdamW的提升幅度相当，验证了预条件正交化与噪声自适应步长是互补的优化机制。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看引言中曲率各向异性对Muon影响的玩具实验分析（图2）、MALT的预条件Muon公式推导部分（第3节）以及GPT-2预训练的对比实验结果（第5节）；收敛性证明可跳过，预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Muon, a matrix optimizer for LLM pretraining, only mitigates gradient anisotropy via Newton-Schulz momentum orthogonalization, but does not explicitly model curvature anisotropy of the loss landscape (i.e., excessively large Hessian condition number with sharp curvature discrepancies across parameter directions), leading to significantly slower convergence under ill-conditioned loss landscapes.
summary_en.importance: It supplements the curvature-aware design dimension for Muon-style matrix optimizers. The proposed lightweight diagonal preconditioning scheme adds negligible memory and training overhead, providing a low-cost improvement path for large model pretraining optimizers. The combined paradigm of "preconditioned orthogonalization + noise-adaptive step size" also offers a reusable design pattern for future optimizer research.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes MALT (Muon Augmented by Lightweight Two-sided preconditioning) and its adaptive variant MALTER: 1) Derives a preconditioned Muon formulation based on local quadratic approximation of the loss, using a positive-definite curvature surrogate to construct a transformed space with isotropic quadratic terms, then orthogonalizes preconditioned momentum and maps the direction back to the original parameter space to address both curvature and gradient anisotropy simultaneously; 2) Designs lightweight two-sided diagonal preconditioners: maintains exponential moving averages (EMA) of row-wise and column-wise squared gradient norms to construct left and right diagonal preconditioning matrices, preserving the matrix structure of parameters with minimal extra overhead; 3) Uses norm grafting to stabilize update scale; 4) MALTER further introduces a scalar step size adapted via Adam-style norm-based noise adjustment in the preconditioned space to improve robustness to stochastic gradient noise. Convergence guarantees for stochastic non-convex optimization are also provided.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on pretraining of GPT-2 Small, Medium and Large models: MALT and MALTER have nearly identical memory footprint and per-step wall-clock time as Muon, but consistently outperform Muon. MALTER achieves the best overall performance, with a performance gain over Muon comparable to the gain of Muon over AdamW, verifying that preconditioned orthogonalization and noise-adaptive step size are complementary mechanisms.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the toy experiment analysis of curvature anisotropy's impact on Muon in Introduction (Figure 2), the derivation of preconditioned Muon formulation in Section 3, and the GPT-2 pretraining comparison results in Section 5. Convergence proofs can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看优化器推导和 LM ablation 表；若实验规模够，这应进入内部 AdamW/Muon 对照复现。
recommendation.en: Read the optimizer derivation and LM ablations; if the scale is credible, this belongs in an internal AdamW/Muon comparison.

paper.title: On MUON optimization: From non-convergence to an error analysis with Polar Express and the Newton-Schulz polynomial from implementations
paper.abstract: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) optimization methods are the standard instruments for the training of deep neural networks (DNNs). In many relevant artificial intelligence (AI) systems - such as popular large language models (LLMs)-not the standard SGD scheme is used as the optimization method but instead suitable accelerated variants of SGD are employed. One of the most popular methods of such accelerated SGD variants is the momentum orthogonalized by Newton-Schulz (MUON) optimizer proposed b

summary.core_problem: 分析 MUON 优化器中 Newton-Schulz 正交化步骤的收敛与误差问题，解释其原始实现为何可能不收敛以及如何推广。
summary.importance: 这属于预训练优化器分析。对真正训练大模型的人，价值不在直接拿来用，而在理解 MUON 这类矩阵结构优化器的数值稳定边界和实现依赖。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出一个广义 MUON 变体，允许任意数量的广义 Newton-Schulz 步和更高阶多项式；分析原始 MUON、Polar Express 以及实现中使用的 Newton-Schulz 多项式，给出非收敛现象与误差分析，讨论不同多项式和迭代步数对正交化近似的影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要更偏理论与数值分析，没有给出 LLM 规模训练结果。核心证据应是收敛性、误差界和不同 NS 多项式/步数下的行为比较，而不是下游 benchmark 提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes convergence and error behavior in the Newton-Schulz orthogonalization used by MUON, explaining why the original implementation may fail to converge and how to generalize it.
summary_en.importance: This is an optimizer-analysis paper relevant to pretraining. Its value is less about immediate adoption and more about understanding the numerical stability boundary of matrix-structured optimizers like MUON.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces a generalized MUON variant with an arbitrary number of generalized Newton-Schulz steps and potentially higher-degree polynomials. The analysis covers original MUON, Polar Express, and the Newton-Schulz polynomial used in implementations, deriving non-convergence phenomena and error behavior under different polynomial/iteration choices.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract is theory- and numerics-heavy and does not report large-scale LLM training. The main evidence is likely convergence analysis, error bounds, and comparisons across Newton-Schulz variants rather than downstream benchmark gains.

recommendation.zh: 如果你团队在试 MUON，这篇该看；不是 recipe 论文，但能提醒你实现里的 NS 多项式和步数并非无害超参。
recommendation.en: Read this if your team is actually trying MUON; it is not a recipe paper, but it usefully warns that the Newton-Schulz polynomial and step count in implementation are not harmless knobs.

paper.title: One QK Channel, Many Sources: Guarding Low-Precision Attention Collapse
paper.abstract: A bfloat16 transformer can train normally for many steps and then collapse abruptly. Distinct low-precision errors can trigger the same failure, leaving unclear whether each source needs its own repair or one shared route can be blocked. We isolate a reproduced GPT-2-class collapse to the streaming-softmax accumulator, where fp32 accumulation repairs it, and use the fault as an assay for moving controlled errors across sources. Errors placed outside attention still drive the same query-key (QK)

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 bf16 Transformer 训练中一种棘手的失稳：训练可以长期看起来正常，但随后突然 collapse。核心问题不是“某个低精度算子是否有错”，而是不同低精度误差是否会通过同一条失败通道放大。作者用 GPT-2 small + OpenWebText 复现了 collapse，并把故障定位到 FlashAttention-2 风格 tiled online softmax recurrence 中的 streaming-softmax accumulator。更重要的是，论文进一步证明：即使误差源从 attention 内部移到 attention 外部，最终仍会进入同一个 QK spectral runaway 通道；只修 QK 路径就能阻断 collapse，而不需要逐个修复所有误差源。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于把低精度训练稳定性问题从“局部数值误差排查”推进到“失败通道识别”。对预训练研究很直接：大规模训练中常见的 loss spike、attention saturation、late-stage collapse，往往不能只靠定位某个 kernel 或某个 dtype 来解释。论文给出一个有操作性的判断：对于具有时间符号一致性的低精度误差，危险不在误差源本身，而在它们是否能沿 residual-block parameter updates 或上游路径进入 QK 子空间，并推动 attention logits 饱和。这意味着防护策略可以放在 QK locus，而不是在所有潜在低精度源头上使用 fp32。贡献量级不是新的训练 recipe，而是一个较清楚的 failure mechanism 和一个可触发的 containment controller，对低精度预训练、FlashAttention 类 kernel 验证、QK norm 使用时机都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分三步。第一步是 isolate：作者在 PyTorch 中重实现 FlashAttention-2 的 tiled online-softmax recurrence，使 running output O 和 softmax statistics carry 暴露出来，可以逐项改精度。对比 vendor kernel、full-matrix attention、bf16 operands、tiling 等因素后，作者把复现出的 GPT-2-class collapse 定位到 bf16 streaming accumulator artifact。fp32 accumulation 能修复这一特定 accumulator fault，说明 collapse 不是简单来自 bf16 输入、FlashAttention 结构或单一训练尺度。

第二步是 identify：作者设计了 controlled fault-source moves 和 always-on module-routed gradient correction。关键点是 source mechanism 仍然开启，只改变哪条模块路径收到 clean fp32 gradient。这样测的是“阻断通道”，不是“修复源头”。结果显示，来自 attention 内部和 attention 外部的误差都会汇聚到同一个 dominant QK channel；纠正 QK route 可以稳定训练，纠正 MLP route 不行。这给出了 source-channel dissociation：fault source is not failure channel。

第三步是 explain and contain：作者分析进入 QK channel 的条件，指出 temporal sign-coherence 是关键，即每个 head 的 error sign 在 optimizer steps 间持续一致。它不同于 per-tile scalar mean 或误差总能量。论文还用 equal-energy off-target control 和移除每个 run 自身 dominant QK weight directions 的实验，说明 QK channel 是早期 runaway 的驱动因素，不只是 collapse 的观测指标。最后提出 QK-Guard：平时不改变模型；在线监控 attention-logit saturation；当检测到 runaway 正在发展时，在 QK locus 启用 parameter-free per-head QK normalization。它不回滚训练，也不修复原始 fault，而是阻断下游通道。对照实验显示，同一触发时刻做 softmax-local action 或 learning-rate cut 不能救回训练，说明 action locus 比“是否响应及时”更关键。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕 GPT-2 small 在 OpenWebText 上的 bf16 训练 collapse 展开。作者报告 baseline 在观察窗口内各 seed 都 collapse，而 fp32 accumulation 相关条件没有观察到 collapse：包括 accumulator → fp32 的两个 seed、fp32/fp32 carry 的两个 seed，以及一个手动停止时仍健康的长 run，记录到 103400 logged steps。这里作者没有把它当 collapse-rate 估计，而是作为 sufficiency counterexample：在原 baseline 必崩的窗口内，单因素 fp32 accumulation 可以阻断该 fault。

定位实验区分了 streaming carry 的两类路径。running output O 在 backward 中通过 D-term 影响 score gradient，进而影响 dQ 和 dK，但不直接影响 dV；statistics carry 通过 saved log normalizer 重标定 recomputed probabilities P，会影响 dQ、dK 和 dV。论文借此解释为什么某些 carry precision 会表现为 QK 相关错误，而不是平均地污染所有 attention 参数。

识别实验把 fault 移动到 attention 外部，仍观察到同样的 QK spectral runaway；然后用 module-routed clean gradient 做通道阻断。结果是 QK route correction 能稳定训练，MLP route correction 不能。这是最关键的因果证据。

机制实验操纵 error-sign sequences，分离 temporal sign-coherence、per-tile scalar mean 和 aggregate magnitude。只有具有跨 step 符号持续性的误差更容易进入 QK channel。作者也指出它不能直接作为在线触发信号，因为正常 feature learning 也会有时间一致性。QK-Guard 因此选择监控 attention-logit saturation。触发后，per-head QK normalization 能 contain runaway；同一时刻的 softmax-local 处理和 learning-rate cut 失败，支持“必须在 QK locus 动作”的结论。
summary.reading_guide:
建议精读 Introduction 的 contribution framing，因为它把 source、channel、trigger、action locus 四个概念分得很清楚。§2 是最值得看的实验设计部分，尤其是 Table 1 附近关于 FlashAttention-2 online-softmax recurrence、running output O、softmax statistics carry、fp32 accumulation 对照的内容。这部分决定了论文的可信度。

§3 需要重点看 module-routed gradient correction 的 assay。判断这篇论文是否站得住，主要看它是否真的在 source mechanism 保持开启时只阻断某条 route。如果这个实验成立，结论就比“某个 kernel 用 fp32 就好”强很多。

§4 建议看 temporal sign-coherence 的操纵实验，以及 equal-energy off-target control 和 dominant QK weight directions removal。这里回答两个问题：什么样的误差会进 QK channel；QK runaway 是因还是果。

§5 看 QK-Guard 的 sensing/action 分离。重点不是 QK norm 本身，而是触发条件为什么选 attention-logit saturation，以及为什么 softmax-local action 和 learning-rate cut 失败。对做大规模低精度训练的人，最可复用的是这种在线诊断与局部 containment 的设计方式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a late-collapse failure mode in bf16 Transformer training: a run can look healthy for many optimization steps and then fail abruptly. The key question is whether each low-precision fault must be fixed at its own source, or whether heterogeneous faults enter a shared failure channel. Using a GPT-2 small collapse on OpenWebText, the authors localize one reproducible fault to the streaming-softmax accumulator in a FlashAttention-2-style tiled online softmax recurrence. They then use this fault as an assay and show that errors originating both inside and outside attention converge to the same QK spectral runaway. Correcting the QK route blocks the collapse while leaving the fault active.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a clean separation between numerical fault sources and the channel that turns them into training failure. This is directly relevant to low-precision pretraining: loss spikes and sudden collapses are often debugged as local kernel or dtype bugs, but this paper shows that the dangerous part can be a shared QK route rather than the original error site. The practical implication is also clear. For temporally sign-coherent low-precision errors that perturb residual-block parameter updates, acting at the QK locus may be sufficient, whereas making every possible source fp32 is neither targeted nor scalable. The work gives a useful mechanism for interpreting attention saturation, QK normalization, and precision choices in large-scale training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper follows an isolate-identify-explain-contain structure. First, the authors reproduce a GPT-2-class collapse in a PyTorch implementation of FlashAttention-2's tiled online-softmax recurrence. This implementation exposes the running output O and the softmax statistics carry, which allows controlled precision edits. The decisive intervention is fp32 accumulation in the streaming accumulator: it prevents the reproduced collapse while preserving the tiled computation. This rules out several simpler explanations, including bf16 operands, tiling itself, the FlashAttention family as a whole, or a single-scale artifact.

Second, the authors introduce an identification assay based on controlled fault-source moves and always-on module-routed gradient correction. The source mechanism remains enabled, while clean fp32 gradients are routed through selected modules. This tests channel blocking rather than source repair. The result is the central source-channel dissociation: faults placed inside attention and faults placed outside attention both drive the same dominant QK channel; QK-route correction stabilizes training, while MLP-route correction does not.

Third, the paper explains how errors enter the QK channel. The distinguishing property is temporal sign-coherence: the error sign for a head persists across optimizer steps. This is separated from per-tile scalar mean and total error magnitude. The authors also test causality with equal-energy off-target controls and by removing each run's own dominant QK weight directions, showing that the QK channel drives the early runaway rather than merely tracking it.

Finally, the paper proposes QK-Guard, a dormant containment controller. It monitors attention-logit saturation and, once a runaway is developing, applies parameter-free per-head QK normalization at the QK locus. It does not repair the underlying fault or rewind the run. At the same trigger point, a softmax-local intervention and a learning-rate cut fail, indicating that the rescue depends on where the action is applied.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical base is a bf16 GPT-2 small training setup on OpenWebText. The baseline collapses in every seed within the observed window. In contrast, fp32-accumulation variants do not collapse in the reported runs: two seeds for the accumulator-to-fp32 arm, two seeds for the fp32/fp32 carry condition, and one long run that was manually stopped while still healthy at 103400 logged steps. The paper treats these as sufficiency counterexamples, not as collapse-rate estimates.

The accumulator analysis separates the backward paths of the streaming carries. The running output O re-enters backward through the D-term, perturbing the score gradient and therefore dQ and dK, but not dV. The statistics carry affects recomputed probabilities through the saved log normalizer and can affect dQ, dK, and dV. This explains why a carry-precision fault can show up as a QK-driven instability rather than as uniform attention-parameter noise.

The channel-identification experiments move the fault outside attention and still observe the same QK spectral runaway. With module-routed clean gradients, QK correction blocks the collapse while MLP correction does not. The mechanism experiments manipulate error-sign sequences and show that temporal sign-coherence, rather than scalar mean or aggregate energy, predicts entry into the QK channel. QK-Guard then uses attention-logit saturation as the online signal, because temporal coherence alone is not specific to failure; normal feature learning can also be temporally coherent.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read the introduction carefully for the distinction between fault source, failure channel, trigger signal, and action locus. Section 2 is the most important part for assessing the numerical claim: focus on the FlashAttention-2 online-softmax recurrence, the exposed carries, the fp32 accumulation contrasts, and Table 1. The credibility of the paper depends on whether the reproduced collapse is truly localized to the streaming accumulator without changing other factors.

Section 3 is the key mechanism section. The module-routed gradient correction assay is the central experiment: the fault remains active, but only one route receives a clean gradient. This is what makes the QK-channel conclusion stronger than a standard kernel fix.

Section 4 is worth reading for the temporal sign-coherence manipulations and the causal controls around dominant QK directions. These experiments explain why some low-precision errors become dangerous and why QK spectral growth should be treated as a driver, not only as a symptom.

Section 5 is useful for practitioners. The important design choice is the separation of sensing from action: monitor attention-logit saturation, then apply per-head QK normalization only when needed. The failed softmax-local and learning-rate-cut controls are particularly informative.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现实验里的 QK 谱监控；它改变调试习惯：别只追 fault source，先保护 failure channel。
recommendation.en: Replicate the QK spectral monitors; the useful shift is to protect the failure channel, not only chase the numerical fault source.

paper.title: CMuon: Accelerating and Stabilizing Diffusion Transformer Training via Chunked Momentum Orthogonalization
paper.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in visual generative modeling, yet their training remains computationally prohibitive. While the recently proposed Momentum Orthogonalization (Muon) optimizer offers a promising alternative to AdamW, its direct application to DiTs yields suboptimal late-stage convergence. In this paper, we identify the root cause of this bottleneck: standard DiT architectures fuse functionally distinct weights (e.g., within AdaLN and

summary.core_problem: 普通Muon优化器直接应用于Diffusion Transformer（DiT）时会出现后期收敛失效、最终生成质量无法稳定优于AdamW的问题，根因是DiT中为算力效率拼接的功能异构权重会被普通Muon的整体正交化操作引入子空间耦合，扭曲参数更新方向。
summary.importance: 指出了基于线性最小化预言机（Linear Minimization Oracle，LMO）的优化器（如Muon系列）与大模型训练中常见的权重融合工程优化之间的兼容性问题——这类问题此前在LLM场景未被充分暴露，因为LLM融合层的梯度统计差异通常小于DiT。提出的CMuon仅需在优化器中做少量代码修改，无明显额外计算开销，为DiT及其他生成式基座预训练的优化器选型与适配提供了可落地的工程参考，也提示优化器设计需要结合架构的参数组织方式调整，而非仅关注算法本身的收敛性质。
summary.technical_approach: 提出分块Muon（CMuon）：在执行牛顿-舒尔茨（Newton-Schulz）动量正交化步骤前，将DiT中为算力效率拼接的融合张量（如QKV融合投影、AdaLN融合投影）按原始功能子模块拆分，对每个子块的动量矩阵独立做正交化，从根源上避免功能不相交子空间的干扰。同时针对矩阵缩放因子、保留AdamW的层选择（如嵌入层、最终投影层）、学习率缩放策略三类关键超参做了系统消融，给出最优配置建议。
summary.experiments: 在675M参数DiT模型上验证，采用VA-VAE潜空间，训练集为ImageNet 256×256，批量大小1024，训练200轮。CMuon相对AdamW实现全程2倍训练加速，且无普通Muon的后期收敛平台问题，最终FID为1.18，全程未使用表示对齐（Representation Alignment，REPA）这类辅助训练加速技术。消融实验验证了在多种超参配置下，CMuon均稳定优于普通Muon，收敛速度与最终生成质量均有提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看引言中对普通Muon在DiT上后期收敛失效的根因分析，再看方法部分对子空间干扰的形式化说明与Algorithm 1的CMuon伪代码，最后看实验中的超参消融结论与最优配置建议。预计阅读时间30~45分钟，Flow Matching的基础公式部分可跳过，核心贡献在优化器与架构的适配逻辑。

summary_en.core_problem: Naive application of the Muon optimizer to Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) leads to suboptimal late-stage convergence and no stable quality gains over AdamW, with the root cause being that standard DiT implementations concatenate functionally distinct weights from AdaLN, QKV, and FFN layers into unified tensors for computational efficiency, and vanilla Muon performs collective momentum orthogonalization on the full fused matrix, inducing unintended coupling between functionally disjoint subspaces that distorts parameter update directions.
summary_en.importance: The work identifies a critical compatibility issue between Linear Minimization Oracle (LMO)-based optimizers (Muon family) and common engineering optimizations (weight fusion) in generative model training, a problem not fully exposed in LLM scenarios where gradient statistics across fused layers are typically more homogeneous. The proposed CMuon requires minimal code changes and negligible computational overhead, providing practical engineering guidance for adapting Muon-style optimizers to DiT and other generative foundation model pre-training pipelines, and highlights that optimizer design needs to account for architectural parameter organization rather than only algorithmic convergence properties.
summary_en.technical_approach: Chunked Muon (CMuon) splits fused weight tensors (e.g., fused QKV projections, fused AdaLN projections) back into their original functional sub-components before performing Newton-Schulz orthogonalization on each chunk's momentum independently, eliminating cross-subspace interference at its source. The work also conducts systematic ablation on three key hyperparameter categories: matrix scaling factors, layer selection for retaining AdamW (e.g., embeddings, final projection layers), and learning rate scaling strategies, with optimal configuration recommendations provided.
summary_en.experiments: Validation is conducted on a 675M-parameter DiT with VA-VAE latent space, trained on ImageNet 256×256 at batch size 1024 for 200 epochs. CMuon delivers consistent 2× training speedup over AdamW throughout the entire training process with no late-stage plateau observed in vanilla Muon, reaching a final FID of 1.18 without auxiliary acceleration techniques such as Representation Alignment (REPA). Ablations confirm consistent improvements over vanilla Muon across various hyperparameter configurations, with gains in both convergence speed and final generation quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the root cause analysis of vanilla Muon's late-stage convergence failure on DiTs in the introduction first, then review the formalization of subspace interference and Algorithm 1 (CMuon pseudocode) in the methodology section, and focus on hyperparameter ablation conclusions and optimal configuration suggestions in experiments. Estimated reading time: 30–45 minutes. Basic Flow Matching formulations can be skipped, as the core contribution lies in the optimizer-architecture adaptation logic.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 fused tensor 诊断；若内部在试 Muon，立刻复现 QKV/AdaLN 分块正交化 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the fused-tensor diagnosis; if Muon is in your optimizer sweep, reproduce the QKV/AdaLN chunking ablation immediately.

paper.title: Automated Numerical Stability Analysis of Deep Learning Operators
paper.abstract: Finite-precision arithmetic unavoidably introduces numerical approximation errors. Numerical computations may use insufficient precision or an improper formulation, which leads to numerical instability. In this paper, we introduce the first unified software tool that integrates CESTAC for detecting the numerical stability of deep learning operators. Our developed software not only enables numerical validation with a single computation pass but also detects the sources of numerical instability an

summary.core_problem: 低精度/混合精度训练场景下，深度学习算子的数值不稳定来源难以自动定位。现有基于随机算术的验证工具（如CESTAC/CADNA）不支持Python张量运算、加速硬件和自动微分计算图，大模型训练中出现的loss spike、精度损失等数值问题往往依赖人工排查，效率较低。
summary.importance: 该工具对大模型预训练的数值稳定性排查有实际工程价值，提供了可嵌入PyTorch等自动微分框架的一键式数值稳定性检测能力，不需要多次重复执行就能定位发生舍入误差放大、灾难性抵消等问题的具体算子，能够降低混合精度训练、FP8训练中排查数值问题的人力成本。
summary.technical_approach: 开发了noisefloat框架，将经典的CESTAC随机算术验证方法与深度学习自动微分框架做原生集成：通过算子重载、张量算子包装实现算术级别的插桩，在单次计算过程中通过定向舍入的同步随机执行估计每个浮点结果的数值可靠性，自动记录出现显著数值误差的算子位置，支持训练和推理过程中的实时稳定性监控，对原有模型代码的修改量小，兼容GPU等加速设备上的张量操作。
summary.experiments: 在多类深度学习任务的算子上人工注入典型数值不稳定问题（如灾难性抵消、不稳定归一化），验证了工具能够准确识别被污染的算子、定位不稳定来源；相比传统需要多次重复执行的随机算术方法，检测过程的运行时间和内存开销大幅降低。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点了解工具的集成方式、支持的算子范围，以及在深度学习训练场景下的额外开销数据，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。如果正在做混合精度/FP8训练的稳定性优化，可以进一步关注其不稳定定位的粒度是否满足生产环境的排查需求。

summary_en.core_problem: Numerical instability in deep learning operators under low/mixed-precision training is difficult to localize automatically. Existing stochastic arithmetic validation tools (e.g., CESTAC/CADNA) do not support Python tensor operations, accelerator hardware, or automatic differentiation graphs, leaving numerical issues like loss spikes and accuracy degradation during large model training to slow manual debugging.
summary_en.importance: This tool has practical engineering value for numerical stability troubleshooting in LLM pretraining. It provides a one-click numerical stability detection capability that integrates natively with autodiff frameworks like PyTorch, capable of localizing operators affected by rounding error amplification, catastrophic cancellation, and other issues without repeated execution runs, reducing engineering overhead for debugging mixed-precision and FP8 training pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors develop noisefloat, a framework that natively integrates the classic CESTAC stochastic arithmetic validation method with deep learning autodiff systems. It implements arithmetic-level instrumentation via operator overloading and wrapped tensor operators, estimating numerical reliability of each floating-point result through synchronous stochastic execution with directed rounding in a single computation pass. It automatically logs operators with significant numerical error, supports real-time stability monitoring during training and inference, requires minimal modification to existing model code, and is compatible with tensor operations on GPU and other accelerators.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on deep learning operators across multiple tasks with artificially injected typical numerical instabilities (e.g., catastrophic cancellation, unstable normalization), the tool correctly identifies corrupted operators and localizes instability sources. It incurs substantially lower runtime and memory overhead compared to traditional stochastic arithmetic methods that require repeated computation runs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for practical utility. Focus on the integration workflow, supported operator coverage, and reported runtime overhead in deep learning training scenarios; estimated reading time 15-20 minutes. Readers actively working on mixed-precision/FP8 training stability can pay closer attention to the granularity of instability localization to evaluate suitability for production debugging workflows.

recommendation.zh: 做训练稳定性和底层算子优化的同学可关注，工具可直接排查loss spike的数值根因，看工具设计部分即可
recommendation.en: Relevant for training stability and low-level operator optimization researchers, the tool can directly debug numerical root causes of loss spikes, focus on tool design section.

paper.title: Towards Robust Reinforcement Learning for Small-Scale Language Model Agents
paper.abstract: The alignment of Small Language Models (SLMs) in the 70--500M parameter range using reinforcement learning is often considered unstable, though the underlying failure mechanisms have not been systematically investigated. In the State-of-the-Art (SOTA) research, fifteen (model, corpus) configurations were trained using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). The experiments included Pythia-70M, 160M, 410M and SmolLM2-135M, 360M on the TinyStories, CNN/DailyMail, and Wikitext-103 corpora. Three reprod

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 70M–500M 小语言模型用 PPO 做 RLHF 时为什么容易不稳定，并试图把问题从“模型太小不适合 PPO”拆成可复现的工程故障和容量条件。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有参考价值。小模型 PPO 失败常被简单归因于容量不足，作者指出至少有三类失败来自训练栈细节：LoRA 参数没有实际训练、bfloat16 下 importance ratio 溢出、reward model 误差驱动 policy collapse。这个结论对做小模型持续预训练、SFT 后 RL、边缘端 agent 对齐有实际意义：当模型规模较小时，训练信号弱、策略容量有限，数值精度和 reward 分布会比大模型更容易决定训练是否可用。论文提出的 PPL_SFT < 20 作为 PPO 可行性的经验门槛，也可以看作判断 SFT prior 是否足够流畅的一条工程规则。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是一个标准但完整的三阶段 RLHF 流程：先做 supervised fine-tuning，再训练 Bradley–Terry reward model，最后用带 KL penalty 的 PPO 更新策略。实验覆盖五个小模型：Pythia-70M、160M、410M，以及 SmolLM2-135M、360M；数据集包括 TinyStories、CNN/DailyMail、Wikitext-103，组成 15 个 model-corpus 配置。作者把任务简化为 single-turn MDP：动作是词表 token，轨迹直到 EOS 结束，reward 在终止状态给出；多轮 agent 框架作为兼容扩展释放，但实证主要在单轮设置。稳定性措施包括三部分。第一，对 PEFT/TRL 管线中 LoRA 参数可能静默冻结的问题，使用 merge-and-reinitialize 方式确保 LoRA 权重进入可训练状态。第二，对小模型中 bfloat16 导致的 PPO importance ratio 溢出，训练阶段改用 float32。第三，对 reward model 误差和未约束 reward 导致的 collapse，加入 reward whitening、KL 约束相关保护和权重回滚。论文把这些称为多层 safety framework，但核心是让 PPO 的数值范围、reward 尺度和策略更新幅度保持在可控区间。
summary.experiments: 实验设计上，作者固定超参，在 15 个配置上运行 SFT → reward model → PPO，以区分单个配置异常和稳定出现的失败模式。报告的三个主要失败模式分别是：PEFT/TRL 中 LoRA 参数被注册为 non-trainable，导致表面训练但策略没有有效更新；bfloat16 在小于 200M 参数模型上更容易出现 probability ratio overflow；reward 值不受控并叠加不合适的 KL penalty 时，策略会生成退化或不连贯输出。修复后，部分配置达到接近公开 instruction-tuned baseline 的水平，包括 SmolLM2-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-Instruct，同时使用更少训练数据。作者提出 capacity-headroom hypothesis：PPO 是否有效不只由参数量决定，而取决于 SFT 后模型是否足够流畅、reward model 是否有区分度；经验规则是 PPL_SFT < 20 的配置更适合继续 PPO。提供内容没有给出完整指标表和每个配置的数值提升，因此具体性能幅度需要查实验表。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 15–25 分钟。优先看 Methodology 中 PPO 实现细节、LoRA merge-and-reinitialize、precision 设置、reward whitening 和 rollback 逻辑；这些比模型最终分数更有可迁移性。然后看 Results 中 15 个配置的 PPL、reward accuracy、KL、reward 曲线和 collapse 案例，确认 PPL_SFT < 20 这条规则是否稳定。对预训练研究者而言，不必细读 agent 叙述，重点是小模型 RL 训练的数值故障、reward 尺度控制，以及 SFT prior 质量如何影响后续 RL。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why PPO-based RLHF is unstable for 70M–500M language models, and separates the issue into reproducible implementation failures, numerical failures, and capacity-related conditions rather than treating it simply as a consequence of small parameter count.
summary_en.importance: The direct impact on base-model pretraining is limited, but the work is useful for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. It shows that PPO failures in small models can come from mundane but consequential issues: LoRA parameters not being trainable, bfloat16 overflow in PPO importance ratios, and policy collapse caused by reward-model errors. This matters for small-model continual training, SFT followed by RL, and on-device agents. At this scale, the training signal is weak and policy capacity is limited, so precision, reward normalization, and KL control can dominate whether RL is usable. The proposed empirical rule, PPL_SFT < 20, is also a practical proxy for whether the SFT prior is fluent enough before PPO.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system uses a standard three-stage RLHF pipeline: supervised fine-tuning, Bradley–Terry reward modeling, and PPO with a KL penalty. The experiments cover five base models, Pythia-70M, Pythia-160M, Pythia-410M, SmolLM2-135M, and SmolLM2-360M, on TinyStories, CNN/DailyMail, and Wikitext-103, giving 15 model-corpus configurations. The empirical setup is a single-turn MDP: actions are vocabulary tokens, generation ends at EOS, and reward is given at the terminal state. A multi-turn agent framework is mentioned as a released extension, but the reported evaluation is mainly single-turn. The stabilization stack has three main pieces. First, a merge-and-reinitialize procedure is used to avoid silent LoRA freezing in PEFT/TRL pipelines. Second, PPO training uses float32 to avoid bfloat16 overflow in probability ratios, especially below 200M parameters. Third, reward whitening, KL-related safeguards, and weight rollback are used to prevent reward-driven policy collapse. The practical contribution is less about a new RL algorithm and more about making the PPO control loop numerically and statistically well-conditioned for very small policies.
summary_en.experiments: The authors run the full SFT → reward model → PPO cycle across 15 configurations with shared hyperparameters, which helps distinguish one-off failures from recurring failure modes. Three recurring problems are reported: LoRA adapters can be silently registered as non-trainable in common PEFT/TRL setups; bfloat16 can produce probability-ratio overflow in models below roughly 200M parameters; and unbounded reward values combined with poorly controlled KL penalties can push the policy into incoherent generations. After applying the stabilization mechanisms, some configurations reportedly reach performance comparable to public instruction-tuned baselines such as SmolLM2-Instruct and Qwen2.5-Instruct while using less training data. The capacity-headroom hypothesis is the main empirical claim: PPO effectiveness depends on both a fluent SFT prior and a discriminative reward model, not just parameter count. The paper gives PPL_SFT < 20 as a practical decision rule. The supplied text does not include the complete result tables, so exact gains per model and dataset should be verified in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Focus first on the methodology details: PPO implementation, LoRA merge-and-reinitialize, precision choice, reward whitening, and rollback. These are more transferable than the final benchmark numbers. Then inspect the result tables and curves for the 15 configurations, especially SFT perplexity, reward-model accuracy, KL, reward trajectories, and examples of collapse. For pretraining researchers, the useful parts are the numerical failure analysis, reward-scale control, and the evidence that SFT prior quality strongly shapes downstream RL stability. The agent framing can be read lightly unless multi-turn extensions are directly relevant.

recommendation.zh: 三个PPO失败模式都是工程中容易踩的坑，尤其是LoRA静默冻结和bf16溢出，做RLHF的团队可以直接对照排查，重点看§3失败模式分析。
recommendation.en: All three PPO failure modes are common pitfalls in engineering, especially silent LoRA freezing and bf16 overflow; RLHF teams can directly use them for troubleshooting — focus on §3 failure mode analysis.

paper.title: ACRL: Adaptive Control of Training-Inference Discrepancy for Stable Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) training for Large Language Models (LLMs) often suffers from instability due to the discrepancy between training and inference. This training-inference discrepancy stems from two primary factors: an architectural separation between training and inference engines, and the use of low-precision quantization in inference versus higher-precision computation in training. To address training instability issues caused by high training-inference discrepancy, we present the pri

summary.core_problem: 解决LLM的RL训练中，训练侧与推理侧的引擎差异、精度差异导致的训练不稳定问题。
summary.importance: 针对RL训练中使用低精度推理加速rollout的核心工程痛点，提出自适应控制训练-推理差异的方法，可在保证稳定的同时降低RL训练成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出自适应控制强化学习（ACRL）框架，实时监测训练与推理的输出差异，将其自适应维持在合理区间，而非完全消除，同时利用可控差异提升策略熵、增强探索。
summary.experiments: （摘要截断，现有结果显示）当推理引擎使用FP8量化时，ACRL可稳定维持训练-推理差异在合理范围，保证RL训练稳定，同时提升策略探索效率与最终准确率。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses training instability in LLM reinforcement learning caused by discrepancies between training and inference engines, as well as numerical precision differences.
summary_en.importance: Targets the core engineering pain point of using low-precision inference to accelerate rollouts in RL training, proposing an adaptive method to control train-inference discrepancy, reducing RL training costs while maintaining stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Adaptive Control Reinforcement Learning (ACRL) framework, which monitors train-inference output discrepancies in real time and adaptively maintains them within a reasonable range (instead of fully eliminating them), while using controlled discrepancy to increase policy entropy and enhance exploration.
summary_en.experiments: (Abstract truncated; available results show) When the inference engine uses FP8 quantization, ACRL consistently maintains train-inference discrepancy within a reasonable range, ensuring stable RL training while improving policy exploration efficiency and final accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 解决RL用FP8推理做rollout的不稳定痛点，工程上可直接参考，仅需读方法部分。
recommendation.en: Solves instability when using FP8-quantized inference for RL rollouts; directly applicable in engineering, read only the method section.

paper.title: Deconstructing Off-Policy Ratios: Entropy-Scaled Trust Regions for Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) accelerates large language model (LLM) post-training by overlapping rollout generation with policy optimization, but the resulting stale, off-policy data can destabilize optimization and ultimately cause policy collapse. Existing methods typically retain or discard tokens based solely on the magnitude of their importance ratios, applying the same threshold uniformly across token positions. In this work, we reveal that the natural scale of the importance r

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是异步 RL 在大模型后训练里的稳定性问题。异步训练通过并行 rollout 生成和策略更新显著提高吞吐，但也带来 stale/off-policy 数据：用于更新的轨迹并不是由当前策略完整生成的，长轨迹里甚至可能跨越多个权重版本。现有方法通常按 importance ratio 的绝对大小统一裁剪或屏蔽 token，默认“大 ratio 就不可信”。作者指出这个前提在异步 agentic RL 里并不成立，因为 ratio 的自然尺度随 token entropy 系统变化。低熵位置的大 ratio 往往只是近零概率放大的采样噪声，高熵位置的大 ratio 反而可能是异步更新带来的真实探索信号。核心问题因此变成：如何在不重建精确行为策略的情况下，区分应当抑制的 off-policy 噪声和应当保留的有效探索。
summary.importance: 这篇论文的价值不只在一个更稳的异步 RL 技巧，而在于它把 off-policy ratio 的解释从“统一阈值的几何裁剪”推进到“与熵耦合的状态依赖信任域”。这对大模型 RL 很关键，因为长 CoT、多轮 agent rollout、异步 pipeline 都在把训练推向更强的 off-policy 区域。若这个问题处理不好，吞吐提升会被训练崩溃抵消。对 pretrain 研究者而言，启发在两层。第一，它揭示了 token-level 训练信号的尺度不是常数，而与分布熵相关，这和预训练里 loss spike、难度分布、confidence calibration 的分析是相通的。第二，它说明异步系统设计不能只看系统吞吐，必须把优化目标里的统计失真一并建模。贡献量级上，这属于“机制解释 + 方法落地”都比较完整的一类工作：既解释了为什么现有 ratio clipping/masking 会错杀或误放，又给出一个不依赖行为策略重建的替代方案，并在强基线上拿到接近同步训练的效果。
summary.technical_approach: 技术主线有三步。第一步，作者建立 entropy-ratio relation。通过实证和附录推导，他们说明 token 的 log-importance-ratio 或 ratio 偏移量的自然尺度会随 token entropy 增长。直观上，若一个 token 处于低熵、模型极其自信的区域，行为策略和目标策略之间哪怕只有很小的 train-inference gap，也会因为某些近零概率项而被放大成很大的 ratio；这种大值并不一定对应真实策略漂移，而更像数值上被放大的采样噪声。相反，在高熵区域，策略本来就不确定，较大的 ratio 更可能落在合理波动范围内。第二步，作者分析异步 RL 的 staleness 结构，不再把一条轨迹视为来自单一行为策略，而是拆成 inter-trajectory staleness 和 intra-trajectory version switching。后者是文章里更关键的观察：长轨迹生成过程中，worker 可能在中途同步到新权重，于是同一条轨迹前半段和后半段来自不同版本。此时在切换点附近，当前目标策略去评估旧前缀下的新续写，会同时看到 entropy 和 ratio 的跃升。作者认为这不是应被统一裁掉的“坏 off-policy”，而是异步训练天然引入的探索。第三步，在上述分析上提出 ESTR，Entropy-Scaled Trust Region。它不是用固定阈值判断 |δ_t| 是否过大，而是让每个 token 的允许边界随其熵自适应伸缩：低熵 token 采用更紧的 trust region，避免噪声放大进入梯度；高熵 token 采用更宽的 trust region，保留真实探索。论文强调 ESTR 不需要显式重建行为策略，也不依赖人为 magnitude bias。实现上，它是 token-level 的筛选/约束机制，可嵌入异步 RL 流程中，替代传统的统一 ratio clipping 或 hard masking。
summary.experiments: 实验重点放在长时程 agentic 任务和复杂推理 benchmark。文中给出的代表性结果是：在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，ESTR 达到 37.3 avg@1，优于最强异步基线的 34.9；同时训练速度达到同步 GRPO 的 2.6 倍，并能在效果上匹配同步 GRPO。这个结果很关键，因为异步方法常见的两难是“更快但更差”或“更稳但吞吐损失大”，而 ESTR 试图把两者拉回平衡。论文的说服力主要来自几类证据。其一，真实 rollout 上的联合分布分析显示 |δ_t| 与 H_t 明显正相关，说明统一阈值缺乏统计依据。其二，版本切换点附近 entropy 和 ratio 同时上升，而标准化偏差项保持在正常尺度，支持“高熵大 ratio 未必是坏样本”的解释。其三，和 interval clipping、hard masking 以及其他异步稳定化方法相比，ESTR 在长轨迹场景下更稳，能减少 policy collapse。若精读实验，建议特别留意不同熵区间下 token 保留/抑制行为的可视化，以及同步、异步、不同 masking 策略之间的训练曲线差异。这些图比单个最终分数更能说明方法为何有效。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合精读。先看 Introduction 和 Motivation，抓住作者要推翻的两个默认前提：ratio 大小可直接代表可信度，以及一条轨迹可视作来自单一行为策略。随后重点读 Figure 1 到 Figure 3 对应的分析：一是 entropy 与 |δ_t| 的耦合关系，二是 intra-trajectory version switching 如何造成切换点处的联合尖峰。方法部分要看清 ESTR 的边界如何随熵变化，以及它在训练中具体替代了哪种 clipping/masking 逻辑。实验部分优先看 BrowseComp-Plus 和其他长轨迹任务上的主结果表，再看训练稳定性曲线和按熵分桶的分析图。附录若有时间值得读，因为理论推导决定了这篇工作的可信度，不只是经验技巧。精读时可以带着三个问题：第一，熵是否是最合适的尺度变量，还是还应结合 advantage/reward uncertainty；第二，ESTR 与 PPO/GRPO 的 clipping 是否存在相互作用；第三，这种 token-level trust region 能否迁移到异步 pretraining、speculative decoding 产生的分布偏移，或多模态 token 的统一 RL 场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a central failure mode in asynchronous RL for LLM post-training. Asynchrony improves throughput by overlapping rollout generation with policy optimization, but the resulting data are stale and off-policy: updates are applied to trajectories not fully generated by the current policy, and long trajectories may even span multiple weight versions. Existing methods usually clip or mask tokens using a single threshold on the importance-ratio magnitude, implicitly assuming that a large ratio means an untrustworthy token. The paper argues that this assumption breaks in asynchronous agentic RL because the natural scale of the ratio depends strongly on token entropy. Large ratios at low entropy are often amplified sampling noise, while large ratios at high entropy can reflect legitimate exploration induced by asynchronous updates. The real problem is therefore how to suppress harmful off-policy noise without discarding useful exploration, and to do so without reconstructing an exact behavior policy.
summary_en.importance: The contribution matters beyond one more stabilization trick. It changes how off-policy ratios should be interpreted: not as quantities with a universal threshold, but as state-dependent signals whose scale is entropy-conditioned. That is important for long-CoT RL, multi-turn agents, and any high-throughput asynchronous pipeline, where stale data are unavoidable. For pretraining researchers, the broader lesson is that token-level training signals do not live on a fixed scale; their meaning depends on local uncertainty. This resonates with issues such as confidence calibration, loss spikes, and optimization under heterogeneous token difficulty. The paper is also useful because it connects systems design and optimization statistics directly: throughput gains from asynchrony are only real if the induced distribution shift is modeled correctly. In terms of contribution type, this is a strong combination of mechanism analysis and practical method design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper develops its argument in three steps. First, it establishes an entropy-ratio relation. Both empirically and theoretically, the authors show that the natural scale of the token-level log-importance ratio grows with token entropy. Intuitively, in low-entropy regions where the model is highly confident, a small train-inference discrepancy can be blown up into a large ratio because of near-zero probabilities. Such large ratios are often noise rather than meaningful policy drift. In high-entropy regions, by contrast, larger ratios are expected and can still be statistically normal. Second, the paper decomposes asynchronous staleness more carefully. Instead of treating each trajectory as if it came from one behavior policy, it separates inter-trajectory staleness from intra-trajectory version switching. The latter is the more novel observation: during a long rollout, a worker may sync to a newer model mid-generation, so different segments of the same trajectory come from different policy versions. Around the switch point, entropy and importance ratios rise together. The paper argues that this should not be interpreted as purely harmful off-policy drift; it is often valid exploration introduced by asynchronous training itself. Third, based on these observations, the authors propose ESTR, the Entropy-Scaled Trust Region. Rather than applying a fixed threshold to |δ_t|, ESTR uses a token-wise trust-region boundary that expands with entropy and contracts when entropy is low. Low-entropy tokens are constrained more tightly to block amplified noise; high-entropy tokens are given a wider admissible region so that useful exploration is preserved. A key practical point is that ESTR does not require explicit behavior-policy reconstruction and does not rely on hand-tuned magnitude bias. It is a token-level filtering or constraint mechanism that can replace conventional ratio clipping or hard masking inside asynchronous RL training.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments focus on long-horizon agentic tasks and difficult reasoning settings. The headline result reported in the paper is on BrowseComp-Plus: ESTR reaches 37.3 avg@1, compared with 34.9 for the strongest prior asynchronous baseline, while matching synchronous GRPO in quality and training 2.6x faster. This is the right comparison to care about, because asynchronous RL usually faces a trade-off between throughput and optimization fidelity. The evidence is not just in the final score table. The paper first shows, on real rollouts, that |δ_t| increases systematically with token entropy, which undermines the statistical validity of a single global threshold. It then analyzes version-switch points inside trajectories and shows concurrent spikes in entropy and ratio, while the standardized deviation remains well-behaved, supporting the claim that many high-entropy large-ratio tokens are legitimate rather than pathological. Finally, against interval clipping, hard masking, and other asynchronous stabilization baselines, ESTR is more stable on long trajectories and reduces policy collapse. When reading the experiments, the most informative figures are the entropy-binned analyses and the training curves under different masking strategies; they explain why the method works, not just that it works.
summary_en.reading_guide: This one is worth a careful read. Start with the introduction and motivation, focusing on the two assumptions the paper challenges: that ratio magnitude alone indicates token trustworthiness, and that each trajectory can be associated with a single behavior policy. Then study the analysis around Figures 1–3: first the coupling between entropy and |δ_t|, then the role of intra-trajectory version switching in creating joint spikes. In the method section, make sure to understand exactly how the ESTR boundary scales with entropy and how it replaces standard clipping or masking logic in training. In the experiments, prioritize the main results on BrowseComp-Plus and other long-horizon tasks, then the stability curves and entropy-bucket visualizations. The appendix is worth reading if time allows, because the theoretical derivation is central to the paper’s credibility. Good questions to keep in mind are: whether entropy is the best scaling variable or should be combined with reward/advantage uncertainty; how ESTR interacts with PPO/GRPO clipping; and whether a similar token-level trust region could be useful in asynchronous pretraining, speculative decoding mismatch, or multimodal RL with heterogeneous token types.

recommendation.zh: 应读；它改变 importance-ratio clipping 的默认先验，异步 RL 系统要复查低熵 token 的噪声放大。
recommendation.en: Read it; it changes the default prior on importance-ratio clipping, and async RL systems should recheck low-entropy token noise amplification.

paper.title: SOAP, Muon, and Beyond: Pushing LLM Pretraining Scales
paper.abstract: Higher-order optimizers such as Muon and SOAP offer faster convergence than AdamW, but their computational cost and numerical stability challenges have limited adoption at scale. In this work, we adapt and enhance preconditioned gradient methods to overcome the practical challenges of large-scale LLM pretraining. We first identify instabilities in SOAP at large batch sizes and propose algorithmic modifications including per-step QR orthogonalization and improved preconditioning strategies that e

summary.core_problem: Muon、SOAP这类张量级自适应高阶优化器相比AdamW收敛速度更快，但在大规模LLM预训练场景（尤其是大batch、MoE大模型）下存在数值不稳定、计算开销高、公平对比缺失的问题，始终未能落地到生产级训练流程。
summary.importance: 优化器是前沿大模型训练的核心瓶颈，直接决定数据效率、最大可扩展batch size、内存占用和最终模型质量。研究在72B参数MoE、100M token全局batch的规模下，对AdamW、Muon、SOAP三类优化器开展系统、公平的对比，修复了SOAP在大batch下的关键稳定性问题，提供了可直接落地的分布式实现，结果可直接指导下一代大规模预训练流程的优化器选型。
summary.technical_approach: 核心技术贡献分为三部分：1）定位SOAP在大batch下出现loss spike的根因是预条件器更新与当前梯度统计之间的滞后，提出每步QR正交化、基于KL散度的协方差估计累积SOAP的Kronecker因子两项修改，完全消除训练不稳定；2）提出update-RMS匹配框架，实现不同优化器之间的公平学习率迁移，避免因学习率调优不当导致的对比偏差；3）在Megatron-LM中实现分层分布式优化器版本，针对MoE场景做适配，将通信和内存开销控制在可接受范围。在此基础上对三类优化器的收敛速度、稳定性、泛化性能开展受控对比。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖从小型稠密模型到72B参数MoE大模型，全局batch size最高达到100M token。关键结果包括：1）AdamW在batch size超过临界值后token效率明显下降，而Muon和修复后的SOAP在100M token batch下仍保持稳定的token高效收敛；2）修改后的KL-SOAP完全消除了此前观测到的loss spike，最终性能略优于Muon，两者在相同计算预算下均显著超过AdamW；3）系统基准测试显示，分布式实现的开销在大规模生产场景下可接受。
summary.reading_guide: 精读重点关注四部分：1）第3章的update-RMS匹配方法，解决了长期以来跨优化器对比中学习率不对齐导致的结果不可信问题；2）第5.4节SOAP不稳定的根因分析与修复方案，这是SOAP从研究走向生产的关键修改；3）第5.3和5.5节大batch、72B MoE上的对比结果，观察不同batch size下三类优化器的收敛曲线差异；4）第6章的分布式实现细节，尤其是MoE专家参数的处理逻辑。可进一步深挖的方向包括不同参数张量（注意力层、MLP、专家参数、embedding层）上的优化器表现差异，以及预条件器更新频率与稳定性的权衡。预计精读时间1.5小时。

summary_en.core_problem: Higher-order tensor-wise optimizers such as Muon and SOAP deliver faster convergence than AdamW, but face numerical instability, high computational overhead, and lack of fair comparison benchmarks that have prevented their adoption in large-scale LLM pretraining, especially for large-batch and MoE regimes.
summary_en.importance: The optimizer is a core bottleneck for frontier LLM training, directly governing data efficiency, maximum scalable batch size, memory footprint, and final model quality. This work presents a systematic, fair comparison of AdamW, Muon, and SOAP at scales up to 72B-parameter MoE models with 100M-token global batch sizes, resolves critical stability issues in SOAP, and delivers production-ready distributed implementations. The results directly inform optimizer selection for next-generation large-scale pretraining pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three core technical contributions are presented: 1) Root cause analysis of SOAP instability at large batch sizes identifies lag between preconditioner updates and current gradient statistics as the source of loss spikes. Fixes include per-step QR orthogonalization of eigenbasis updates and integration of KL-divergence-based covariance estimation for accumulating SOAP's Kronecker factors, eliminating training instabilities. 2) An update-RMS matching framework is introduced to enable fair learning rate transfer across optimizers, removing comparison bias from suboptimal learning rate tuning. 3) A layer-wise distributed implementation integrated with Megatron-LM is designed to support efficient scaling to MoE models, with manageable communication and memory overhead. Controlled empirical comparisons of convergence, stability, and generalization across the three optimizer families are then conducted.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations span small dense models up to 72B-parameter MoE models, with global batch sizes up to 100M tokens. Key findings include: 1) AdamW shows clear token efficiency degradation beyond a critical batch size, while both Muon and the fixed SOAP variants maintain stable, token-efficient convergence even at 100M-token batches. 2) The modified KL-SOAP variant eliminates all previously observed loss spikes, achieves slightly better final performance than Muon, and both significantly outperform AdamW at matched compute budgets. 3) Systems benchmarks confirm the distributed implementations have acceptable overhead for production deployment at scale.
summary_en.reading_guide: For close reading, prioritize four sections: 1) The update-RMS matching framework in Section 3, which addresses a longstanding flaw in cross-optimizer comparisons caused by misaligned learning rate scaling. 2) The SOAP instability root cause analysis and fixes in Section 5.4, which are the key changes required to move SOAP from research to production. 3) The large-batch and 72B MoE convergence results in Sections 5.3 and 5.5, which show how performance differs across optimizers as batch size scales past AdamW's critical threshold. 4) The distributed implementation details in Section 6, particularly the handling of MoE expert parameters. Open directions to explore further include per-layer optimizer performance differences across attention, MLP, expert, and embedding parameters, and the tradeoff between preconditioner update frequency and training stability. Estimated reading time: 1.5 hours.

recommendation.zh: NVIDIA大规模验证高阶优化器在LLM预训练的可用性，SOAP稳定性修复和update-RMS对比方法可直接复用，需立刻在内部栈验证。
recommendation.en: NVIDIA validates higher-order optimizers for large-scale LLM pretraining at scale; SOAP stability fixes and update-RMS comparison are directly reusable, validate in internal stacks immediately.

paper.title: Weight-norm Criticality: A Mechanism for Loss Spikes Induced by the Normalization and Weight Decay
paper.abstract: Most explanations of training instability focus on \emph{learning-rate criticality}, typically characterized by the Edge of Stability, beyond which optimization becomes unstable. We argue that, in practical deep neural network training, there is an additional and often overlooked \emph{weight-norm criticality}. This criticality is induced by the interaction between normalization (which introduces scale-invariant components) and weight decay (which persistently shrinks parameter norms). As the we

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是一个训练稳定性问题：为什么带 Normalization 的网络在较强 weight decay 下会出现突然的 loss spike。已有解释多把 spike 归因于 learning-rate criticality，也就是有效学习率越过稳定边界。作者指出还有一类独立但相互耦合的机制：weight-norm criticality。Normalization 让部分权重具有尺度不变性，loss 对这些权重的整体缩放不敏感；但 weight decay 会持续压小这些权重范数，而局部 Hessian sharpness 会随范数变小快速放大，最终把优化推到不稳定区。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于，它给 loss spike 提供了一个可定位、可监控的机制解释。大模型训练里 LayerNorm、RMSNorm、weight decay 几乎是默认配置，spike 往往被归因于 batch 异常、学习率过大、Adam 动量滞后或数据混合问题。这篇论文提醒：即使学习率没有明显越界，scale-invariant component 的权重范数塌缩也可能单独制造 sharpness 放大。贡献量级不是新的训练 recipe，而是一个诊断框架：把 instability 从全局 learning-rate 判断，细化到某些归一化相关层的 weight-norm threshold。它也解释了一个实际张力：weight decay 有泛化收益，但对归一化网络不能无限加大，否则会把特定层推过临界边界。
summary.technical_approach: 核心技术路线是把 Normalization 引入的尺度不变性写进 landscape 分析。对进入 BN、LN 等归一化模块的权重，网络输出在一定条件下对权重缩放近似不变，所以 loss 沿径向缩放方向不变。但曲率不是不变的：当权重范数变小，相关方向的 Hessian 特征值会被放大，典型尺度可理解为与权重范数的倒数平方相关。weight decay 在这些分量上持续施加收缩力，因此会把权重范数推向低值区；一旦 Hessian 放大到学习率无法稳定离散优化的位置，就会出现 spike。论文进一步提出 weight-norm criticality indicator，把 Hessian 与学习率结合起来预测是否发生 spike。一个实用点是临界条件可以按 scale-invariant component 分解，不需要计算全模型 Hessian，只需计算某一层或某个归一化相关参数块上的 restricted Hessian。这使得方法可以用于多归一化层的现实模型，并能把 spike 归因到具体层，而不是只得到一个全局不稳定判断。它和 Edge of Stability 的区别在于：EoS 主要看给定参数点的有效步长是否超过 sharpness 阈值；这里强调 weight decay 会动态改变尺度不变权重的范数，从而改变 sharpness 本身。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖了语言模型、视觉模型和简化可控模型。作者在一个 LLaMA-style Transformer 上做一轮 100B-token corpus 的预训练，只扫 weight decay 系数 {0, 0.5, 1}，其余训练设置固定；loss 曲线显示较强 weight decay 会诱发明显 spike。为排除语言建模和 Transformer 的特殊性，又在 CIFAR-100 上训练 ResNet-50，并用 SGD 扫 weight decay，同样观察到 Normalization 网络中的 spike。随后用 MNIST 上的全连接网络做因果拆解：隐藏层分别使用 BN、LN 或 Identity，只改变是否有归一化。结果表明，weight decay 或 normalization 单独存在并不足以解释现象，关键是二者交互。论文还构造了合成回归任务，用更小的模型复现 weight-norm collapse 到 sharpness 放大再到 loss spike 的链条。消融的主要信息是：随着 weight decay 增大，归一化相关权重范数下降；对应 Hessian sharpness 上升；layer/component-wise criticality 指标能预测 spike，并能定位是哪些 scale-invariant component 先越界。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 和 Empirical Evidence 两部分，先确认问题边界：它不是在否定 learning-rate criticality，而是在补充一种由 normalization 与 weight decay 共同触发的临界机制。技术上应重点看理论推导中关于 scale-invariant weight norm 与 Hessian eigenvalue 放大的部分，以及 weight-norm criticality indicator 的定义。最值得深挖的是 layer-wise decomposition：如果要迁移到 LLM 预训练诊断，关键问题是 restricted Hessian 如何低成本估计、哪些参数块应该被视为 scale-invariant component、RMSNorm/PreNorm Transformer 下等价条件是否成立。实验上重点看 Fig. 1、Fig. 2，以及附录里的 Transformer 训练超参；需要判断 weight decay 取值是否接近大模型实际区间，以及该机制在 AdamW、gradient clipping、learning-rate schedule、norm placement 改变时是否仍然稳定存在。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why loss spikes can appear when normalized networks are trained with strong weight decay. Prior explanations mostly emphasize learning-rate criticality, where the effective step size crosses a stability boundary. The paper adds a separate mechanism: weight-norm criticality. Normalization creates scale-invariant parameter blocks. Weight decay keeps shrinking their norms. As those norms approach zero, the local Hessian can grow rapidly even though the loss is insensitive to rescaling, and the optimizer can be pushed into an unstable regime.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is diagnostic. Modern LLMs routinely combine LayerNorm or RMSNorm with decoupled weight decay, and loss spikes are often attributed to data batches, large learning rates, Adam dynamics, or global sharpness. This work shows that a particular normalized component can become unstable because its norm collapses, even when a global learning-rate story is incomplete. The contribution is not a new recipe, but a mechanism and a monitoring framework: stability can be checked at the level of scale-invariant blocks rather than only at the full-model level. It also clarifies why weight decay has a practical upper limit in normalized architectures: stronger regularization can improve generalization, but it can also move certain components past a norm-dependent critical boundary.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis incorporates normalization-induced scale invariance into loss-landscape stability. For weights feeding into normalization layers such as BN or LN, rescaling the weight vector may leave the network function largely unchanged. The loss is therefore insensitive to radial scaling, but the curvature is not. When the norm of such a weight block becomes small, the relevant Hessian eigenvalues can be amplified, roughly following the inverse scale of the norm. Weight decay supplies a persistent shrinkage force, so increasing the decay coefficient drives these blocks toward a high-sharpness region. The paper then defines a weight-norm criticality indicator combining local Hessian information and the learning rate. A practical feature is the component-wise decomposition: one can evaluate the restricted Hessian for a specific scale-invariant block instead of the full parameter Hessian. This makes the criterion applicable to architectures with many normalization modules and allows attribution of instability to individual layers.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical evidence spans several settings. A LLaMA-style Transformer is pretrained for one epoch on a 100B-token corpus while sweeping only the weight decay coefficient over {0, 0.5, 1}; stronger decay produces clear training-loss spikes. To show the effect is not specific to autoregressive language modeling, the authors train ResNet-50 on CIFAR-100 with SGD and again vary only weight decay, observing the same phenomenon in normalized networks. A controlled MNIST fully connected network then separates the factors by using BN, LN, or Identity in hidden blocks. The results indicate that neither normalization nor weight decay alone explains the spikes; the interaction is the driver. A synthetic regression setup further reproduces the chain from weight-norm shrinkage to Hessian growth and instability. The key ablation insight is that increasing decay shrinks normalization-related weight norms, raises sharpness, and makes the component-wise criticality indicator predictive of spikes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the Introduction and empirical sections first to understand the distinction from the standard Edge-of-Stability account. The most important technical part is the derivation linking scale-invariant weight norms to Hessian eigenvalue amplification, followed by the definition of the weight-norm criticality indicator. For LLM pretraining practice, the layer-wise decomposition is the part to inspect most carefully: it determines whether this can become a usable spike-monitoring tool. Useful follow-up questions are how to estimate the restricted Hessian cheaply, how the criterion changes under RMSNorm and PreNorm Transformers, and whether AdamW, gradient clipping, learning-rate schedules, or different normalization placements change the observed boundary. The Transformer hyperparameters in the appendix are worth checking to judge how close the experiment is to production-scale training regimes.

recommendation.zh: 提出归一化+权重衰减交互导致loss spike的新机制，应立刻在内部loss spike排查中纳入权重范数监控项。
recommendation.en: Proposes a novel mechanism of loss spikes from normalization-weight decay interaction; add weight-norm monitoring to internal loss spike diagnosis pipelines immediately.

paper.title: The Dark Room in the Reward Channel: Dense Prediction Rewards Collapse GRPO-Trained LLM Agents -- and What Actually Works
paper.abstract: Dense per-step supervision is an appealing remedy for sparse-reward, long-horizon LLM agents: reward the agent for predicting its next observation, and memory should follow. We show that under group-normalized RL (GRPO), this recipe does not merely fail -- it destroys the policy. Across Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B on ALFWorld, a potential-based prediction reward drives every run into a degenerate absorbing state (prediction accuracy -> 1.0, task success -> 0,episode length pinned at the horizon): the "dark

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是：在长程 LLM agent 的 GRPO 训练中，把“预测下一步观察”作为 dense reward，为什么会让策略坍缩到可预测但无任务进展的状态。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口的启发在于，它把 reward 设计问题推进到 advantage estimator 层面。一个 episode-level 有界、看似安全的 shaping reward，经过 GRPO 的 group std normalization 后，会在全失败组里被放大成完整训练压力。这对 RL-for-reasoning、agent RL、过程奖励设计都有警示：reward 的绝对量级不够，必须看它在分组采样、归一化和失败分布下的方差结构。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者在 ALFWorld 多步环境中让模型每步输出一个可验证的 <predict> block，预测下一 observation 的任务无关特征，例如位置、可见物体、容器状态。预测奖励以 potential difference 形式注入，每步缩放系数 λ=0.1，episode 总和会 telescoping 到一个有界项，因此从 return 角度看扰动很小。但在 GRPO 中，组内 advantage 会除以本组标准差。稀疏成功奖励导致 all-fail groups 很常见，这时组内唯一差异来自很小的预测 shaping 项；std normalization 会把这个小差异标准化到完整尺度，使 λ 的缩小失效。论文用 Proposition 1 解释这种 λ-invariance，并进一步提出 variance-profile criterion：危险不取决于 dense signal 的大小或密度，而取决于模型掌握该信号后，组内方差是否仍然存在。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B，在 ALFWorld 上以相同配置训练：group size 4，训练 batch 为 8×4=32 trajectories/step，验证 32 episodes，采样温度 0.4。加入预测奖励后，所有规模都出现相同轨迹：初期看似改善，随后转向，最终进入吸收态；prediction accuracy 到 1.0，task success 到 0，episode length 固定在 horizon。单因素消融显示，只移除 GRPO 的 std normalization，就能把同一 reward 从 0% collapse 恢复到约 51.6% success，接近 baseline。信号通道实验显示，把同样内容作为 reward channel 基本中性或有害，而作为 auxiliary loss 可带来约 20 个百分点收益；shuffled-gold placebo 表明精确的内容-上下文配对不是主要有效因素。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 failure chain 的描述，再看 Proposition 1 和 Proposition 2，重点理解 all-fail group、std normalization、λ-invariance 三者的连接。实验部分优先看 collapse 曲线、去掉 std normalization 的单因素 rescue，以及 signal-delivery matrix。对做 RL post-training 的读者，最有用的是 variance-profile criterion 和 early-warning diagnostics；环境细节和 synthetic POMDP 可以按需浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why a dense next-observation prediction reward, intended to help long-horizon LLM agents with sparse task rewards, can collapse GRPO training into a predictable but task-useless policy.
summary_en.importance: The useful lesson is at the interface between reward design and the advantage estimator. A shaping reward can be bounded at the episode-return level and still become destructive after group-wise standard-deviation normalization. This matters for RL training of reasoning models and agents: reward scale alone is not a safety knob. The relevant object is the reward signal’s within-group variance under the sampler, especially in all-fail groups where sparse success rewards provide no variation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup asks the agent to emit a verifiable <predict> block at each step in ALFWorld. The prediction targets task-agnostic features of the next observation, such as location, visible objects, and receptacle state. The reward is implemented as a potential difference with coefficient λ=0.1, so the episode-level sum telescopes to a bounded term. The failure arises inside GRPO. Because sparse terminal rewards create many all-fail groups, the only within-group return differences are the small dense prediction terms. GRPO then divides by the group standard deviation, turning those small differences into full-scale normalized advantages. Proposition 1 formalizes the resulting λ-invariance: reducing the shaping coefficient does not reduce the update in such groups, unless the coefficient is set to zero. Proposition 2 reframes the issue as a variance-profile criterion: a dense signal is dangerous when its within-group variance survives after the model has mastered it.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments train Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B agents on ALFWorld with group size 4, 8 groups per update, 32 trajectories per training step, 32 validation episodes, and sampling temperature 0.4. With the prediction reward, all tested scales follow the same pattern: an initial honeymoon phase, a turn, and then an absorbing state with prediction accuracy reaching 1.0, task success dropping to 0, and episode length pinned at the horizon. A single-factor ablation localizes the cause: removing only GRPO’s standard-deviation normalization changes the same reward from 0% success to about 51.6%, roughly baseline parity. The delivery-channel experiments are also informative. Reward-channel variants are neutral or harmful, while delivering similar information through an auxiliary loss improves success by about 20 points. A shuffled-gold placebo suggests that exact content-context pairing is not the main active ingredient.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Read the Introduction for the failure chain, then focus on Proposition 1 and Proposition 2 to understand why bounded shaping can become large after z-scoring. In the experiments, prioritize the collapse curves, the ablation that removes standard-deviation normalization, and the signal-delivery matrix. For RL post-training work, the variance-profile criterion and early-warning diagnostics are the most reusable pieces. The synthetic POMDP and feature-coverage analysis are useful if one wants a more controlled account of when prediction-style signals fail.

recommendation.zh: GRPO稠密奖励崩溃的机制扎实且普适，做RL后训练或mid-train RL的人必须注意这个归一化坑，可直接复现验证避坑
recommendation.en: The mechanism of GRPO collapse with dense rewards is solid and generalizable; anyone doing RL post-training or mid-train RL must note this normalization pitfall

paper.title: SLAI T-Rex: Full-Parameter Post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 Family on Ascend SuperPOD
paper.abstract: Full-parameter post-training of trillion-parameter-scale MoE models introduces substantial system-level challenges for large-scale distributed training, including severe memory pressure, non-overlapped communication overhead, and inefficient kernel execution. While most large-scale LLM training systems are built around GPU-based clusters, this report presents an end-to-end optimization practice on the Ascend NPU SuperPOD. Using the DeepSeek-V4 model family as the target workload, we develop a hi

summary.core_problem: 解决万亿级 MoE 模型在 Ascend NPU 集群上做全参数后训练时的内存、通信重叠和 kernel 效率问题。
summary.importance: 这是大规模训练系统与 recipe 的工程报告，价值在于把 GPU 主导的 LLM 训练经验迁移到 Ascend SuperPOD，并给出可落地的分层优化框架。对做大规模预训练/后训练基础设施的人，信息密度很高。
summary.technical_approach: 工作以 DeepSeek-V4 family 为目标负载，提出覆盖三层的端到端优化：模型级并行与切分、计算-通信编排与重叠、底层 kernel 执行优化。作者把这些系统优化整合为 SLAI T-Rex，并在其上建立 CPT 与 SFT 工作流，说明系统不仅能跑通 benchmark，还能支撑复杂任务后训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的核心结果是 MFU 达到 34.22%，相对开源 baseline recipe 提升 2.93 倍，同时保持训练稳定。论文聚焦系统效率与稳定性，而不是模型能力刷新；从预训练研究视角，最值得看的是并行策略、通信编排和稳定性处理细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自深圳环湾研究院 AI Training Platform Team，论文以 DeepSeek-V4 family 为目标工作负载，属于头部实验室相关的大规模训练系统实践。
