summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles memory pressure, communication overlap, and kernel-efficiency bottlenecks in full-parameter post-training of trillion-scale MoE models on Ascend NPU clusters.
summary_en.importance: This is a large-scale training-systems report. Its value lies in translating GPU-centric LLM training practice into an Ascend SuperPOD setting and presenting an end-to-end optimization stack that is directly relevant to large-scale pretraining and post-training infrastructure.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using the DeepSeek-V4 family as the target workload, the authors build a hierarchical optimization framework spanning model-level parallelism, compute-communication orchestration, and low-level kernel execution. They package the system as SLAI T-Rex and further demonstrate CPT and SFT workflows on top of it.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result in the abstract is 34.22% MFU, a 2.93x improvement over an open-source baseline recipe, while preserving training stability. The paper is about systems efficiency and stability rather than capability gains; for pretraining researchers, the key sections are parallelism, overlap strategy, and stability engineering.
summary_en.authors_note: The team is from the AI Training Platform Team at Shenzhen Loop Area Institute, and the work is built around the DeepSeek-V4 family, making it a notable large-scale training-systems practice tied to a top lab ecosystem.

recommendation.zh: 这类报告会直接改你对“非 CUDA 集群能否高效训大 MoE”的先验；先复现其并行与通信重叠设计，再看 MFU 是否能在自家栈上站住。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on whether non-CUDA clusters can train giant MoEs efficiently; first inspect the parallelism and overlap design, then test whether the MFU story survives on your own stack.

institutions: AI Training Platform Team, Shenzhen Loop Area Institute

paper.title: Stale but Stable: Staleness-Adaptive Trust Regions for Stabilizing Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement learning improves throughput by decoupling rollout generation from optimization, but staleness is an inevitable byproduct compounded by policy lag, engine delays, and mixture-of-experts routing. From a trust-region perspective, this mismatch is critical: training-inference divergence governs approximation error in finite-horizon bounds, whereas PPO clipping only gates sampled outward updates, acting as a sampled surrogate rather than a full-policy constraint. As a resu

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理异步 RL 训练中的 staleness 问题：rollout 用旧策略生成 token，trainer 用新策略更新参数，二者之间的实际 mismatch 会随 lag、推理引擎实现差异、低精度数值和 MoE routing 等因素变得长尾化。固定 PPO clip 半径无法区分可靠 token 和高 staleness token，容易在后期训练中放大训练-推理分布偏移。
summary.importance: 对大模型 RL 训练稳定性有直接参考价值，尤其是 rollout 和 optimization 解耦的高吞吐训练系统。贡献不在于新的奖励建模，而在于把“配置上的 lag”改写成“token 级实际策略 mismatch”的优化问题，并给出一个低侵入的 PPO clipping 修改。对预训练研究的启发主要在训练动态层面：系统异步、kernel 差异、MoE routing 这类工程细节会进入优化目标，不能只用 trainer step lag 作为稳定性指标。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Staleness-Adaptive Trust Region，简称 SAT。核心做法是用 detached sampled log-ratio db,t = log πj(y|s) - log μ(y|s) 作为 token 级 staleness proxy，并将它分解为 policy-update mismatch 和 implementation mismatch。论文从有限 horizon policy improvement bound 出发，指出真正需要控制的是 target policy 和 behavior policy 的状态级 divergence，而 PPO clip 只是 sampled-action surrogate，并不能给所有 action 提供硬约束。SAT 因此不统一缩小 PPO clip，而是只对 batch 内高 staleness 分位尾部 token 收紧 outward update 的边界。它通过 batch 自校准 quantile 找到异常 staleness token，再用 staleness-based kernel scaling 得到 contraction factor，最后只收缩与当前 advantage 符号对应的 clip endpoint。pull-back update 保持原 PPO 行为，这一点很重要，因为这些梯度会把策略拉回 behavior policy，而不是继续扩大 mismatch。相比固定半径 PPO，SAT 的 clip 区间被包含在 PPO 区间内；相比 DPPO 这类 asymmetric clipping，SAT 的边界由当前 batch 观察到的实际 staleness 决定，而不是只依赖 behavior probability。
summary.experiments: 实验设置是 batch-wise asynchronous RL：SGLang 负责 rollout，Megatron 负责 training，权重每若干 trainer step broadcast。论文报告了 configured lag = 1 和 lag = 8 的受控实验。主要结论是，在高 staleness 场景下，SAT 相比固定 clip 更稳定，性能更好；SAT-GSPO w/ R3 是报告中表现最好的变体，同时保持较低的 observed staleness。论文强调 routing replay 和 SAT 的作用不同：routing replay 降低 logged mismatch 的水平，SAT 改变 divergence-expanding gradient 的截断位置，二者可以互补。给定材料中没有完整列出各任务的最终分数和消融表数值，阅读时需要重点核对 lag=8 下的性能曲线、staleness 分布和各 SAT kernel / quantile / contraction 设计的消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。优先看 Section 2.1–2.2，理解 configured lag 和 realized mismatch 的区别，以及 db,t 的分解。再看 Section 3 的 policy-improvement bound 推导，重点是为什么 PPO clipping 不能等价于控制 target-behavior divergence。方法部分关注三个细节：高 staleness tail 如何被 quantile gate 选中，kernel scaling 如何映射到 contraction factor，以及 sign-selected endpoint 为什么只截断 outward update。实验部分重点看 lag=1 与 lag=8 的对比、observed staleness 的分布图、SAT-GSPO w/ R3 的消融。若只关心工程落地，可以跳过部分证明，直接看算法伪代码和异步训练设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies instability in asynchronous RL for large models. Rollout workers sample tokens from stale behavior policies, while trainers update a newer target policy. The realized mismatch is not just the configured step lag; it also includes engine-level differences, low-precision numerics, and MoE routing effects. Under this heterogeneous and long-tailed mismatch, a fixed PPO clip radius gives high-staleness tokens the same outward update allowance as reliable tokens.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for large-scale RL training where rollout and optimization are decoupled for throughput. Its main contribution is not a new reward objective, but a cleaner optimization view of asynchronous staleness at token level. It highlights a practical lesson for foundation-model training: system details such as inference kernels, routing replay, and trainer-rollout mismatch can enter the learning signal, so stability cannot be reasoned about from trainer-step lag alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is Staleness-Adaptive Trust Region, or SAT. It uses the detached sampled log-ratio db,t = log πj(y|s) - log μ(y|s) as a per-token staleness proxy, with a decomposition into policy-update mismatch and implementation mismatch. The analysis starts from a finite-horizon policy-improvement bound, where the approximation penalty is tied to target-behavior divergence. PPO clipping is shown to be a sampled-action surrogate rather than an all-action ratio envelope. SAT therefore does not shrink the PPO clip range uniformly. It identifies the high-staleness tail in each batch using a self-calibrating quantile, maps unusually large staleness to a contraction factor through a kernel function, and contracts only the sign-selected endpoint of the PPO interval. Pull-back updates are left unchanged. This keeps the method close to PPO while cutting off outward updates earlier exactly where they are more likely to enlarge divergence.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use a batch-wise asynchronous setup with SGLang for rollout and Megatron for training, with periodic weight broadcasts. The paper reports controlled runs at configured lags 1 and 8. SAT improves stability and performance in the high-staleness regime, and the best reported variant, SAT-GSPO with R3, also maintains relatively low observed staleness. The paper separates two mechanisms: routing replay reduces the level of logged mismatch, while SAT changes where divergence-expanding gradients are clipped. The provided material does not expose the full numerical tables, so the key numbers to verify in the full paper are the lag-8 learning curves, observed-staleness histograms, and ablations over the gating and contraction choices.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is enough for most readers. Start with Sections 2.1–2.2 to understand the distinction between configured lag and realized mismatch. Then read the policy-improvement-bound argument in Section 3, focusing on why PPO clipping is not a hard divergence control. In the method section, inspect the quantile gate, staleness kernel, contraction factor, and sign-selected clipping endpoint. In the experiments, prioritize the lag-1 versus lag-8 comparison, the observed-staleness distribution, and the SAT-GSPO with R3 ablations. Readers interested mainly in deployment can focus on the algorithm and asynchronous-system setup rather than the full proof.

recommendation.zh: 异步RL的陈旧性是大模型RLHF的实际痛点，SAT的信任域收缩思路值得在内部RL训练pipeline中测试。
recommendation.en: Staleness in async RL is a practical pain point for LLM RLHF; the SAT trust-region contraction idea is worth testing in internal RL training pipelines.

paper.title: Reducing Per-Sample Harm in Stochastic Optimization
paper.abstract: Modern optimizers combine gradients from the current mini-batch with historical optimization state, such as momentum or adaptive moments. While highly effective, aggregating across the batch and incorporating this history can produce parameter updates that increase the loss of individual samples. We term this effect harm and formalize the parameter update as an optimization problem that explicitly minimizes the conflicting impact of both batch averaging and past optimization state on current dat

summary.core_problem: 带动量或自适应矩的随机优化器在聚合批次梯度并结合历史状态时，可能使部分样本的损失上升，即 per-sample harm 问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将 per-sample harm 形式化并提出可高效集成到标准优化器的近似解法，对训练稳定性和泛化有潜在价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将参数更新建模为显式最小化批次平均和历史优化状态对当前数据冲突影响的优化问题，通过将维度降至批次大小、并限制在最后一层线性层求解，大幅降低内存与计算开销。
summary.experiments: 在标准优化器（SGD、Adam 类）上集成该代理问题，验证了最后一层线性层即可可靠捕捉逐样本梯度的二阶统计量，可有效降低 per-sample harm。

summary_en.core_problem: Stochastic optimizers with momentum or adaptive moments, by aggregating batch gradients and incorporating historical state, can increase loss on individual samples — an effect termed per-sample harm.
summary_en.importance: A methodological innovation that first formalizes per-sample harm and proposes an efficient surrogate integrable into standard optimizers, with potential implications for training stability and generalization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formulates the parameter update as an optimization problem that explicitly minimizes the conflicting impact of batch averaging and past optimization state on current data; reduces dimensionality to batch size and restricts computation to the last linear layer for efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: Integrated into standard optimizers (SGD, Adam-family); validates that the last linear layer alone reliably captures second-order statistics of per-sample gradients, effectively reducing per-sample harm.

recommendation.zh: 优化器方向的新颖视角，per-sample harm 的概念值得关注，重点看最后一层近似二阶统计量的发现是否能复现到 LLM 规模。
recommendation.en: A novel optimizer perspective; the per-sample harm concept is worth attention, focus on whether the last-layer second-order statistic finding scales to LLM settings.

paper.title: PsiLogic: Chaos-Aware Active Cancellation for Adam with a Fair Cross-Domain Benchmark
paper.abstract: Adaptive optimizers such as Adam and AdamW apply the same update rule regardless of whether training is in a chaotic early phase or near convergence. We introduce PsiLogic, an optimizer that augments Adam with a dynamic Active Cancellation Term gated by a dual exponential moving average (EMA) of scale-normalized gradient norms. The resulting chaos detector strengthens damping when gradient statistics are unstable and fades to zero as training stabilizes, providing an implicit warmup without a ha

summary.core_problem: Adam/AdamW 在训练早期梯度统计不稳定和接近收敛阶段使用同一更新规则，可能导致早期混沌阶段阻尼不足或需要手工 warmup。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是优化器改进与小规模 benchmark。它和预训练优化有关，但实验只有 2000 steps、少量 arena 和小规模 NLP/CV 设置，不能直接支持 LLM 预训练级别结论。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PsiLogic，在 Adam 上加入由双 EMA scale-normalized gradient norm 门控的 Active Cancellation Term。梯度统计不稳定时增强 damping，训练稳定后该项衰减为零，目标是提供一种隐式 warmup。
summary.experiments: 使用 FairBench 协议，对 Adam、AdamW、Lion 做 per-optimizer learning-rate sweeps、相同初始化和 Welch t-tests。在 NVIDIA H100 80GB、4 个 arenas、3 个 seeds、2000 steps、bf16 AMP 下，PsiLogic 在 3/4 个 arena 上最好：NLP perplexity 7.79±0.18，相比 AdamW 8.17±0.08，p=0.049；ViT top-1 accuracy 0.244±0.006，相比 AdamW 0.223±0.002。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the mismatch between Adam-style optimizers using the same update rule during unstable early training and near-convergence phases.
summary_en.importance: This is an optimizer proposal with a small reproducible benchmark. It is relevant to pretraining optimization, but the evidence is limited to short 2,000-step runs and small cross-domain arenas, so it should not be treated as LLM-scale evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: PsiLogic augments Adam with an Active Cancellation Term gated by dual EMAs of scale-normalized gradient norms. The term increases damping when gradient statistics are unstable and fades out as training stabilizes, acting as an implicit warmup mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: FairBench compares Adam, AdamW, and Lion with per-optimizer learning-rate sweeps, identical initialization per seed, and Welch t-tests. On an NVIDIA H100 80GB setup with 4 arenas, 3 seeds, 2,000 steps, and bf16 AMP, PsiLogic wins in 3 of 4 arenas, including NLP perplexity 7.79±0.18 versus AdamW 8.17±0.08 with p=0.049, and ViT top-1 0.244±0.006 versus AdamW 0.223±0.002.

recommendation.zh: 优化器想法可以备查，但 2000 steps 太短；只看门控公式和 LR sweep 是否公平。
recommendation.en: The optimizer idea is worth filing, but 2,000 steps is too short; only inspect the gating formula and whether the LR sweeps are fair.

paper.title: QUADS: Stabilizing NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning for MoE via QUantization-error Alignment across Dual Sides
paper.abstract: Rollout generation is a major bottleneck in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Large Language Models, motivating low-precision rollout acceleration such as FP8. As an emerging low-precision format, NVFP4 combines fine-grained scaling for accuracy preservation with native W4A4 FP4 GEMMs for higher throughput than FP8. However, we find that directly applying NVFP4 to MoE RL rollout is impractical. NVFP4 rollout with BF16 training collapses after roughly 150 steps, accompanied

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体的工程—算法接口问题：在 MoE 大模型的 RL 训练里，rollout 端如果用 Blackwell 上原生 W4A4 的 NVFP4 来提速，会因为 rollout 与 trainer 的 log-probability 偏差迅速放大而训练崩溃。作者要找出的不是“低精度会不会掉点”这种泛泛结论，而是：崩溃主要来自权重量化还是激活量化；如果主要来自激活误差，那么在 rollout 和 trainer 分离的 RL 管线里，怎样做误差对齐，才能既保住 W4A4 吞吐，又不破坏 GRPO 的策略梯度稳定性。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口、训练稳定性和低精度系统设计很有参考价值。原因有两点。第一，RL 训练越来越像一个分布式异构系统问题，rollout 精度不只是 serving 细节，而是直接进入 importance ratio 和 policy update 的训练信号。第二，这篇工作把“低精度不稳定”拆成了可操作的误差来源分析，指出在 NVFP4 这种极低比特格式下，激活误差比权重误差更致命，而两者不能用同一种对齐策略处理。这个结论对未来更激进的低精度 pretrain / mid-train 也有启发：如果训练和推理路径不一致，先分清哪些张量可同步、哪些张量是在线重算的，往往比统一做 fake quant 更关键。贡献量级属于强工程方法论文，尤其适合关注 RL 系统、MoE 和 Blackwell 低精度栈的人。
summary.technical_approach: 作者的方法叫 QUADS，核心是 dual-side quantization-error alignment，也就是 trainer 侧和 rollout 侧分别处理不同来源的误差，而不是试图用一个统一的量化方案覆盖全部路径。诊断部分先做了关键 ablation：把 rollout 中的权重和激活分开量化，比较 W4A16 与 W16A4。结果显示 W16A4 的失败模式几乎贴近完整 W4A4，而 W4A16 明显更稳定，说明 activation quantization 才是主导项，且权重误差与激活误差近似可加。基于这个发现，QUADS 分两部分。其一是 trainer-side asymmetric QAT：在训练端只对权重做 NVFP4 fake quantization / dequantization，对激活保持 BF16。这样做的原因很直接：权重在 rollout engine 与 trainer 之间是同步参数，可以共享匹配的 QDQ 路径；而激活是每次 rollout 在线重算的，若在 trainer 端也强行做对称 W4A4 fake quant，反而会把本来无法严格对齐的激活误差注入学习过程。其二是 rollout-side residual activation compensation：既然激活误差是主因，就在真正的 W4A4 rollout 里对高残差通道做 second-pass quantization，用额外一轮更精细的补偿减少 activation quantization 带来的 log-prob 偏差。作者强调这部分通过 fused kernels 实现，目的是保住大部分原生 W4A4 Tensor Core 吞吐优势，而不是退回高精度 GEMM。与已有方法相比，QeRL 之类只做 weight-only NVFP4，激活仍用 BF16，本质上没有进入真正的 W4A4 regime；FP8/INT8 RL 系统则处在更宽松的数值网格上，训练—推理不匹配更容易靠 clipping 或 TIS 控住。QUADS 的区别在于它正面处理 full-parameter MoE GRPO 下的原生 FP4 activation mismatch。
summary.experiments: 实验结论很清楚。首先，naive NVFP4 W4A4 rollout + BF16 training 会在大约 150 个 RL step 后崩溃，表现为 reward 和 held-out score 同时下降，且 rollout–trainer 的 per-token log-probability gap 单调增大，importance ratio 被推离 trust region。其次，分离量化的 ablation 证明了误差来源：W16A4 基本复现 W4A4 的不稳定，而 W4A16 更接近稳定训练，支持“激活误差主导”的判断。最终结果上，QUADS 在 full-parameter MoE GRPO 中把平均 pass@1 做到 72.86%，几乎追平 BF16 baseline 的 73.15%，远高于 naive NVFP4 的 51.37%。同时，rollout throughput 比 FP8 还高 16%。摘要里提到评测覆盖四个 held-out benchmarks，但给出的全文片段没有展开具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、专家数、训练 token 数和 group size G 等更细节数字；这些应在实验节和附录里核对。就目前可见信息，最重要的不是绝对分数，而是三组对比关系：BF16≈QUADS >> naive NVFP4，以及 QUADS 在稳定性恢复后仍保留对 FP8 的吞吐优势。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议很明确。先看 Introduction 里对 RL pipeline 的问题定义，确认作者讨论的是 decoupled rollout/trainer 架构下的数值偏差，而不是普通量化推理。然后直接看 Section 3.1 的 ablation，这是全文最关键的一页：如果不先接受“activation error 是主因”，后面的 asymmetric QAT 和 residual compensation 就会显得像两块经验 patch。接着看 trainer-side QAT 和 rollout-side compensation 的实现细节，重点关注为什么一边只量化权重、另一边专门补偿激活，以及 fused kernel 是否真的保住吞吐。最后看主结果表，核对三件事：训练是否稳定到全程、log-prob gap 是否被压回可控范围、吞吐提升是否在端到端而不只是 kernel 级。预计阅读时间 20-30 分钟。若要深挖，建议追问两个问题：一是这种方法对 dense model 是否同样成立，还是 MoE 的路由稀疏性放大了激活误差；二是 residual activation compensation 的额外开销在更长 CoT rollout 下是否仍然划算。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific systems-and-optimization problem in RL for MoE LLMs: native NVFP4 W4A4 rollout on Blackwell is attractive for throughput, but when rollout is run in FP4 while training remains in BF16, the rollout–trainer log-probability mismatch quickly destabilizes GRPO and causes collapse. The key question is not simply whether low precision hurts, but which source of error matters most—weights or activations—and how to align quantization error across the decoupled rollout and trainer paths without giving up the throughput advantage of true W4A4 execution.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is highly relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface, training stability, and low-precision system design. Two points matter. First, in modern RL pipelines, rollout precision is part of the training signal because token log-probabilities feed directly into importance ratios and policy updates; it is not just a serving detail. Second, the paper turns “low precision instability” into a structured error-analysis problem and shows that under NVFP4, activation quantization is much more damaging than weight quantization, and the two should not be handled with the same alignment strategy. That lesson generalizes: whenever training and inference paths diverge, it is often more important to distinguish synchronized tensors from online-recomputed tensors than to apply a uniform fake-quant recipe everywhere. The contribution is best seen as a strong engineering method paper for RL systems, MoE training, and Blackwell-era low-precision deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, QUADS, stands for quantization-error alignment across dual sides. The central idea is to treat trainer-side and rollout-side errors differently instead of forcing a single quantization scheme over both. The diagnostic step is crucial: the authors separately quantize weights and activations during rollout and compare W4A16 against W16A4. W16A4 closely reproduces the failure mode of full W4A4, while W4A16 is much more stable, showing that activation quantization dominates the instability and that weight and activation errors are roughly additive. Based on this, QUADS has two components. First, trainer-side asymmetric QAT: weights are fake-quantized to NVFP4, but activations remain in BF16. The rationale is that weights are synchronized across rollout and trainer engines, so their quantization–dequantization path can be aligned; activations are recomputed online during rollout and cannot be faithfully matched by symmetric W4A4 fake quantization on the learner side. Second, rollout-side residual activation compensation: since activation error is the main problem, the rollout engine performs a second-pass quantization on high-residual channels to reduce activation-induced log-prob bias while preserving native W4A4 GEMMs. The implementation uses fused kernels so that most of the throughput benefit of FP4 Tensor Cores is retained. This differs from prior work in an important way. Weight-only NVFP4 methods such as QeRL never enter the true W4A4 regime because activations stay in BF16, and FP8/INT8 RL systems operate on a much denser numerical grid where mismatch can often be controlled by clipping or truncated importance sampling. QUADS is designed specifically for full-parameter MoE GRPO with native FP4 activation quantization.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical story is straightforward. Naive NVFP4 rollout with W4A4 inference and BF16 training collapses after roughly 150 RL steps: reward and held-out performance drop, while the per-token rollout–trainer log-probability gap grows monotonically and pushes importance ratios outside the trust region. The weight-vs-activation ablation then identifies the source: W16A4 largely matches the instability of full W4A4, whereas W4A16 remains much closer to stable behavior, supporting the claim that activation error is the dominant driver. In the final results, QUADS reaches 72.86% average pass@1 across four held-out benchmarks, essentially matching the BF16 baseline at 73.15% and far outperforming naive NVFP4 at 51.37%. At the same time, it improves rollout throughput by 16% over FP8. The provided text does not expose finer details such as model size, expert count, benchmark names, total RL steps, or exact GRPO group settings, so those should be checked in the experimental section and appendix. The main takeaway is the relation among the three systems: BF16 ≈ QUADS >> naive NVFP4, with QUADS still preserving a throughput edge over FP8.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction to anchor the problem correctly: this is about numerical mismatch in a decoupled rollout/trainer RL pipeline, not generic quantized inference. Then go directly to the ablation in Section 3.1. That is the most important part of the paper. If the activation-dominant failure mode is not established first, the later design choices can look like ad hoc patches. After that, read the trainer-side asymmetric QAT and rollout-side residual compensation sections, focusing on why one side aligns weights while the other explicitly compensates activations, and whether the fused-kernel implementation really preserves throughput. Finally, inspect the main result tables for three things: end-to-end training stability, reduction of the rollout–trainer log-prob gap, and whether the throughput gain survives beyond kernel-level microbenchmarks. A useful skim should take 20–30 minutes. If you want to go deeper, two questions are worth pursuing: whether the same conclusion holds for dense models or is amplified by MoE routing sparsity, and whether the extra cost of residual activation compensation remains favorable for longer chain-of-thought rollouts.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看的是“激活误差比权重误差更致命”这个结论；若你在做低精度 RL 或 rollout-serving 一体化，先复现 log-prob gap 诊断再谈提速。
recommendation.en: The key takeaway is that activation error, not weight error, dominates FP4 RL collapse; if you run low-precision RL or rollout-serving stacks, reproduce the log-prob-gap diagnostic before chasing throughput.

paper.title: Ring-Zero: Scaling Zero RL to a Trillion Parameters for Emergent Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards without human-annotated data, often referred to as zero RL, has emerged as a powerful paradigm for eliciting chain-of-thought reasoning. However, due to computational constraints, existing studies are largely restricted to small models, leaving the training dynamics and emergent capabilities at a large scale unexplored. To meaningfully explore this frontier, we aim to elicit high-quality reasoning behaviors from the model. However, we find that naiv

summary.core_problem: 解决 zero RL（仅依赖可验证奖励、无人工标注）在超大模型上难以稳定扩展的问题，尤其是推理可读性差、冗余 token 多、推理深度不自适应等训练退化现象。
summary.importance: 这项工作的重要性不在于又做了一个 RL 配方，而在于把 zero RL 从小模型实验推进到 1T 参数量级，直接回答了“R1-Zero 类范式能否随规模继续成立”这个问题。贡献类型属于规模突破 + 训练系统/算法联合工程 + post-train 对 pretrain/scale 接口的实证研究。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上提出一套面向超大规模 zero RL 的稳定训练流水线，核心包括 clipped importance sampling、training-inference ratio correction、mixed-precision control 等算法与系统协同优化。论文关注的不是新 reward 设计，而是如何让大规模 RL rollout、更新比率和数值精度在 trillion 级模型上不把训练带偏，并改善 reasoning 轨迹的可读性与长度控制。
summary.experiments: 摘要明确给出最大规模达到 1T 参数，并围绕 sample efficiency、emergent reasoning 和训练稳定性给出三点主要发现。现有摘要未提供完整 baseline 名单、数据规模和具体提升幅度，但从表述看，比较对象应覆盖 naive scaling 与若干 zero-RL 训练变体，重点观察大模型在相同或相近 RL 预算下的效率和推理行为质量。若正文实验干净，这会是判断 zero RL 是否具备真正 scale law 的关键证据。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院、蚂蚁集团、清华大学、浙江大学。题目和设定明显延续 R1-Zero/可验证奖励推理这条线，属于国内强团队在大规模 RL 训练上的系统化推进。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles how to scale zero RL—reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and no human annotations—to trillion-parameter models without collapsing into unreadable, redundant, or poorly calibrated reasoning traces.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not merely another RL recipe. It pushes zero RL from small-model demonstrations to the 1T regime and directly probes whether the R1-Zero-style paradigm continues to hold under scale. This is a scale study plus an algorithm-system training contribution with clear implications for the pretrain↔post-train interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is a stability-oriented large-scale zero-RL pipeline combining clipped importance sampling, training-inference ratio correction, and mixed-precision control. The focus is less on inventing a new reward and more on keeping rollout, update ratio, and numerical precision well behaved at trillion scale while improving readability and adaptive depth of reasoning trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states experiments up to 1T parameters and highlights three findings around sample efficiency, emergent reasoning, and stable scaling. The abstract does not expose full baselines, data volume, or exact gains, but the likely comparisons are against naive scaling and simpler zero-RL variants, with emphasis on efficiency under comparable RL budgets and on reasoning trace quality. If the setup is clean, this becomes an important data point on whether zero RL has a genuine scaling regime.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Renmin University of China, Ant Group, Tsinghua University, and Zhejiang University. The framing clearly sits in the R1-Zero / verifiable-reward reasoning line and represents a serious large-scale systems push from strong Chinese labs.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该认真看：它不只是把 RL 做大，而是在检验 zero-RL 是否真有规模收益；先盯训练稳定性细节和 reasoning 长度分布，若 setup 干净，内部应尽快复现实验骨架。
recommendation.en: This is worth real attention: it is testing whether zero RL truly scales, not just making RL bigger; inspect the stability tricks and reasoning-length statistics first, and if the setup is clean, the training skeleton is worth reproducing internally.

institutions: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: The Silent Freeze: Predicting When Low-Precision Training Stops Learning
paper.abstract: Training in reduced floating-point precision can silently halt learning: when a gradient-descent weight update falls below half the unit in the last place (ULP) of the weight, it rounds away and that coordinate freezes while its gradient is still nonzero. The freeze is deterministic, governed by a per-coordinate half-ULP condition, and predictable from a high-precision trajectory and the target mantissa length alone, without low-precision data. In a small GPT trained under the standard AdamW-plu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个很具体、但在低精度预训练里常被忽略的问题：模型并不是因为梯度消失、优化失败或数值爆炸才停止学习，而是因为参数更新在目标精度下小于该参数当前数值的 half-ULP，更新被舍入掉，导致对应坐标虽然梯度仍非零，却再也无法移动。作者把这种现象称为 silent freeze。关键点不只是“会冻结”，而是冻结条件是逐坐标、确定性的，并且可以仅用一条高精度训练轨迹加目标 mantissa 位数，在不运行低精度训练的前提下预测冻结何时发生。论文要解决的核心问题，就是把这种看似训练动力学问题的现象，还原成一个由浮点表示粒度直接决定、可提前预报的停止学习机制。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响很直接。第一，它给低精度训练提供了一个比 loss spike、overflow、underflow 更隐蔽的失效模式：训练表面稳定，loss 甚至可能平滑，但参数已经大面积不再更新。第二，它把“能否继续学习”与权重尺度、梯度尺度、学习率日程、mantissa 位数联系到同一个无量纲量 ρ 上，这对 bf16 / fp8 / 量化感知训练的 recipe 设计很有启发。第三，这个结论不是某个优化器或某个 toy setting 的偶然现象；作者在 frozen-feature 线性模型、可训练两层 tanh 网络、CNN，以及 124M GPT-2 上都看到了同类行为。对大模型预训练来说，这意味着只看吞吐和最终 loss 不够，训练中后期是否进入“算术冻结区”本身就该成为监控指标。贡献类型上，这是训练稳定性与数值机制层面的基础性诊断工作，量级不在于立刻提升多少 benchmark，而在于解释了低精度训练何时会无声失效，以及如何事先规避。
summary.technical_approach:
方法很干净。作者从浮点数表示出发，写出在 mantissa 位数为 m 时，参数 wi 的表示间隔 ULP_m(wi)=2^{floor(log2|wi|)-m}。若一次梯度下降更新满足 |Δwi| < 1/2 ULP_m(wi)，按 round-to-nearest 后该坐标保持不变，于是该坐标被冻结。基于这个逐坐标条件，作者定义 frozen fraction f，即一次 step 后 bitwise 不变的参数比例，并把 f 首次达到 1/2 的时刻定义为 freeze time τ*。

更关键的是，他们把条件改写成无量纲形式 ρ_i < 2^{-φ_i}，其中 φ_i 是 log2|wi| 的小数部分，表示参数位于当前 binade 内的相对位置。若 φ_i 近似均匀分布，则 half-ULP 边界对应一个固定的一比特宽区间，其中位阈值给出 ρ* = 1/sqrt(2) ≈ 0.707，没有拟合参数。这个推导解释了为什么冻结阈值是 O(1) 常数，而不是随模型维度变尖锐的相变。

预测器的构造也很直接：先跑一条 fp64 高精度轨迹 {w_t, g_t}，然后对任意目标精度 m，在每个 step 上计算预测冻结比例 \hat f_t(m)=<1[η|g_{t,i}| < 1/2 ULP_m(w_{t,i})]>。\hat f_t 穿过 1/2 的时刻就是预测的 τ*。这里完全不需要低精度训练数据，因此如果预测成立，就说明冻结主要由算术离散化决定，而不是低精度训练反馈改变了动力学。

实验设计上，作者用了两类实现。其一是真实 bf16 硬件。其二是 mantissa-truncation emulator：所有算术在 fp64 中做，但每步后把权重 round 到 m-bit mantissa 网格。这样可以单独研究 mantissa 精度，而不混入 exponent 范围和 denormal 等因素。作者先在 m=7 上验证 emulator 与真实 bf16 一致，再扫 m∈{5,6,7,8,10,12}。这套设计的优点是把问题拆得很清楚：冻结来自权重存储精度本身，而不是某个硬件实现细节。

从全文看，论文还强调了两个细节。第一，冻结 onset 是 crossover，不会因为参数数目变大而变成无限尖锐的临界点，因为 half-ULP band 的宽度天然就是一比特。第二，在多层网络里，全局 L2 聚合的 ρ 可能失真，因为不同层尺度不同，小 bias 向量还可能长期不冻结；因此真正可靠的是逐坐标或分层统计，而不是单个全局标量。这一点对大模型监控很重要。
summary.experiments:
实验分四层展开，逻辑很完整。

1. frozen-feature 线性 GD + 真实 bf16 硬件：作者先在最简单可控的设定里直接观测冻结。step 100 时 frozen fraction f=0，step 300 时 f=1.0，之后训练最后 90% 的过程参数都保持冻结。用首次完全冻结点读取阈值，得到 ρ*≈0.72。

2. mantissa emulator 扫精度与学习率：在 m=7 上，emulator 对真实 bf16 的 freeze curve 拟合 RMSE 仅 0.002，说明它是可信替身。进一步扫 m∈{5,6,7,8,10,12}，覆盖 128× 的精度跨度，以及 4× 学习率范围，得到稳定阈值 ρ*=0.71，跨设置 coefficient of variation 为 0.06。这里最关键的结果不是单点数值，而是阈值几乎不随精度和学习率变化，只是 freeze time 在大范围移动。

3. 先验预测 τ*：这是全文最有说服力的实验。作者只用高精度轨迹和目标 mantissa 位数预测冻结时间，预测与实测在 384× 的 freeze-time 范围内一致，覆盖从 11 到 4222 steps。对可训练网络的 55 个 clean cells，predicted/measured 的中位比值为 1.00，约 94.5% 的 cell 落在 15% 误差内。更重要的是，预测能跟住个体轨迹差异；某些 run 比邻近设置早两个数量级冻结，预测也能提前指出。

4. 可训练非凸网络与真实数据：
- 两层 tanh teacher-student 回归中，emulator 与真实 bf16 的 freeze curve RMSE 为 0.007，阈值约 ρ*≈0.74；跨 seed 的 within-cell CV 中位数为 0.21。说明冻结并不依赖 frozen features 或凸性。
- 一个约 1e5 参数的 CNN，在 MNIST 上做交叉熵训练。emulator 扫 m∈{5,6,7,8,10}、3 个 seeds，共 15 个 precision-seed cells。这里先验预测达到“逐 cell 完全命中”：预测 freeze step 与实测完全相同，中位比值 1.000，最大误差 0%。真实 bf16 硬件上，m=7 的 freeze curve 也被 emulator 以 RMSE 0.02 复现。

5. 124M GPT-2：摘要里已经给出一个关键信号：在 124M GPT-2 上，如果每步后都把权重约束到 8-bit floating-point grid，训练也会在中途进入冻结区。虽然给出的正文片段没有完整展开 GPT-2 数字，但论文的意图很明确：silent freeze 不是小模型玩具现象，而是会出现在标准 Transformer 训练里。

整体上，最值得记住的数字有三个：阈值 ρ* 大致稳定在 0.71–0.74；高精度轨迹预测 freeze time 的中位比值 1.00；预测覆盖 11 到 4222 steps 的 384× 时间尺度。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“定义—预测器—泛化验证”这条线读。

先看 Results 开头关于 ULP、half-ULP 和 ρ 的推导，尤其是把冻结条件写成 ρ_i < 2^{-φ_i} 的那一段。这一段决定了全文是不是只是在做经验观察，还是已经把现象钉在浮点算术上。接着看 Fig.1：一边是真实 bf16 / emulator 的 freeze curve，一边是 predicted vs measured τ*。如果这两张图成立，论文的主结论基本就站住了。

然后看 Methods 里 ρ*=1/sqrt(2) 的推导，重点不是公式本身，而是作者为何能得到无拟合参数的阈值，以及 equidistributed φ_i 这个假设在实验里是否真的成立。这里值得深挖：大模型不同层、不同参数类型是否都满足这个假设，embedding、norm、bias 会不会偏离。

再看 trainable tanh network 和 CNN 两组实验。它们回答的是“这是不是只在线性 toy model 里成立”。CNN 那组尤其值得看，因为作者明确指出全局 pooled ρ 在多层异尺度网络里会失真，这对实际 LLM 监控很关键。读这部分时要留意他们如何改用分层或逐坐标视角解释结果。

如果时间有限，GPT-2 部分至少要看实验设置：权重是如何约束到低精度网格的，优化器是否仍是 AdamW+cosine，冻结发生在训练的哪个阶段。这里和真实大模型训练最相关。进一步可思考三个延伸问题：一，master weight 用高精度保存时，这个问题会被多大程度缓解；二，Adam 的动量与二阶矩是否会推迟冻结但不能根治；三，cooldown、weight decay、norm growth 控制是否能把 ρ 拉回安全区。

阅读时间上，精读约 45–60 分钟。若只抓主结论，先看 Results + Fig.1 + GPT-2 实验，20 分钟足够。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper isolates a specific failure mode of low-precision training: learning can stop not because gradients vanish or optimization diverges, but because individual parameter updates become smaller than half an ULP of the stored weight and are rounded away. Those coordinates then become permanently immobile even while their gradients remain nonzero. The central problem is to characterize this “silent freeze” as a deterministic arithmetic phenomenon, and to predict when it happens from a high-precision trajectory plus the target mantissa length, without running the low-precision training itself.
summary_en.importance: This matters for pretraining because it identifies a failure mode that standard training dashboards can easily miss. Loss may look smooth and training may appear stable, while a large fraction of parameters has already stopped moving. The work ties continued learnability to a single scale ratio involving weight magnitude, gradient magnitude, learning rate, and mantissa precision. That is directly relevant to bf16, fp8, and aggressively quantized training recipes. The contribution is not a benchmark gain; it is a numerical diagnosis with practical consequences for recipe design, monitoring, and precision allocation. For large-scale pretraining, the message is simple: throughput and final loss are not enough. One should also ask whether the run has entered an arithmetic freeze regime.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The analysis starts from floating-point spacing. For a format with m mantissa bits, the spacing at coordinate wi is ULP_m(wi)=2^{floor(log2|wi|)-m}. Under round-to-nearest, a gradient step leaves wi unchanged whenever |Δwi| < 1/2 ULP_m(wi). This gives a per-coordinate freeze condition and leads to a measurable frozen fraction f, defined as the proportion of coordinates that remain bitwise unchanged after a step. The freeze time τ* is the first step where f reaches 1/2.

The key theoretical move is to rewrite the condition in dimensionless form as ρ_i < 2^{-φ_i}, where φ_i is the fractional part of log2|wi| and indicates where the weight lies within its binade. If φ_i is approximately equidistributed, the half-ULP boundary occupies a one-bit-wide band, whose median yields a parameter-free threshold ρ*=1/sqrt(2). This explains why the onset is an O(1) crossover rather than a sharp size-dependent phase transition.

The predictor is deliberately simple. Run one fp64 trajectory {w_t, g_t}. For any target mantissa length m, compute the predicted frozen fraction at each step as \hat f_t(m)=<1[η|g_{t,i}| < 1/2 ULP_m(w_{t,i})]>. The predicted τ* is where \hat f_t crosses 1/2. Since the predictor uses no low-precision data, successful prediction would imply that the phenomenon is governed primarily by arithmetic discretization rather than by altered low-precision dynamics.

The experimental design separates arithmetic effects cleanly. Real bf16 hardware establishes that the freeze is physically present. A mantissa-truncation emulator performs all arithmetic in fp64 but rounds weights to an m-bit grid after each step, allowing controlled sweeps over mantissa precision without confounding exponent range or denormals. The paper also emphasizes an important practical nuance: in multilayer networks, a single pooled L2-based ρ can become misleading because layers live at different scales and tiny bias vectors may never freeze. Layerwise or coordinatewise statistics are therefore more informative than a single global scalar.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical story is built in stages.

First, in frozen-feature linear gradient descent on real bf16 hardware, the frozen fraction is 0 at step 100 and 1.0 by step 300, after which the iterate remains frozen for the final 90% of training. Reading the threshold at the first fully frozen point gives ρ*≈0.72.

Second, the mantissa-truncation emulator is validated against real bf16 at m=7, reproducing the freeze curve with RMSE 0.002. Sweeping m in {5,6,7,8,10,12} spans a 128x precision range, and varying the learning rate spans another 4x. Across this grid, the threshold remains stable at ρ*=0.71 with coefficient of variation 0.06. The main point is that precision and learning rate shift the freeze time substantially, but not the threshold itself.

Third, the a-priori prediction of freeze time is the strongest result in the paper. Using only the high-precision trajectory and the target mantissa length, predicted and measured τ* agree across a 384x range of freeze times, from 11 to 4222 steps. On 55 clean trainable-network cells, the median predicted/measured ratio is 1.00, and about 94.5% of cells fall within 15%. The predictor also tracks trajectory-specific outliers rather than only average trends.

Fourth, the phenomenon survives beyond convex toy settings. In a two-layer trainable tanh teacher-student regression problem, the emulator matches real bf16 with RMSE 0.007 and the threshold is around ρ*≈0.74. In a CNN with about 1e5 parameters trained on MNIST with cross-entropy, the emulator sweep over m in {5,6,7,8,10} and 3 seeds yields exact freeze-step prediction in all 15 precision-seed cells: median ratio 1.000 and maximum error 0%. On real bf16 hardware at m=7, the emulator still matches the freeze curve with RMSE 0.02.

Finally, the paper extends the observation to a 124M GPT-2 transformer with weights constrained to an 8-bit floating-point grid after each step. The full numerical details are not included in the excerpt here, but the inclusion of this experiment is important: the authors are not claiming a toy-only effect. They are arguing that the same arithmetic mechanism appears in standard Transformer training as well.

The numbers worth retaining are the threshold range 0.71–0.74, the median prediction ratio of 1.00, and the 384x span of accurately predicted freeze times.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in three passes: definition, predictor, generalization.

Start with the opening part of Results where the paper derives the half-ULP condition and rewrites it in terms of ρ and φ. That section determines whether the work is merely empirical or whether it truly pins the effect on floating-point arithmetic. Then inspect Figure 1 carefully: the real-bf16 versus emulator freeze curves, and the predicted-versus-measured freeze times. If those plots are convincing, the main claim is already in good shape.

Next, go to the Methods section for the derivation of ρ*=1/sqrt(2). The important question is not the algebra itself, but why a parameter-free threshold emerges and how credible the equidistributed-φ assumption is in practice. This is also where one should think about whether different parameter classes in large models, such as embeddings, norms, and biases, might violate the assumption.

Then read the trainable tanh and CNN sections. They answer the obvious objection that the effect might only hold in linear or frozen-feature settings. The CNN discussion is especially useful because it shows why a single pooled ρ can fail in multilayer models with heterogeneous scales. That point is highly relevant for real LLM monitoring.

If time is limited, at least read the GPT-2 setup and the main figure around it. The practical questions to keep in mind are: how weights are projected to the low-precision grid, whether AdamW plus cosine is still used, and at what stage of training the freeze appears. Natural follow-up questions are whether fp32 master weights largely remove the issue, whether Adam moments merely delay rather than eliminate freezing, and whether cooldown, weight decay, or norm control can keep ρ away from the danger zone.

A full careful read is about 45 to 60 minutes. A fast read focused on the main claim can be done in about 20 minutes via Results, Figure 1, and the Transformer experiment.

recommendation.zh: 直接改变对低精度训练稳定性的认知，应立刻在内部 fp8/bf16 训练配方中加入半 ULP 冻结检查。
recommendation.en: This changes the prior on low-precision training stability; add the half-ULP freeze check to internal fp8/bf16 training recipes immediately.

paper.title: Learning in Curved Weight Space:Exponential-Linear Weight Reparameterization for Improved Optimization
paper.abstract: Many neural networks operations have a multiplicative nature rather than additive: halving or doubling a norm are analogous relatively but require unequal optimization distances when taking linear steps. Adaptive optimizers such as Adam normalize updates per coordinate, but update steps remain additive; weights with very different magnitudes receive similarly sized absolute changes, producing very different relative perturbations. We introduce \textbf{\method} (\textbf{\methodshort}), a weight r

summary.core_problem: 研究普通线性权重空间中的加性更新是否不适合具有乘性尺度结构的神经网络参数优化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是优化参数化改进。它不直接针对 LLM 预训练，但触及大模型训练里长期存在的尺度敏感性、相对更新幅度和优化稳定性问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Exponential-Linear Weight Reparameterization，将原始权重通过两条路径映射到有效权重：一条是符号感知的对称指数路径，使大幅值权重获得近似按比例的扰动；另一条是接近恒等的线性路径，用来保留直接优化通道并降低不稳定风险。方法属于权重重参数化，而不是新优化器。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、任务、训练数据和提升幅度。需要查看正文确认是否覆盖 Transformer、语言建模或大规模训练设置；若只在小型视觉/MLP 上验证，对 LLM 预训练的外推价值有限。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether additive updates in linear weight space are a poor fit for neural networks whose useful parameter changes are often multiplicative in scale.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an optimization-side reparameterization. It is not LLM-specific, but it touches scale sensitivity, relative update size, and stability issues that matter in large-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes an Exponential-Linear Weight Reparameterization with two pathways: a sign-aware symmetric exponential path that turns additive raw-weight updates into roughly magnitude-proportional effective-weight changes, and an identity-like linear path intended to preserve a stable direct route through the transform. This is a parameterization change rather than a new optimizer.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or effect sizes. The key thing to check in the full paper is whether the evidence includes Transformers or language modeling; results limited to small MLP/CV setups would be weak evidence for pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 可扫方法和消融；若没有 Transformer/LM 实验，就只把它当相对更新参数化的备查想法。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations; without Transformer or LM experiments, treat it as a reference idea for relative-update parameterization.

paper.title: AutoNorm: Understanding Adaptive Normalization in Transformers through Differentiable Gating
paper.abstract: Normalization is a critical component for stabilizing Transformer training, yet the choice between static strategies such as Layer Normalization (LN) and adaptive alternatives remains largely task-dependent. In this paper, we investigate a key optimization challenge in differentiable normalization gating. Our experiments show that, on relatively stationary vision tasks, the high gradient variance introduced by Gumbel-Softmax gating can hinder convergence of the routing mechanism, causing learned

summary.core_problem: 如何在 Transformer 中用可微的“归一化路由/选择”机制（在 LN 与 DyT 等候选归一化之间按层自适应切换）稳定训练，并解释为什么同一套 gating 在语言任务上有效、在相对平稳的视觉任务上却会失效。
summary.importance: 对预训练的直接价值在于“训练稳定性与训练动态”的一类具体机制：可微结构选择（Gumbel-Softmax gating）在不同数据非平稳性条件下会出现完全不同的优化行为。论文把失败归因到早期高梯度方差导致 selector 无法及时专化，并给出一个工程上可落地的稳定化策略（gate-freezing schedule）。这类结论对大规模预训练里引入可学习路由（MoE、可学习算子选择、可学习归一化/激活）时的 recipe 设计有参考意义，但方法本身更偏“组件级改造”，影响量级取决于是否真的需要在线自适应归一化。
summary.technical_approach:
方法主线是 AutoNorm：在每一层把归一化从“固定 LN”改为“在 LN 与 DyT 之间做可学习混合/选择”。权重由一个轻量 NormSelector 预测，并用 Gumbel–Softmax 重参数化实现近似离散路由，从而可以端到端反传优化。

全文的关键不是“又一个可学习混合”，而是对失败模式的定位：在输入分布较平稳（stationary）的任务上，训练早期 backbone 表征尚未成形，selector 的梯度方差又很高，导致 gating 分布难以收敛到稳定偏好，最终学到的路由甚至不如随机选择；而在语言建模/分类这类更非平稳的设置里，gating 多样性可以持续存在更久，反而给 selector 足够时间在表征成熟后形成有效的层级策略。

对应的改进是 AutoNorm-S：引入 gate-freezing schedule（按训练阶段冻结/放开 gate 或其温度/采样噪声的控制），核心目的是降低早期 selector 的优化噪声，让 backbone 先进入“可分辨”的表征区间，再让路由专化。论文也把“非平稳性”操作化为训练过程中激活统计的跨 batch 变化、以及 gating 分布熵的坍缩速度等可观测信号，用来解释何时 adaptive normalization 更可能带来收益。
summary.experiments:
从全文描述看，实验围绕三点展开：
1) 复现与对比：AutoNorm（Gumbel-Softmax gating）在视觉基准上出现 selector 学不好、性能不如 Random Selector 的反直觉现象；在语言建模/分类任务上则能学到更好的层级归一化策略。
2) 机制验证：用梯度方差、gating 熵/多样性随训练演化等指标，展示“平稳数据 + 早期高方差”会阻碍路由专化。
3) 修复效果：AutoNorm-S 通过 gate-freezing 恢复视觉任务上的竞争力，并在 NLP 上提供额外 inductive bias。

你给到的全文片段未包含表格与具体数值（模型规模、数据规模、提升幅度），因此无法可靠摘录精确数字；若需要数字级结论，需要补充 Table/Figure 所在页或 PDF。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“视觉失败、语言成功”的现象描述，明确论文要解释的是优化动力学而不是归一化公式本身。
- 重点看 Methodology 中对“non-stationarity”的定义与可观测量（激活统计变化、gating 熵坍缩），这是全文论证链条的支点。
- 直接跳到 AutoNorm-S 的 gate-freezing 细节（训练日程如何设、冻结哪些参数/温度），这是最可迁移的工程经验。
- 最后看实验里 Random Selector vs learned gating 的对照，以及与 SwitchNorm / DyT / LN 的对比设置，确认收益是否来自“路由”而非单一归一化更强。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make differentiable normalization routing in Transformers train reliably—i.e., learning per-layer policies to switch between LN and alternatives like DyT—and why the same Gumbel-Softmax gating works on language tasks but fails on relatively stationary vision tasks.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a training-dynamics explanation for differentiable architectural selection: with stationary inputs, early-stage high gradient variance in Gumbel-Softmax gating prevents the selector from specializing before backbone features mature, so learned routing can underperform even random selection. The proposed stabilization (a gate-freezing schedule) is a practical recipe that may generalize to other learnable routing components used in pretraining (e.g., operator selection, conditional computation). The impact is component-level rather than a new pretraining paradigm, but the failure-mode analysis is the part worth keeping.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AutoNorm replaces a fixed normalization (typically LN) with a learnable mixture/selection between LN and DyT at each Transformer layer. A lightweight NormSelector predicts mixture weights, trained end-to-end via a Gumbel–Softmax reparameterization to approximate discrete routing.

The paper’s technical core is the diagnosis of when this routing is learnable: on stationary datasets, the selector sees high-variance gradients early on while representations are still unstable, so the gating distribution does not collapse into meaningful preferences; on non-stationary language modeling/classification, sustained gating diversity persists long enough for the selector to discover useful layer-wise policies after representations become informative.

AutoNorm-S addresses this with a gate-freezing schedule (and related control of gating noise/temperature): reduce selector degrees of freedom early to let the backbone settle, then re-enable routing to allow specialization. The work also operationalizes “non-stationarity” using measurable signals such as batch-to-batch activation-statistics variability and the entropy-collapse rate of the gating distribution.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental story has three pillars:
1) Phenomenon: differentiable Gumbel-Softmax gating learns effective normalization policies on language tasks but can fail on vision benchmarks, where a Random Selector may outperform the learned gates.
2) Mechanism: tracking gradient-variance and gating-entropy dynamics supports the claim that early high-variance gradients block specialization under stationary inputs.
3) Fix: AutoNorm-S (gate-freezing) restores competitive performance on vision and provides an inductive bias on NLP.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the tables/figures with exact numbers (model sizes, data sizes, deltas), so I cannot quote reliable numeric improvements without the missing pages.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the Introduction for the key empirical anomaly (vision failure vs language success) and the hypothesis about optimization dynamics.
- Focus on the Methodology section where non-stationarity is defined and measured; this is the backbone of the argument.
- Jump to the AutoNorm-S gate-freezing schedule details; this is the most transferable training recipe.
- Check the main ablations comparing learned gating vs random selection and against LN/DyT/SwitchNorm baselines to ensure the gains are truly from routing rather than a stronger single normalization.

recommendation.zh: 自适应归一化的跨任务优化差异分析有参考价值，重点看梯度方差与门控收敛的关联实验，可纳入预训练归一化消融备选。
recommendation.en: The cross-task optimization analysis of adaptive normalization is informative; focus on experiments linking gradient variance to gating convergence, worth considering for pretraining normalization ablations.

paper.title: ARMOR: Stabilizing On-Policy LLM RL with Off-Policy Anchor Samples
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has significantly enhanced the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet the training process remains notoriously fragile. In this work, we investigate a critical source of this instability: over-optimization, where models exploit training heuristics at the expense of generalizable reasoning. While reverse KL regularization is the standard defense against such degradation, our analysis reveals that it is often insufficient in this regime, as it fails

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文聚焦一个现在很实际的问题：LLM 在 on-policy RL，尤其是 reasoning RL 里，经常出现“训练 reward 持续上升，但验证集性能先停滞再下降”的过优化现象。作者认为这不是传统意义上 reward model 错了，而是在可验证奖励下，策略仍会收缩到少数训练集上高回报但泛化差的解题模式。标准 reverse KL 常被当作稳定器，但论文指出它在这里有两个根本缺陷：一是 mode-seeking，保不住参考策略分布中的多样性；二是惩罚过于均匀，会压制探索，导致训练后期改进停滞。
summary.importance: 对 pretrain 研究者，这篇工作的价值不在于提出全新 RL 范式，而在于把 reasoning RL 的一个核心失稳机制讲得比较清楚，并给出一个很工程化、也较容易接入现有 GRPO/DAPO 流水线的修正方案。它的重要性主要体现在三点。第一，它把“稳定优化”和“稳定泛化”区分开来，提醒大家不能只看 reward curve。第二，它对 reverse KL 在 LLM RL 中的局限给出了更具体的分布层面解释，这对后续设计 trust region、reference anchoring、mixed-policy sampling 都有参考价值。第三，它提出用 off-policy anchor samples 主动维持参考分布覆盖，而不是被动靠 KL 惩罚，这个思路对 RLHF、reasoning RL，甚至 continual post-training 都可能有迁移价值。
summary.technical_approach:
ARMOR 包含两个核心部件。

第一是 Anchor Rollout。标准 on-policy RL 只从当前策略采样，容易让训练数据分布快速跟着策略一起收缩，最终强化某些 shortcut reasoning pattern。作者的做法是在 rollout 阶段主动混入来自 reference policy 的 off-policy 样本，把这些样本当作“锚点”。这样做的目的不是简单增加数据量，而是显式保留参考策略中已经存在、且更可能具有泛化性的解题模式。和 reverse KL 的区别在于，KL 只是对偏离参考分布施加损失约束，但并不保证训练时真的看到参考分布的代表性样本；Anchor Rollout 则直接把这些样本放回训练流里，属于从数据分布层面做稳定化。

第二是 Mixed Optimization。作者不再把 KL 当作附加惩罚项，而是直接优化一个混合策略 α·πθ + (1-α)·πref。直觉上，这相当于把优化目标和采样分布更紧地绑在一起，构造一个自适应 trust region：当当前策略已经比参考策略更好时，仍允许向外探索；但由于混合分布始终保留一部分参考策略质量，训练不会像纯 on-policy 那样迅速坍缩到狭窄模式。作者认为这同时解决了 reverse KL 的两个问题：Anchor Rollout 缓解 instability，Mixed Optimization 缓解 stagnation。

从正文可见，论文是在 GRPO/DAPO 语境下展开分析。作者先回顾 GRPO 的 clipped objective 和 loss-level reverse KL，再引入 DAPO 作为主要 baseline，因为 DAPO 去掉 KL 后更容易暴露过优化问题。ARMOR 的设计因此不是替代整个 RL 框架，而是作为一个可插拔层，作用在采样和优化目标两端。这个定位很重要：它解释了为什么方法能跨 base model 和 RL algorithm 迁移。
summary.experiments:
从已给出的正文，实验覆盖不同 base model，包括 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 和 Qwen3-8B-Base，也覆盖不同 RL 算法，包括 DAPO 和 QAE。主结论是 ARMOR 能显著缩小 reward-validation gap：训练 reward 继续上升的同时，验证性能不再像 baseline 那样提前掉头，而是能维持更长时间的稳定增长。作者把这称为 prolonged training stability 和 continuous performance gains。

虽然当前截取内容没有完整表格数字，但有几个实验点已经很明确。第一，作者专门比较了带 reverse KL 的方法与 ARMOR，结论是单纯 reverse KL 不能阻止策略塌缩到少数 shortcut 模式。第二，ARMOR 在不同模型和不同 RL 算法上都有效，说明它不是某个特定实现细节带来的偶然收益。第三，论文应当包含对两个组件的消融：只加 Anchor Rollout、只做 Mixed Optimization、两者同时使用。阅读时需要重点确认这部分，因为方法主张正是两个组件分别对应 instability 和 stagnation 两类失败模式。

如果从研究判断上看，最关键的实验不是最终 benchmark 分数，而是训练过程曲线、分布覆盖分析、以及 reference/policy 样本多样性的可视化。因为这篇论文的核心论点是“reverse KL 没有真正保住参考分布覆盖”，所以任何支持这一点的统计证据都比单点成绩更重要。当前可见信息不足以复述完整数字，需以正文图表为准。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读偏精一点。先看 Introduction 和 Fig.1、Fig.2，确认作者定义的 failure mode 是什么，以及为什么把问题归因于 over-optimization 而不是 reward mismatch。然后看 Preliminaries 里对 GRPO、DAPO、reverse KL 两种 estimator 的回顾，尤其要弄清作者批评的是 reverse KL 的分布性质，不只是某个 estimator 方差大。方法部分重点看 Anchor Rollout 和 Mixed Optimization 的公式定义、采样流程、以及 α 的设定方式。实验部分优先看训练曲线和消融，而不是只看最终榜单。预计 40 分钟左右能抓住主要思想；如果要判断是否值得复现，再补看附录里的超参、采样比例、reference policy 更新方式和 off-policy 样本混入细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode that has become common in reasoning-oriented LLM RL: training reward keeps improving, yet validation performance plateaus or degrades. The authors frame this as over-optimization rather than classical reward hacking. Even with verifiable rewards, the policy can still overfit to narrow solution patterns that score well on seen data but generalize poorly. Their main claim is that standard reverse-KL regularization is not enough in this regime because it is mode-seeking and does not preserve adequate coverage of the reference distribution, while also suppressing useful exploration.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and post-training researchers, the value here is not a brand-new RL paradigm but a clearer diagnosis of why on-policy reasoning RL becomes brittle. The paper separates stable optimization from stable generalization, which is an important practical distinction: a smooth reward curve can hide policy collapse. It also gives a more concrete distributional critique of reverse KL in LLM RL, which is relevant for future work on trust-region design, reference anchoring, and mixed-policy training. Finally, the proposed fix is fairly modular, so the idea may transfer beyond the exact setup here to RLHF, reasoning RL, and potentially continual post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ARMOR has two main components.

The first is Anchor Rollout. In standard on-policy RL, rollouts come only from the current policy, so the training distribution can quickly collapse together with the policy itself. This reinforces a small set of shortcut reasoning patterns. ARMOR injects off-policy samples from the reference policy during rollout and treats them as anchors. The point is not merely to add more data, but to explicitly preserve solution modes already present in the reference distribution, which are more likely to be broad and generalizable. This differs from reverse KL in an important way: KL penalizes deviation from the reference, but it does not guarantee that representative reference samples are actually present in the training stream. Anchor Rollout stabilizes the process at the data-distribution level.

The second is Mixed Optimization. Instead of adding KL as an auxiliary penalty, the method directly optimizes a mixed policy, alpha times the current policy plus one minus alpha times the reference policy. The intended effect is an adaptive trust region. The current policy is still allowed to explore beyond the reference when it finds better reasoning paths, but the optimization target never fully discards the reference distribution. According to the authors, this addresses both failure modes of reverse KL: Anchor Rollout mitigates instability from mode collapse, while Mixed Optimization mitigates stagnation from overly uniform regularization.

The paper develops the method in the GRPO and DAPO setting. It reviews GRPO’s clipped objective and loss-level reverse KL, then uses DAPO as a primary baseline because DAPO without KL makes over-optimization easier to expose. ARMOR is therefore positioned as a plug-in layer on top of existing RL pipelines, modifying both rollout generation and the optimization target rather than replacing the whole algorithm.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full-text excerpt, experiments cover multiple base models, including Qwen2.5-Math-7B and Qwen3-8B-Base, and multiple RL algorithms, including DAPO and QAE. The main empirical claim is that ARMOR narrows the reward-validation gap: training reward continues to improve, while validation performance remains stable for longer and keeps increasing instead of turning downward early as in the baseline.

Although the excerpt does not include the full result tables, several conclusions are already clear. First, the paper explicitly compares reverse-KL-based stabilization against ARMOR and argues that reverse KL alone does not prevent collapse onto shortcut modes. Second, the gains appear across different models and RL algorithms, which suggests the method is not tied to one specific implementation detail. Third, the paper should contain component ablations for Anchor Rollout alone, Mixed Optimization alone, and the full combination. Those ablations are central, because the method’s conceptual claim is that the two components address two different failure modes: instability and stagnation.

For judging the paper, the most important evidence is not the final benchmark score but the training dynamics, coverage analysis, and any visualization of policy versus reference diversity. The core argument is that reverse KL does not truly preserve reference-distribution coverage, so any statistics supporting that claim matter more than a single endpoint metric. The exact numbers are not fully visible in the provided excerpt and should be checked in the main figures and tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is worth a careful skim. Start with the introduction and the first two figures to understand the claimed failure mode and why the authors attribute it to over-optimization rather than reward mismatch. Then read the preliminaries on GRPO, DAPO, and the two reverse-KL estimators. The important point is that the critique is about the distributional behavior of reverse KL, not just estimator variance. In the method section, focus on the formal definitions of Anchor Rollout and Mixed Optimization, the rollout procedure, and how alpha is chosen. In the experiments, prioritize training curves and ablations over final leaderboard numbers. Around 40 minutes should be enough to extract the main idea. If you are considering reproduction, then check the appendix for hyperparameters, anchor-sample mixing ratios, reference-policy handling, and other rollout details.

recommendation.zh: Reverse KL失效机制的分析有价值，重点看§2的问题拆解，锚定样本的思路可复现到内部RL训练消融中
recommendation.en: The analysis of reverse KL insufficiency in LLM RL is insightful; check §2 failure mode and anchor rollout design for internal RL training ablations.
