方法上，SDPG 建立在 KL-regularized policy optimization 框架上，目标里有三类信号。第一类是标准 RLVR 的 outcome reward。它沿用 group-based rollout，并用 group-relative advantage；文中还强调用 normalized standard deviation 处理组内 reward 归一化，缓解 reward 方差和全 0/全 1 组带来的不稳定。第二类是 privileged on-policy self-distillation：同一个模型分成两个分支，student 用可部署上下文生成，teacher 看到额外特权信息，例如 demonstration、答案或 reasoning path。关键不是只加一个 KL，而是使用 exact full-vocabulary reverse KL，形式是 D_KL(p_t || SG[q_t])，其中 q_t 停梯度。作者证明，对固定 rollout prefix，这个 reverse KL 的 student-side gradient 与一个 detached-sampling policy-gradient update 局部等价，其 token advantage 可以写成 centered log teacher/student ratio，也就是以 log(q/p) 为核心、再减去对应分布级 KL 均值做中心化。这个推导的意义在于：蒸馏不再只是“模仿 teacher”，而是可以看成对每个 token 的 advantage shaping。第三类是 reference-policy KL regularization。作者采用基于 RPG 的 KL 正则化形式，主文聚焦未归一化 forward / reverse KL 到固定 reference policy，用来限制策略漂移，避免 privileged teacher 和 verifier 共同驱动下的更新过猛。

在稳定性设计上，SDPG 有两个明确的工程控制件。其一是 positive-advantage gating：只在 verifier advantage 为正时启用或强化 distillation 信号，避免 teacher 在负样本轨迹上继续灌输局部模式。其二是 warmup-decay schedule：蒸馏系数先升后降，前期帮助模型获得稠密学习信号，后期逐步让 verifier 主导，减少 teacher ceiling 对 student 探索空间的压制。和 RLSD 这类把 teacher 信号揉进 clipped ratio 的方法相比，SDPG 更强调把蒸馏项作为一个精确、全词表、可解释的辅助 policy-gradient 信号，而不是仅仅作为 PPO/GRPO surrogate 的修饰项。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的实验设置看，作者主要比较了三类基线：纯 RLVR/GRPO 类方法、已有 self-distillation 类方法，以及带不同正则和稳定器的 SDPG 变体。结论层面比较清楚：SDPG 在性能和训练稳定性上都优于 RLVR 与自蒸馏基线，尤其是在早期训练阶段负 advantage 较多、reward 稀疏时更稳。论文强调的收益不是单点峰值，而是更平滑的 learning curve、更少的 collapse/震荡，以及更高的最终 verifier pass rate。

更值得看的是消融。第一，exact full-vocabulary reverse KL 明显优于只在 sampled token 上做近似蒸馏，说明 teacher 分布的“暗知识”在 reasoning token 选择上确实有用。第二，去掉 positive-advantage gating 后，训练会更容易受错误 teacher signal 干扰，尤其在全局错误轨迹上出现性能回退。第三，去掉 warmup-decay schedule，或者让蒸馏系数始终偏大，student 的上限会被 teacher 束缚，验证了文中对“强 teacher 信号抑制潜力”的判断。第四，reference-policy KL 仍然重要；没有它时，蒸馏和 reward 双重驱动会放大策略漂移，稳定性变差。

你给出的全文片段没有包含完整结果表和具体模型规模、数据规模、任务数字，因此无法可靠填写精确参数量、样本量和绝对提升幅度。若要补齐数字，优先查主实验表、ablation 表以及 appendix 中的 training config。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，但不要只看摘要。建议先看 Introduction 里关于 self-distillation 的 policy-gradient 解释，那是全文最有信息量的部分，决定了这篇工作的价值不只是“又一个 RL trick”。然后看方法章节里 reverse KL 梯度恒等式的推导，重点确认三件事：为什么是 reverse KL 而不是 forward KL；为什么 teacher 分支要 stop-gradient；centered log-ratio advantage 是怎么来的。接着看 objective 设计，弄清 verifier reward、distillation、reference KL 三项各自扮演什么角色。实验部分优先看稳定性曲线和消融，不必过度纠结主表排名。真正值得深挖的是两个问题：一是 privileged context 的质量如何影响 token-level advantage 的偏差；二是 positive-advantage gating 会不会让模型错过“从失败轨迹中学局部正确模式”的机会。预计 30–45 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读；若要复现或迁移到 reasoning RL pipeline，再读 appendix 的正则形式和实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific tension in RL with verifiable rewards: the verifier provides sparse sequence-level supervision, while reasoning models benefit from dense token-level learning signals. Prior on-policy self-distillation methods use the same model with privileged context as a teacher, but they are often treated as heuristic auxiliary losses, without a clean policy-gradient interpretation. They also risk reinforcing locally plausible tokens on globally wrong trajectories when the teacher signal is imperfect. SDPG asks how to integrate full-vocabulary self-distillation into KL-regularized RLVR in a principled way, so that sparse verifier rewards and dense privileged supervision can work together without destabilizing training.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–post-train interface because it turns self-distillation from a practical trick into an analyzable RL objective. Its value is threefold. First, it gives full-vocabulary reverse-KL self-distillation an exact local policy-gradient interpretation, which clarifies why it can compensate for sparse rewards. Second, it makes the failure mode explicit: privileged context is not automatically beneficial, and without verifier constraints it can amplify token-level preferences on globally incorrect rollouts. Third, the proposed gating and coefficient schedule are really mechanisms for controlling training-signal quality, which is useful beyond RLVR and may transfer to synthetic supervision, process supervision, or mid-training settings. The contribution is best understood as making a class of methods more interpretable and more stable, rather than introducing a new paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SDPG is built on a KL-regularized policy optimization framework with three supervision sources. The first is the standard RLVR outcome reward. It uses group-based rollouts and group-relative advantages, with normalized standard deviation to stabilize reward normalization under low-variance groups. The second is privileged on-policy self-distillation. The same model is split into two branches: the deployable student conditions on the normal context, while the teacher sees extra privileged information such as demonstrations, direct answers, or reasoning traces. The key choice is to use the exact full-vocabulary reverse KL, D_KL(p_t || SG[q_t]), where the teacher branch is stop-grad. The paper shows that, for a fixed rollout prefix, the student-side gradient of this reverse KL is locally identical to a detached-sampling policy-gradient update whose token-level advantage is a centered log teacher/student ratio. This matters because the distillation term is no longer just imitation; it becomes an advantage-shaping signal over the full vocabulary. The third component is reference-policy KL regularization. Following the RPG view, the main text uses unnormalized forward and reverse KL terms to a fixed reference policy to control policy drift under the combined pressure of verifier rewards and privileged distillation.

Two stabilizers are central. Positive-advantage gating activates or strengthens the distillation signal only when the verifier-side advantage is positive, reducing the chance that the teacher reinforces bad trajectories. A warmup-decay schedule for the distillation coefficient gives dense guidance early, then gradually hands control back to the verifier objective later, limiting teacher-induced ceiling effects. Compared with methods such as RLSD, which fold teacher information into a clipped ratio objective, SDPG treats distillation as an exact, full-vocabulary, interpretable auxiliary policy-gradient signal.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental section compares SDPG against three families of baselines: pure RLVR/GRPO-style methods, prior self-distillation methods, and SDPG variants with different regularization and stabilization choices. The main conclusion is consistent: SDPG improves both final performance and training stability over RLVR and self-distillation baselines, with the largest gains appearing in the early phase where rewards are sparse and negative advantages are common. The benefit is not only a better endpoint but also smoother learning curves and fewer collapses or oscillations.

The ablations are more informative than the headline result. Exact full-vocabulary reverse KL outperforms sampled-token approximations, suggesting that the teacher distribution carries useful dark knowledge for reasoning token selection. Removing positive-advantage gating makes training more vulnerable to noisy teacher guidance, especially on globally incorrect trajectories. Removing the warmup-decay schedule, or keeping the distillation coefficient too large throughout training, suppresses the student’s eventual potential, matching the paper’s claim that overly strong teacher signals can hurt exploration and final capability. Reference-policy KL also remains important; without it, the combination of reward and distillation leads to larger policy drift and worse stability.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the final result tables or reliable numeric details such as model size, data scale, or exact improvement margins, so those should not be fabricated. To recover the numbers, the main result tables, ablation tables, and appendix training configurations are the places to check.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but it is worth reading beyond the abstract. Start with the introduction’s policy-gradient interpretation of self-distillation; that is the conceptual center of the work. Then read the method section around the reverse-KL gradient identity and verify three points: why reverse KL is used instead of forward KL, why the teacher branch is stop-grad, and how the centered log-ratio advantage emerges. After that, read the objective carefully to separate the roles of verifier reward, distillation, and reference KL. In the experiments, prioritize stability plots and ablations over the main benchmark table. The two questions worth thinking about are how privileged-context quality affects token-level advantage bias, and whether positive-advantage gating sacrifices useful local learning signals from failed trajectories. A solid skim should take about 30 to 45 minutes; appendix details matter only if you want to reproduce or adapt the method.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得从 loss 设计角度细看：把 privileged-context self-distill 写成精确 reverse-KL 很干净，建议直接复现其 ablation，看是否真能稳住 RLVR。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the loss design alone: casting privileged-context self-distillation as exact reverse-KL is unusually clean; I’d reproduce the ablations to see if it genuinely stabilizes RLVR.

paper.title: GNMR: Runtime Stability Control for Low-Precision Large Language Model Training
paper.abstract: Training stability is a key bottleneck in low-precision language model training: efficient low-cost paths can still produce short-lived numerical risks at a small set of operators. We formulate this as runtime stability control and present Gradient Norm-to-Mean Ratio (GNMR), a lightweight controller that compares each recoverable unit's current gradient norm with its historical mean. Together with $Δ$-GNMR for abrupt short-window increases, GNMR maps local risk signals to bounded recovery action

summary.core_problem: GNMR 解决的是低精度 LLM 训练中的运行时稳定性控制问题。现有 FP8、FP4、activation quantization、优化器状态压缩等方案通常把精度选择当成静态 recipe 或离线校准问题，但训练中的不稳定往往是局部、短暂、非平稳的：某个 attention 或 FFN 算子可能只在少数 step 出现梯度或激活异常，其他层仍然安全。该工作要回答的是：在已有低成本路径和高保真恢复路径之间，训练系统如何在线判断哪些局部单元需要临时回退到高精度，并且把额外开销限制在固定预算内。
summary.importance: 这对预训练研究有直接价值。低精度训练的主要难点不只是平均误差，而是少数局部异常是否会触发 loss spike、梯度异常或长期质量损失。GNMR 的贡献在于把低精度稳定性从“选一种格式和一套 recipe”推进到“在线闭环控制”：每一步监控局部风险，只恢复少数高风险算子，并显式控制恢复预算。它不声称发明新的低比特格式或新 kernel，而是把控制策略与后端实现解耦。这一点对大规模预训练很实用，因为真实训练栈经常混合 FP8、BF16、activation compression、optimizer compression 和不同 kernel；稳定性控制需要能嵌入这些栈，而不是绑定某个特定硬件路径。
summary.technical_approach: 核心信号是 Gradient Norm-to-Mean Ratio。对每个可低精度执行的局部单元，例如 attention、FFN 中的 fc1/fc2 等算子，GNMR 比较当前梯度范数与该单元历史均值，得到一个无量纲、可跨模块比较的风险分数。为捕捉短时间突变，作者又引入 Δ-GNMR，用短窗口统计对 GNMR 做归一化，强调相对近期行为的突然偏离。控制策略分三层：第一，逐 step 计算 operator-wise 风险；第二，在候选单元中按风险排序，只选择 top-risk 单元；第三，用 maxO 限制当前 step 可恢复单元数量，并用 Tlock 让恢复状态持续几个 step，避免频繁切换造成 thrashing。被选中的单元从低精度路径切到高保真路径，其他单元继续走低成本路径。论文还给出一步 expected-descent 分析，说明当低精度扰动在关键更新上放大时，选择性恢复可以减少对下降方向的破坏；这不是全局保守保护，而是把高精度预算用在当前最可能影响训练稳定性的局部位置。
summary.experiments: 实验设计分为三类。第一类是 controlled activation-quantization stress bench，用来单独评估触发信号质量和局部风险识别能力，避免被完整系统的 kernel、格式和调度差异混淆。第二类是在 Transformer Engine 支持的低精度训练设置中验证 recipe-level 集成，观察 GNMR 是否能在真实低精度路径下维持质量并控制开销。第三类是 large-model post-training task，用来检查该控制器在较大模型适配场景中的质量保持和工程成本。引言明确说实验考察 trigger quality、budget behavior、quality preservation 和 engineering overhead。给定内容没有提供具体模型规模、训练 token 数、loss 曲线数值、恢复比例、吞吐损失或下游指标，因此不能给出精确提升幅度。精读时需要核对实验表格中三个问题：GNMR 相比全局梯度范数、loss spike 后验检测、静态 fallback 的提前预警能力；maxO 和 Tlock 对稳定性与吞吐的折中；在 TE-backed setting 中是否只带来小幅开销而能显著减少 spike 或质量退化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先读 Introduction 的 L1–L4，它准确界定了低精度训练稳定性为什么是运行时控制问题，而不是单纯的格式选择问题。然后看 Preliminary 和 Method 部分，重点关注 operator-wise unit 的定义、GNMR 与 Δ-GNMR 的统计更新方式、历史均值和短窗口的时间尺度、maxO/Tlock 的策略细节。理论部分主要看 expected-descent 分析中如何建模低精度扰动与选择性恢复。实验部分重点看三组证据：stress bench 的触发准确性，TE 低精度训练中的质量与吞吐，large-model post-training 的可迁移性。最值得深挖的是阈值与预算如何随模型规模、batch size、学习率阶段和 loss spike 位置变化；这决定了它能否从 post-training 扩展到长周期 pretraining。

summary_en.core_problem: GNMR addresses runtime stability control for low-precision LLM training. Existing FP8, FP4, activation-quantization, and compressed-state recipes often treat precision as a mostly static configuration or an offline calibration choice. In practice, instability is local and transient: a specific attention or FFN operator may become risky for a few steps while the rest of the model remains safe. The question is how to decide online which local units should temporarily fall back to a higher-fidelity path under a fixed overhead budget.
summary_en.importance: The paper is directly relevant to pretraining systems and training dynamics. The hard part of low-precision training is not only average quantization error; it is whether rare local perturbations trigger loss spikes, gradient anomalies, or lasting quality degradation. GNMR reframes low-precision stability as closed-loop control: monitor local risk at every step, recover only a sparse subset of risky operators, and enforce an explicit budget. It does not rely on proposing a new numeric format or kernel. That separation is useful for real training stacks, where FP8, BF16, activation compression, optimizer-state compression, and backend-specific kernels are often mixed.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main signal is the Gradient Norm-to-Mean Ratio. For each eligible low-precision unit, such as attention or FFN projection operators, GNMR compares the current gradient norm with the unit’s historical mean. This gives a dimensionless local risk score that can be compared across modules. To detect abrupt short-term changes, the paper adds Δ-GNMR, which normalizes the signal by a recent window and emphasizes deviations from near-term behavior. The controller then ranks eligible units by risk, recovers only the top-risk subset, limits instantaneous overhead with maxO, and uses a short Tlock interval to prevent rapid switching. Selected units are routed through a higher-fidelity recovery path, while the rest continue on the low-cost path. The analysis gives a one-step expected-descent argument: when low-precision perturbations are large on critical updates, selective recovery reduces the error injected into the descent direction without paying the cost of global high-precision execution.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is organized around three settings. A controlled activation-quantization stress bench isolates trigger quality and local risk identification from backend effects. A Transformer Engine-backed low-precision training setup tests integration with a realistic training recipe. A large-model post-training task checks whether the controller preserves quality and keeps overhead bounded in a larger adaptation setting. The stated evaluation axes are trigger quality, budget behavior, quality preservation, and engineering overhead. The provided content does not include model sizes, token counts, loss values, recovery ratios, throughput changes, or downstream metric numbers. The key experimental questions to verify in the tables are whether GNMR gives earlier and more local warnings than global gradient norm or post-hoc loss-spike detection, how maxO and Tlock trade stability for throughput, and whether the TE-backed setting shows quality preservation with small overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully. Start with the L1–L4 requirements in the introduction; they define why low-precision stability should be treated as a runtime control problem rather than a static precision-selection problem. Then read the preliminary and method sections for the operator-wise unit definition, the GNMR and Δ-GNMR update rules, the historical and short-window timescales, and the maxO/Tlock policy. In the theory part, focus on how the expected-descent analysis models low-precision perturbation and selective recovery. In the experiments, prioritize the stress bench trigger analysis, the TE-backed training results, and the large-model post-training transfer test. The most important open point is how thresholds and recovery budgets scale with model size, batch size, learning-rate phase, and the location of loss spikes; that determines whether the method can move from post-training to long-horizon pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 低精度训练稳定性的轻量落地方案，无需修改内核或数值格式，可直接接入现有预训练流水线开展内部测试
recommendation.en: Lightweight solution for low-precision training stability, no kernel or numerical format changes required, can be directly integrated into existing pretraining pipelines for internal testing

paper.title: S-SPPO: Semantic-Calibrated Self-Play Preference Optimization
paper.abstract: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences is often formulated via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). However, the standard Bradley-Terry instantiation of DPO is limited in modeling common departures from transitivity in human preferences. To address this, recent work has introduced Self-Play Preference Optimization (SPPO), which iteratively refines the policy by training on self-generated win-lose pairs. Our investigation, however, reveals a critical instability in SPPO: th

summary.core_problem: SPPO (Self-Play Preference Optimization) 在处理语义相似但被 Reward Model 赋予极端胜率的回复对时，会产生严重的训练不稳定和策略退化问题。
summary.importance: 揭示了 Self-Play 偏好对齐方法中的一个关键缺陷（对 RM 过度自信的敏感性），并提出了一种无需额外人工标注或强模型监督即可稳定训练的校准框架，对提升 RLHF/DPO 变体的鲁棒性有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 S-SPPO 框架，包含双空间语义校准：1) 监督校准（Supervision Calibration）：通过语义门控机制，根据回复间的语义重叠度对目标胜率进行退火，降低 RM 在相似回复上的过度自信；2) 表示校准（Representation Calibration）：在隐空间引入排斥力，防止模型在生成相似回复时发生流形坍缩（mode collapse）。理论证明该方法保持了常数和博弈结构，能收敛到纳什均衡。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama-3-8B 上，S-SPPO 在 AlpacaEval 2.0 上取得了 52.19% 的胜率和 47.46% 的长度控制胜率，显著优于现有基线方法，且有效消除了标准 Self-Play 方法中观察到的性能退化现象。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中对 SPPO 失败模式的分析（图 1），以及 S-SPPO 双空间校准机制的具体实现。理论部分可略读，重点理解语义门控和隐空间排斥力如何协同工作。

summary_en.core_problem: SPPO (Self-Play Preference Optimization) suffers from severe training instability and policy degeneration when the Reward Model assigns overly confident win rates to semantically indistinguishable response pairs.
summary_en.importance: Identifies a critical flaw in self-play preference alignment methods (sensitivity to RM overconfidence) and proposes a calibration framework that stabilizes training without requiring additional human annotations or strong model supervision, offering direct insights for improving the robustness of RLHF/DPO variants.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the S-SPPO framework, featuring dual-space semantic calibration: 1) Supervision Calibration: Uses semantic gating to anneal target win rates based on semantic overlap, mitigating RM overconfidence on similar responses; 2) Representation Calibration: Introduces a repulsive force in the latent space to prevent manifold collapse when generating similar responses. Theoretically proves that this method preserves the constant-sum game structure and converges to a Nash Equilibrium.
summary_en.experiments: On Llama-3-8B, S-SPPO achieves a 52.19% win rate and a 47.46% length-controlled win rate on AlpacaEval 2.0, significantly outperforming existing baselines and effectively eliminating the performance degradation observed in standard self-play methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of SPPO's failure modes in the Introduction (Figure 1) and the specific implementation of S-SPPO's dual-space calibration mechanisms. The theoretical part can be skimmed; focus on understanding how semantic gating and latent space repulsion work together.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它抓住了偏好学习里一个常被忽略的脏点：语义近重复 pair 的过置信监督；只看退化分析和 calibration 设计就值回时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it isolates a real pathology in preference learning—overconfident supervision on near-duplicate responses; the degeneration analysis and calibration trick are the parts worth reading.

paper.title: PR2: Predictive Routing Replay for MoE-Based LLM Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Mixture of Experts (MoE) Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance at scale. However, reinforcement learning (RL) on MoE-based LLMs often suffers from training instability. A root cause is router drift, i.e., expert activations can change drastically across model updates and differ between disaggregated rollout and training phases, causing large rollout--training mismatch and unstable importance sampling weights in PPO-style RL algorithms. Routing replay mitigates this issue by fre

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 MoE LLM 做 PPO/GRPO 类强化学习时的路由不稳定问题：同一批 rollout 轨迹在训练阶段被当前模型重新计算时，token 可能被送到不同专家，导致 rollout-policy 与 training-policy 的计算路径不一致，进而放大重要性采样比率的方差。已有 routing replay 固定旧路由可以稳定比率，但会让训练长期使用过时专家路径，错过当前策略即将激活的专家，形成 router staleness。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发在于：MoE 的条件计算路径不仅是架构问题，也是训练信号问题。RL 阶段的梯度估计会被 router drift 放大，而简单冻结路由又会牺牲专家更新的新鲜度。PR2 给出了一种折中：训练时仍使用固定路由来稳定 PPO 比率，但 rollout 时提前预测短期路由演化，让缓存的专家路径更接近未来训练策略。这个思路对 MoE mid-training、continual pretrain 和任何异步 rollout/training 的大规模训练系统都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 Predictive Routing Replay。作者先把 routing replay 形式化为用一个退化的 replay measure 替代当前路由分布，并推导出 router staleness 与固定路由 PPO 梯度偏差之间的散度界。这个分析指出，稳定重要性估计需要冻结路由，但有效学习又需要路由分布跟上策略更新。PR2 因此在每个 MoE router 旁边加入轻量 evolution predictor。rollout 阶段，predictor 对 router logits 产生一个 learned logit bias，再基于偏置后的 logits 做 top-k routing，并把预测出的专家索引缓存到 trajectory 中。训练阶段，模型重放这些缓存的 top-k 专家索引，同时关闭 predictor，从而保持 PPO/GRPO 的固定计算路径。predictor 用 KL divergence 目标训练，目标是让 rollout-time 预测路由接近短期更新后的路由分布；作者还给 predictor 使用单独的 learning-rate multiplier，使其能更快适应 router 演化。PR2 不修改 policy optimization objective，可接入 VeRL、Slime、TRL 这类 MoE RL 框架。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在 MoE reasoning RL。文中报告 PR2 能降低 routing mismatch，缓解训练不稳定，并在多个 reasoning 任务上超过 routing replay、GSPO 等基线。最明确的结果是：在 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base 上使用 GRPO+PR2，AIME24 accuracy 达到 40.31%，相比 routing replay 高 12.29 个百分点，相比 GSPO 高 9.38 个百分点。作者强调计算开销很小，因为 predictor 只是在 rollout 阶段给 router logits 加轻量偏置，训练阶段仍是缓存路由重放。消融重点应是 predictor、KL 目标、learning-rate multiplier、是否预测未来路由，以及 routing mismatch 指标与最终准确率之间的关系。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 router drift 与 router staleness 的定义，明确它和 dense model PPO 不同在哪里。再看理论部分关于 replay staleness 控制 fixed-route PPO gradient deviation 的散度界，重点不是推导细节，而是它如何导出“冻结路由”和“跟踪路由演化”的折中。方法部分重点看 rollout 阶段 logit bias、top-k route caching、训练阶段关闭 predictor 的流程图。实验部分优先看 AIME24、routing mismatch、训练稳定性曲线，以及 predictor 相关消融。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a stability issue specific to RL on MoE LLMs. In PPO- or GRPO-style training, trajectories are generated by a stale rollout policy and later evaluated by the updated training policy. For MoE models, the same token may be routed to different experts across these two phases. This route drift changes the computation path behind the importance ratio and can make policy updates unstable. Plain routing replay fixes the route, but then the cached route becomes stale and excludes experts that the current policy would activate.
summary_en.importance: The main value is the training-signal view of MoE routing. The router is not just an inference-time dispatch module; during RL it controls which experts receive gradients and how off-policy the reused trajectories become. PR2 gives a practical compromise: keep replayed routes fixed during training for stable importance estimation, while predicting near-future routing during rollout so the cached route is less stale. The same issue can appear in large-scale MoE mid-training, continual pretraining, and disaggregated rollout-training systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: PR2, Predictive Routing Replay, augments each MoE router with a lightweight evolution predictor. The paper first formalizes routing replay as replacing the current routing distribution with a degenerate replay measure, then derives a divergence-based bound showing that replay staleness controls route-induced deviation in fixed-route PPO gradients. Motivated by this, the predictor produces a learned logit bias during rollout. Top-k routing is then performed on the biased logits, and the predicted expert indices are cached with the trajectory. During training, these cached top-k routes are replayed and the predictor is disabled, so the policy objective remains unchanged and the computation path is fixed. The predictor is trained with a KL objective designed to match short-horizon router evolution, with a separate learning-rate multiplier for faster adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments focus on reasoning RL for MoE LLMs. PR2 is reported to reduce routing mismatch, improve training stability, and outperform routing replay and GSPO-style baselines. The clearest number is on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base: GRPO with PR2 reaches 40.31% accuracy on AIME24, improving over routing replay by 12.29 points and over GSPO by 9.38 points. The method adds little compute because the predictor only biases router logits during rollout, while training still uses cached expert indices. The key ablations to inspect are the predictor, the KL training objective, the dedicated learning-rate multiplier, and the relation between routing mismatch and final task accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the definitions of router drift and router staleness in the introduction, since they are the main conceptual contribution. Then read the theoretical section on the divergence bound to see why fixed routing stabilizes PPO but can bias expert updates. In the method section, focus on the rollout-time logit bias, top-k route caching, and disabling the predictor during training. In the experiments, prioritize the AIME24 result, routing mismatch metrics, stability curves, and predictor ablations.

recommendation.zh: 做MoE RL对齐的团队可直接复现该机制，重点看§3.2的预测器设计和§4.1的稳定性分析数据。
recommendation.en: Teams working on MoE RL alignment can directly reproduce this mechanism; focus on predictor design in §3.2 and stability analysis data in §4.1.

paper.title: Softsign: Smooth Sign in Your Optimizer For Better Parameter Heterogeneity Handling
paper.abstract: Sign-based and LMO-inspired optimizers have recently attracted substantial attention in deep learning due to their strong performance and low memory footprint. However, their fixed-magnitude updates can hurt terminal convergence: they decouple update mechanisms from gradient magnitudes and fail to account for parameter heterogeneity, often leading to oscillation rather than convergence. We propose SoftSignum, a smooth relaxation of sign-based optimization that replaces the hard sign map with a t

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 sign-based / LMO-style 优化器的收敛尾段问题。Signum、Lion、Muon 这类方法把梯度方向投到固定几何边界上，早期训练时能带来稳定、低内存、抗噪的更新，但接近最优点时会忽略参数之间的尺度和收敛速度差异。梯度已经很小的坐标仍然被迫走固定幅度步长，容易在局部附近振荡，而不是细粒度收敛。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在优化器设计，而不是新的训练目标。当前 LLM 预训练里，Lion、Muon、sign-style optimizer 的吸引力来自低状态量和较强的早期训练效率，但它们的尾段 loss、cooldown 行为和参数异质性处理仍是实际问题。SoftSignum / SoftMuon 提供了一个连续过渡的设计：不在某个全局时刻硬切到 SGD，而是让每个参数或矩阵方向根据动量大小进入 sign-like 或 magnitude-sensitive 区域。这对长周期预训练、annealing/cooldown、Muon 类优化器在大模型上的稳定使用都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 steepest descent 和 LMO 的统一视角出发。标准 steepest descent 会保留梯度幅度信息；LMO-style 方法则去掉幅度，只保留归一化后的几何方向，例如坐标级 sign 或矩阵级正交化。作者指出问题不在于 LMO 早期不好，而在于固定幅度更新缺少终端分辨率。为此，他们用一个一般正则项 V 来塑造更新 d 的几何，而不是约束参数 θ 的可行域。选取坐标级熵型正则后，可以得到闭式的 tanh 形式更新，即用温度控制的 soft sign 替代 hard sign。直观上，当动量幅度远大于温度时，tanh 饱和，行为接近 sign；当动量幅度小于温度时，tanh 近似线性，行为接近 SGD 式的小步更新。论文还提出基于动量分布分位数的温度调度，让过渡阈值随训练动态变化，而不是手工设定全局切换点。SoftMuon 是同一思想在矩阵优化器上的扩展，可理解为把 Muon 的硬正交化放松为对奇异方向的平滑缩放，使不同谱方向不必统一走满幅度步长。
summary.experiments: 提供的正文片段没有包含完整实验表格和具体数值，因此不能确认模型规模、训练 token 数、任务设置和提升幅度。根据引言和摘要，实验目标应是验证两点：第一，相比 Signum / Lion / Muon 这类 hard LMO 更新，SoftSignum / SoftMuon 在训练尾段能减少振荡并改善最终 loss；第二，基于分位数的温度调度比固定温度或硬切 SGD 更稳，且不需要复杂的学习率重标定。精读时需要特别核对实验是否覆盖真实语言模型预训练，而不只是小模型或视觉任务；还要看收益来自优化器形态本身，还是来自额外调参、学习率 schedule 或更长训练。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 到 35 分钟。优先看第 3 节的几何放松推导，确认 tanh 更新是如何从正则化子问题中得到的；再看温度调度部分，重点看分位数如何定义、多久更新一次、是否引入额外超参。SoftMuon 部分值得单独看，因为它关系到 Muon 从固定正交化到平滑谱更新的具体实现。实验部分重点看训练 loss 曲线的尾段、不同参数组的更新幅度分布、固定温度/硬切换/分位数调度的消融，以及大模型或语言建模实验是否足够有代表性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the late-stage convergence issue of sign-based and LMO-style optimizers. Methods such as Signum, Lion, and Muon use fixed-magnitude updates in their respective geometries. This is useful early in training, but near convergence it ignores parameter heterogeneity: coordinates or spectral directions with tiny gradients still receive full-size updates, which can produce oscillation rather than fine-grained convergence.
summary_en.importance: The relevance is mainly optimizer design for large-scale training. Sign-style optimizers and Muon-like methods are attractive for LLM pretraining because they reduce optimizer-state cost and often behave well under noisy gradients. Their weak point is the terminal phase, especially under annealing or cooldown. SoftSignum and SoftMuon offer a continuous alternative to a hard optimizer switch: each coordinate or matrix direction can move between a bounded LMO regime and a magnitude-sensitive SGD-like regime according to the current momentum scale. This is a useful design pattern for pretraining recipes that rely on low-memory or geometry-normalized updates.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper frames steepest descent and LMO updates under a common geometric view. Standard steepest descent keeps gradient magnitude, while LMO-style updates discard it and map the update to a fixed boundary, such as coordinate-wise sign or spectral orthogonalization. The proposed method replaces the rigid norm-induced update geometry with a regularized update problem. With a coordinate-wise entropic regularizer, the solution becomes a temperature-controlled hyperbolic tangent transformation. Large momentum values saturate and behave like sign updates; small momentum values stay in the linear region and behave more like magnitude-sensitive SGD. A quantile-based temperature schedule tracks the momentum distribution and avoids a manually chosen global switch point. The same relaxation is extended to matrix-valued updates in SoftMuon, where hard orthogonalization is softened so that different spectral directions can receive different effective magnitudes.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied full-text excerpt does not include the experimental tables or exact numerical results, so model sizes, data scales, and performance deltas cannot be verified here. The empirical claims to check are whether SoftSignum and SoftMuon improve terminal loss over hard sign or hard Muon updates, and whether the quantile temperature schedule is more robust than fixed temperatures or a hard switch to SGD. For pretraining relevance, the key question is whether the gains hold on language-model training at meaningful scale rather than only on small models or non-language workloads.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take about 25 to 35 minutes. Read the geometry-relaxation derivation first, especially how the tanh update follows from the regularized subproblem. Then inspect the quantile temperature schedule: how the quantile is chosen, how often it is updated, and how many new hyperparameters it introduces. The SoftMuon section is worth reading carefully because the practical value depends on how the smooth spectral update is implemented. In the experiments, focus on late-stage loss curves, update-magnitude distributions, ablations of fixed temperature versus adaptive temperature, and comparisons against hard optimizer switching.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法和附录证明，但先别改训练栈；关键是它把 sign optimizer 的硬离散更新改成可退火连续几何，这个方向适合做小规模预训练复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and theory, but do not swap your training stack yet; the real idea is turning hard sign updates into an annealable continuous geometry, which is worth testing in small-scale pretraining.

paper.title: Singularity-aware Optimization via Randomized Geometric Probing: Towards Stable Non-smooth Optimization
paper.abstract: Deep learning optimization relies heavily on the assumption of smooth loss landscapes, a condition systematically violated by modern architectures due to non-smooth components such as ReLU activations and quantization operators. In such non-smooth regimes, adaptive optimizers such as Adam suffer from gradient chattering, violent oscillations caused by conflicting signals within the Clarke subdifferential, leading to poor convergence and suboptimal generalization. To address this, we introduce Si

summary.core_problem: 现有深度学习优化默认损失景观光滑，但现代网络包含ReLU、量化算子等非光滑组件，会形成梯度未定义的奇异点，导致Adam这类自适应优化器出现梯度震荡，收敛性和泛化性下降；现有非光滑优化方法要么计算复杂度过高要么引入额外方差，无法兼顾效率与稳定性。
summary.importance: 为LLM预训练中常见的非光滑场景（如量化感知训练、稀疏正则训练）提供了可落地的优化器改进思路，可作为Adam的即插即用替换，无需大幅修改训练流程，同时具备严格的理论收敛保证。
summary.technical_approach: 提出S-Adam优化器，核心包含两个设计：1）局部几何不稳定性（LGI）指标，通过随机方向采样估计Clarke次微分的直径，无需计算Hessian，计算成本低；2）自适应几何制动项，根据LGI分数实时调整步长，在奇异点附近缩小步长抑制震荡，光滑区域保持大步长快速收敛。同时通过微分包含分析证明了算法以最优O(1/√T)速率收敛到Clarke平稳点。
summary.experiments: 在低比特量化感知训练、高噪声小批次学习等极端非光滑场景下测试，相比AdamW、Prox-SGD取得明显的精度提升；探针数量k可灵活平衡计算成本与估计精度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议重点看第2章的问题背景与梯度震荡的几何成因、第4章S-Adam的算法流程、实验部分的低比特QAT结果，跳过复杂的理论证明附录，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Deep learning optimization relies on smooth loss landscape assumptions, which are violated by non-smooth components like ReLU activations and quantization operators in modern architectures. Adaptive optimizers such as Adam suffer from gradient chattering at singular points where gradients are undefined, leading to poor convergence and generalization. Existing non-smooth optimization methods either have prohibitive computational cost or introduce excess variance, failing to balance efficiency and stability.
summary_en.importance: Provides a practical optimizer improvement for common non-smooth scenarios in LLM pretraining, such as quantization-aware training and sparse regularization training. It can be used as a drop-in replacement for Adam with minimal training pipeline modifications and has rigorous theoretical convergence guarantees.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the S-Adam optimizer with two core designs: 1) Local Geometric Instability (LGI) metric, which estimates the diameter of the Clarke subdifferential via random direction sampling without Hessian computation, keeping computational overhead low; 2) Adaptive geometric brake term that adjusts step size in real time based on LGI score, reducing step size near singularities to suppress oscillations while maintaining large steps in smooth regions for fast convergence. The algorithm is proven to converge to Clarke stationary points at the optimal O(1/√T) rate via differential inclusion analysis.
summary_en.experiments: Tested in extreme non-smooth scenarios including low-bit quantization-aware training and high-noise small-batch learning, achieving noticeable accuracy improvements over AdamW and Prox-SGD. The number of probes k allows flexible trade-off between computational cost and estimation fidelity.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 2 for problem background and geometric origin of gradient chattering, Section 4 for S-Adam algorithm workflow, and experimental results on low-bit QAT. Skip complex theoretical proof appendices. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 针对非光滑优化中梯度震颤问题的优化器改进，Clarke次微分直径的可计算化实现是亮点，建议读§3 LGI度量的推导和§4实验的稳定性对比
recommendation.en: Optimizer improvement addressing gradient chattering in non-smooth optimization; the computable formulation of Clarke subdifferential diameter is the key insight; read §3 LGI metric derivation and §4 stability comparisons

paper.title: Can Entry-Wise Clipping Give Spectral Control of Stochastic Gradients?
paper.abstract: Training instabilities such as loss spikes are frequently the result of stochastic gradient noise. Because of rare expressions in language training data, and multiple layer composition, the noise impact is heavy-tailed and survives mini-batch averaging. Existing remedies trade off structure against cost: vector-norm clipping ignores the matrix structure of weight updates, while spectral normalization (e.g., Muon (Jordan et al., 2024)) respects it at additional cost. We show that this trade-off c

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：在 LLM 预训练中，能否用便宜的逐元素 clipping 近似实现对矩阵梯度更新的谱控制，从而缓解由重尾随机梯度噪声引起的 loss spike 和训练不稳定。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在训练稳定性和优化器设计。LLM 训练中的梯度噪声常有重尾特征，少数异常 entry 可能显著影响矩阵更新的最大奇异值。全局 norm clipping 会无差别缩放信号和噪声，普通 coordinate-wise clipping 又没有明确的谱控制解释；Muon、SPECTRA 等谱方法更贴近矩阵结构，但计算代价更高。这项工作给出一个中间方案：当噪声是 entry-wise heavy-tailed contamination 时，逐元素处理可以通过“局部化”机制控制谱扰动。这个视角有助于解释为什么一些简单 clipping 在大模型训练中有效，也给 Adam、Muon 这类优化器的 clipping 位置提供了更具体的设计依据。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从最大奇异值的一阶扰动分析出发，定义 normalized localization ratio \hat{R}(E)，用于衡量噪声矩阵 E 的大 entry 是否对齐到最大奇异值的扰动方向。作者区分两类 regime：在局部化 regime 中，少数大 entry 主导谱扰动，逐元素幅值就能成为谱控制的有效杠杆；在 Gaussian 或有界二阶矩的 random low-rank 噪声中，这种性质通常不成立。基于这个模型，作者推导出 smooth shrinkage clipping：φ(x)=x exp(-|x|/τ)。它来自高斯信号先验下 Bayes-optimal entry-wise estimator 的可处理替代，用来减小局部化重尾噪声导致的谱扰动。应用方式有两种：post-clipping，即直接作用在 optimizer update 上；pre-clipping，即放在谱归一化之前，用来恢复被局部 spike 污染的子空间。理论部分还在 Cauchy-contaminated noise 模型下证明了带 smooth shrinkage 或 hard coordinate-wise clipping 的随机梯度方法可达到 O(ε^{-4}) 的 ε-stationary point 复杂度，重尾参数只进入常数项。
summary.experiments: 实验观察来自 LLM 预训练中的 transformer layer 梯度噪声。作者报告真实噪声呈现局部化现象，并且形态更接近 entry-wise heavy-tailed contamination，而不是 Gaussian 或 random low-rank perturbation。优化实验中，smooth shrinkage 作为 post-clipping 作用于 Adam，可节省约 7% 训练 token；作为 pre-clipping 放在 Muon 的谱归一化之前，可修复局部 spike 对子空间的污染，并节省约 2% token。这里的“节省 token”应理解为达到相同训练进度或损失水平所需 token 数减少。结果说明，逐元素 clipping 不只是启发式稳定技巧，在特定噪声结构下可以近似承担谱控制角色。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–40 分钟。先看 Figure 1，确认真实梯度噪声与 entry-wise heavy-tailed contamination 的相似性，这是后续理论成立的经验前提。Section 3 是核心，重点看最大奇异值一阶扰动和 normalized localization ratio 的定义；这里决定了为什么逐元素 clipping 能影响谱范数。Section 4 看 smooth shrinkage 的推导和 φ(x)=x exp(-|x|/τ) 的设计动机。Section 6 的 Adam 与 Muon 实验最接近预训练实践，尤其要看 clipping 放在 update 之后还是谱归一化之前。理论收敛部分可以快速扫读，重点记住 O(ε^{-4}) 与重尾参数只进常数这一点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether cheap entry-wise clipping can provide spectral control over matrix-valued stochastic gradients in LLM pretraining, especially under heavy-tailed noise that causes loss spikes and unstable updates.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is relevant to pretraining stability and optimizer design. Gradient noise in large language model training is often heavy-tailed, and a small number of extreme entries can dominate the spectral behavior of a matrix update. Global norm clipping treats all directions uniformly and can suppress useful signal. Standard coordinate-wise clipping is cheap but lacks a structural explanation. Spectral methods such as Muon or SPECTRA respect matrix geometry, but they require more expensive operations. This work identifies a regime where entry-wise clipping is a principled surrogate for spectral control: when the noise is localized entry-wise heavy-tailed contamination rather than Gaussian or bounded-variance low-rank perturbation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis starts from a first-order perturbation expansion of the top singular value. From this, the authors define a normalized localization ratio, \hat{R}(E), which measures whether the large entries of a noise matrix E align with the perturbation direction of the top singular value. If the noise is localized, entry magnitudes can directly control spectral perturbation. If the noise is Gaussian or random low-rank with bounded second moment, this entry-wise handle is much weaker. Using the localized heavy-tail model, the paper derives a smooth shrinkage operator, φ(x)=x exp(-|x|/τ), as a tractable surrogate for the Bayes-optimal entry-wise estimator under a Gaussian prior on the signal. The operator can be used after the optimizer update as post-clipping, or before spectral normalization as pre-clipping. The latter is designed to prevent localized spikes from corrupting the subspace used by spectral methods. The theory also gives O(ε^{-4}) complexity for reaching an ε-stationary point under Cauchy-contaminated noise, with the heavy-tail parameter affecting constants rather than the exponent.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical starting point is real stochastic gradient noise from a transformer layer during LLM pretraining. The observed noise is localized and resembles entry-wise heavy-tailed contamination more than Gaussian or random low-rank noise. In optimization experiments, smooth shrinkage used as post-clipping improves Adam and saves about 7% of training tokens. When used as pre-clipping before Muon-style spectral normalization, it helps recover subspaces corrupted by localized spikes and saves about 2% of tokens. The token-saving numbers should be read as reductions in the amount of training data needed to reach comparable progress or loss, not as a universal constant across all training runs.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–40 minute skim is enough for most readers. Start with Figure 1, since the empirical noise shape is the premise for the method. Then read Section 3 for the perturbation analysis and the definition of the localization ratio; this is the main conceptual contribution. Section 4 explains why the smooth shrinkage form φ(x)=x exp(-|x|/τ) is used instead of hard clipping or full spectral clipping. The experimental section is the most useful part for pretraining practice, especially the distinction between post-clipping for Adam and pre-clipping before Muon. The convergence proofs can be skimmed unless the reader is working directly on heavy-tailed SGD theory.

recommendation.zh: 优先看噪声模型和 shrinkage ablation；若覆盖真实预训练梯度，可立刻进 internal stability ablation。
recommendation.en: Prioritize the noise model and shrinkage ablations; if they use real pretraining gradients, this should go into internal stability ablations.

paper.title: Off-Policy Learning to Reason Works Because It Is More Pessimistic Than You Think
paper.abstract: Large scale reinforcement learning has become a central tool for improving reasoning in large language models. At this scale, generation is often lagged or asynchronous, so updates are performed on data collected by older policies. This makes learning inherently off-policy. Most existing approaches nevertheless remain rooted in PPO-style trust-region objectives, treating training as approximately on-policy and using importance weights to correct distribution mismatch. These corrections can intro

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论大规模推理 RL 中不可避免的 off-policy 训练：rollout 往往来自旧策略，而去掉 importance weight 的 ratio-free 方法为什么反而稳定。
summary.importance: 启发点在于把 A⋆-PO、OAPL 这类 off-policy reasoning RL 的稳定性解释为一种隐式保守更新，而不是简单的“忽略分布偏移”。这对大规模 RL 系统有实际意义，因为异步采样、策略滞后、旧 checkpoint rollout 都会让严格 on-policy 假设失效。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，论文分析一类不使用 importance ratio 的 off-policy 目标，指出它们诱导的目标策略不是常见 KL-regularized policy optimization 中的指数倾斜分布，而是 Lambert-tempered target policy。这个目标会对高 advantage 样本做温和放大，避免少数旧策略采样到的高 reward completion 过度主导更新。关键控制量来自 advantage normalization。论文把目标行为分成三个区域：正区域是保守的 Lambert regime；边界退化到指数更新；负区域比指数更新更激进，更容易导致 entropy collapse。基于这个分析，作者解释了 OAPL 实现中为什么要把 advantage 计算温度和 regularization 温度解耦：这会把 advantage 推回更保守的区域。进一步提出 β-shifted mean advantage，即在 group-centered reward advantage 上加一个 β shift，使诱导目标直接落在保守区域，减少对温度解耦启发式的依赖。
summary.experiments: 实验重点是鲁棒性而不是单点分数。相较 OAPL，β-shifted mean advantage 对 regularization strength 更不敏感，在更大的 policy lag 下也更稳定；训练中 entropy 保持得更好，减少了 OAPL 在激进正则或 stale rollout 下出现的 collapse 或不稳定。给定内容没有提供具体 benchmark、模型规模和数值提升，因此适合作为机制分析和训练 recipe 参考，而不是按最终榜单性能阅读。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 到 45 分钟。先看 ratio-free off-policy objective 到 Lambert-tempered target 的推导，理解为什么去掉 importance weight 后不是无校正训练，而是改变了目标分布形状。然后看 advantage normalization 的三种 regime，这是最有用的诊断工具。实验部分重点看 policy lag、regularization strength 和 entropy 曲线，不必过度关注单个任务分数。若已经熟悉 PPO/GRPO/OAPL，可以直接读理论分析和 β-shifted mean advantage 的实现规则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why ratio-free off-policy RL can work for LLM reasoning when rollouts are generated by stale or asynchronous behavior policies.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is a clearer explanation of off-policy reasoning RL at scale. Large RL systems rarely operate in a purely on-policy regime: generation is expensive, workers are asynchronous, and updates often consume samples from older policies. The paper argues that removing importance weights is not merely ignoring distribution mismatch; under suitable advantage normalization, it induces a conservative update that can be more stable than ratio-corrected PPO-style objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis covers ratio-free off-policy objectives related to A⋆-PO and OAPL. Instead of deriving another trust-region surrogate, it asks what target policy these objectives actually optimize toward when the data come from an older behavior policy. The induced target is shown to be Lambert-tempered rather than the usual exponential target from KL-regularized policy optimization. This matters because Lambert tempering can damp high-advantage samples, preventing a few stale completions from dominating the update. The behavior depends on the advantage baseline and normalization. In the positive regime, the target is pessimistic and conservative; at the boundary, it recovers the exponential update; in the negative regime, it becomes more aggressive than the exponential update and is more prone to entropy collapse. The paper uses this lens to explain the temperature decoupling used in practical A⋆-PO/OAPL implementations, then proposes a simpler β-shifted mean advantage that pushes the target into the conservative Lambert regime by construction.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical results focus on stability under different regularization strengths and policy lags. Compared with OAPL, the β-shifted mean advantage is reported to be less sensitive to regularization, more stable under stale rollouts, and better at maintaining entropy. The provided text does not include exact model sizes, benchmark names, or numerical margins, so the empirical claim should be read as a robustness result rather than a detailed performance comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with attention to the derivation of the Lambert-tempered target and the three regimes induced by advantage normalization. These sections are the useful part for RL training design. Then check the implementation rule for the β-shifted mean advantage and the stability plots over policy lag, regularization strength, and entropy. Estimated reading time is 30 to 45 minutes for readers already familiar with PPO, GRPO, and OAPL.

recommendation.zh: 从隐式悲观角度解释off-policy RL训练LLM推理的核心机制，做RL与预训练融合的可重点看目标函数推导部分
recommendation.en: Explains the core mechanism of off-policy RL for LLM reasoning via implicit pessimism; researchers working on RL-pretraining integration should focus on objective derivation

paper.title: Cyclical Entropy Eruption: Entropy Dynamics in Agent Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Agentic large language models are increasingly used to solve real-world tasks by reasoning over goals, invoking tools, and interacting with external environments. Reinforcement learning provides a natural framework for improving these behaviors, and recent agent RL methods have achieved strong results across domains. However, the training dynamics of agent RL remain poorly understood, limiting our ability to diagnose instabilities and design more effective training algorithms. In this work, we i

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文分析 agent RL 中一个训练动态问题：策略熵不是像单轮 reasoning RL 那样下降后保持低位，而是在训练中反复出现快速升高和缓慢回落。作者把这个现象称为 cyclical entropy eruption，并试图解释它为什么在长轨迹、工具调用和格式约束的 agent 场景中出现。
summary.importance: 它对预训练方向的直接贡献有限，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有信息量。agent RL 的训练信号包含格式有效性、工具执行反馈和语义正确性，分布变化比单轮 RL 更复杂。论文指出，熵升高不一定只是探索增加，也可能来自表示相似轨迹之间的梯度干扰，导致有效轨迹 likelihood 被压低。这个观察对后续设计 agent 数据合成、RL loss、格式奖励和稳定训练诊断都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把训练过程分成三个阶段。第一是 entropy descent，模型快速学会工具格式、函数调用和特殊 token 的使用，策略分布变尖。第二是 entropy eruption，当正确和错误轨迹在表示空间中过于相似时，advantage 加权更新会产生梯度干扰，压低有效轨迹概率，使分布变平，并放大重复、幻觉和格式退化。第三是 entropy subsidence，分布变平后采样轨迹更多样，表示相似度下降，训练又能逐步强化正确轨迹，随后再次进入收敛和熵爆发循环。基于这个分析，作者提出 SEAL，即 Separation-Enhanced Agent Learning，在原 agent RL objective 上加入表示分离约束，让正确与错误轨迹在表示空间中拉开距离，以减少冲突更新。该方法不增加推理成本。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖不同 agent 任务、模型和 RL 算法。文中给出的关键数字包括：在 Qwen2.5-7B + GRPO 上，SEAL 使 AlfWorld 平均准确率提升 2.81%，WebShop success rate 提升 3.13%。在 Llama 系列模型上，普通 GRPO 出现训练崩溃，success rate 为 0%；加入 SEAL 后恢复到 79.69%。论文还报告 SEAL 能提高 valid-trajectory likelihood，缓解熵的周期性升高。这里最有价值的实验不是单点性能，而是 entropy、representation similarity、valid trajectory likelihood 三者随训练变化的曲线是否能互相解释。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25–35 分钟。先看 entropy 曲线和三阶段分解，确认 agent RL 与单轮 reasoning RL 的差别；再看理论分析中 representation similarity 如何导致梯度干扰；最后看 SEAL loss 的定义和消融。若时间有限，可以跳过部分 benchmark 细节，重点看训练动态图、valid trajectory likelihood 曲线、以及 Llama 崩溃被 SEAL 修复的案例。深挖点是：表示分离是否会牺牲可泛化的共享结构，以及该机制能否和 KL、entropy bonus、format reward 等常用稳定化手段区分开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes a training instability in agent reinforcement learning. Unlike single-turn reasoning RL, where entropy often decreases and remains low, agent RL shows repeated cycles of sharp entropy increases followed by gradual decay. The paper calls this pattern cyclical entropy eruption and studies why it arises in long-horizon tool-using trajectories with validity constraints.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to RL post-training than to pretraining itself, but it is useful for understanding the pretrain-posttrain interface. Agent RL mixes semantic rewards, format validity, tool feedback, and long trajectories. The paper argues that entropy spikes can be caused by gradient interference between highly similar correct and incorrect trajectories, not merely by beneficial exploration. This gives a concrete diagnostic for unstable agent RL runs and suggests that representation geometry matters in RL objective design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed explanation has three phases. In entropy descent, the policy quickly learns tool-call schemas, special tokens, and valid output formats, so the distribution sharpens. In entropy eruption, trajectories become highly similar in representation space. Advantage-weighted updates then interfere with each other and can reduce the likelihood of valid trajectories, flattening the policy and increasing degenerate generations such as repetition, hallucination, or malformed actions. In entropy subsidence, the flatter policy samples more diverse trajectories, representation similarity decreases, and correct trajectories can again be reinforced. This creates a recurring cycle. The method contribution is SEAL, a Separation-Enhanced Agent Learning objective that encourages correct and incorrect trajectories to be separated in representation space. It is a training-time modification and adds no inference cost.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span multiple agent benchmarks, backbones, and RL algorithms. Reported numbers include a 2.81% average accuracy gain on AlfWorld and a 3.13% success-rate gain on WebShop for Qwen2.5-7B trained with GRPO. For a Llama-series model where vanilla GRPO collapses to 0% success rate, adding SEAL recovers training and reaches 79.69%. The more important evidence is the set of training curves linking entropy, representation similarity, and valid-trajectory likelihood. Those curves support the claim that the instability is a structured training dynamic rather than random noise.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Read the entropy dynamics figures first, then the analysis connecting representation similarity to gradient interference, and then the SEAL objective and ablations. Benchmark tables are secondary unless the goal is to reproduce the method. The main technical questions are whether representation separation removes harmful interference without destroying useful shared structure, and how SEAL compares with simpler stabilizers such as KL control, entropy regularization, or stronger format rewards.

recommendation.zh: 读熵曲线和三阶段分解；若环境控制干净，它会改变 agent RL 只盯 reward/length 的监控习惯。
recommendation.en: Read the entropy traces and three-phase decomposition; if the environments are controlled, this changes how agent RL should be monitored beyond reward and length.

paper.title: Less is More: Early Stopping Rollout for On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation has recently emerged as a promising alternative to standard sequence-level imitation, training a student by scoring its own rollouts with a teacher model. However, we observe ``Off-policy Teacher Decay'' problem in this paradigm: for the later tokens, with student's earlier trajectory as context that is off-policy to the teacher, the teacher's ability to produce a corrective score would decay, and may fall back to token-completion behavior learned in the pre-training stage

summary.core_problem: On-policy distillation（OPD）用 teacher 对 student 自己 rollouts 的每个 token 给 soft target/密集奖励。但在长输出里，teacher 在后段 token 的评分会因为 conditioning 在 student 的 off-policy 前缀上而“失真”，逐渐退化成预训练式的 token completion，而不是对齐后的纠错分布。论文要解决的是：如何在不改 OPD 主框架的情况下，缓解这种 late-token 的 off-policy teacher decay，并提升稳定性与效率。
summary.importance: 对训练动态与对齐信号质量有直接启发：它把 OPD 里一个常被忽略的“位置维度分布漂移”问题显式化，并给出极简修复（截断 rollout）。这对 post-training recipe 很实用，尤其是跨家族/跨代 teacher-student 组合时的稳定性。对预训练本身不是方法贡献，但对“如何让 teacher 信号在长序列上保持语义对齐而非退回 next-token completion”这一类问题有普遍性，可能影响后续的 distillation/RLHF/RLAIF 训练设计。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Early Stopping Rollout（ESR）：student 只生成前 N 个 response tokens，只在这段 early window 上计算 OPD 的 token-level distillation loss（teacher 条件在 prompt + student 前缀）。实现上是 OPD loop 的一行改动。
核心机制判断：
- Off-policy Teacher Decay：随着位置 t 增大，teacher 需要在越来越长的 student 前缀 y^S_{<t} 上条件化；该前缀对 teacher 来说是 off-policy，导致 teacher 的“可恢复性”下降，评分不再代表 teacher 的对齐后策略。
- 论文用 recoverability gap 来度量：比较 teacher 从原 prompt 解题的准确率 A_T(x) 与从 student 前缀继续的准确率 A_T(x | y^S_{<t})，差值随 t 增大。
- ESR 的直觉是：只在 teacher 仍处于“自然推理状态”的早期位置蒸馏，避免把后段的退化分布当成监督信号。
作者进一步给出两个解释性现象：
1）Cascading Alignment：只训练早期窗口，未训练的后段 token 的 KL 也会下降 30–40%，说明早期对齐会通过前缀分布改善后续生成。
2）Sub-mode Commitment：ESR 训练的 student 可能收敛到 teacher 支持的某个子模态，而不是追逐 teacher 的主模态；该子模态在某些任务上可能更好，因此出现 student 超过 teacher 的现象。
并且作者做了消融，声称“位置”效应独立于 KL/entropy 等常见信号。
summary.experiments:
主要结果（来自全文描述）：
- ESR 在 math/code/function calling 等任务上，跨训练方式（LoRA、全参微调）、跨 student 规模（1.5B–32B）、跨 teacher 规模（1.7B–72B）、跨模型家族（Qwen2.5/Qwen3、Gemma2/Gemma3）均优于 full-rollout OPD。
- 训练效率：wall-clock 最多降低 24×，峰值显存最多降低 4×（因为 rollout 更短、token-level loss 计算更少）。
- 稳定性：full-rollout OPD 在 cross-generation / cross-family 设置下更容易不稳定甚至 collapse；ESR 更稳。
- 现象验证：teacher 从 early-stopped student rollout 继续生成时，性能在约 100 tokens 后快速衰减，约 300 tokens 降到接近 student baseline（Figure 1 的描述）。
- 机制量化：Cascading Alignment 里提到未训练后段的 KL 仍下降 30–40%。
具体各任务的绝对分数/提升幅度、最佳 N 的选择曲线等需要看论文表格与超参扫描部分（提供的全文片段未包含这些表格）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Off-policy Teacher Decay 的定义与度量（recoverability gap）以及 Figure 1：这是 ESR 合理性的关键证据。
- 再看 ESR 的超参 N 如何选、对不同任务/模型是否敏感（通常会有一张 sweep 曲线或表）。
- 最后看两组解释性实验：Cascading Alignment（为什么不训练后段也能改善后段）与 Sub-mode Commitment（为什么可能超过 teacher）。
如果要落地到训练：优先确认两点——(1) 你的 OPD 是否也存在长输出场景（工具调用/代码/长推理），(2) teacher 在 off-policy 前缀上的退化是否可复现；可先用 recoverability gap 做快速诊断。

summary_en.core_problem: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts using token-level teacher scores as soft targets. The paper identifies a failure mode in long responses: as token position increases, the teacher is conditioned on an increasingly off-policy student prefix, so the teacher’s scoring distribution decays toward generic next-token completion rather than providing aligned corrective supervision. The goal is to fix this late-token supervision pathology without changing the OPD framework.
summary_en.importance: A practical training-dynamics contribution for post-training recipes: it isolates “position-induced off-policy drift” as a distinct issue in OPD and shows a minimal intervention can improve both stability and cost, especially for cross-family or cross-generation teacher–student pairs where full-rollout OPD can collapse. While not a pretraining method, it is broadly relevant to how we preserve the quality of teacher signals over long sequences—an issue that also shows up in alignment and distillation pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Early Stopping Rollout (ESR): truncate the student rollout to the first N response tokens and compute the OPD distillation loss only on this early window. Implementation is essentially a one-line change.
Key reasoning:
- Off-policy Teacher Decay: teacher supervision at position t is conditioned on the student prefix y^S_{<t}, which is off-policy for the teacher and drifts away from the teacher’s aligned distribution.
- The paper proposes a measurable diagnostic via a recoverability gap: compare teacher accuracy from the original prompt A_T(x) versus accuracy when forced to continue from a student-generated prefix A_T(x | y^S_{<t}); the gap grows with t.
- ESR avoids training on positions where the teacher is no longer in its “natural reasoning state.”
Explanatory findings:
1) Cascading Alignment: training only early tokens reduces KL on untrained late tokens by ~30–40%, suggesting early-prefix alignment improves downstream generation distribution.
2) Sub-mode Commitment: ESR students may commit to a supported sub-mode of the teacher distribution instead of chasing the dominant mode; this can sometimes outperform the teacher.
The authors also claim position effects are not reducible to KL/entropy heuristics via ablations.
summary_en.experiments:
Reported empirical coverage:
- Tasks: math, code, function calling.
- Training regimes: LoRA and full fine-tuning.
- Scales: students 1.5B–32B; teachers 1.7B–72B.
- Families/generations: Qwen2.5/Qwen3 and Gemma2/Gemma3; ESR is notably more stable in cross-family/cross-generation settings where full-rollout OPD can collapse.
Efficiency: up to 24× wall-clock reduction and up to 4× peak memory reduction.
Diagnostics: teacher performance when continuing from an early-stopped student rollout decays quickly after ~100 tokens and reaches near-student baseline within ~300 tokens (as described for Figure 1).
Mechanism quantification: Cascading Alignment shows ~30–40% KL reduction on late tokens without directly training them.
Exact per-benchmark scores and the optimal N sweeps are not present in the provided excerpt and should be taken from the paper’s tables/plots.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the definition/measurement of Off-policy Teacher Decay and the main diagnostic plot (Figure 1).
- Check how N is selected and how sensitive ESR is across tasks/models (look for sweeps).
- Read the two explanatory sections: Cascading Alignment and Sub-mode Commitment.
For adoption, first reproduce the recoverability-gap diagnostic on your own OPD setup; it’s a fast way to tell whether ESR is likely to help.

recommendation.zh: 只看机制实验和 rollout 长度消融；它修正了“更 on-policy、更长轨迹更好”的直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanism tests and rollout-length ablations; it corrects the intuition that longer on-policy trajectories are always better.

paper.title: MuCon: Clipped Muon Updates for LLM Training
paper.abstract: Muon-style optimizers take a matrix-valued momentum or preconditioned update $B = U \operatorname{diag}(σ_1,\ldots,σ_r) V^\top$ and replace it with its canonical partial polar factor $\operatorname{Pol}(B) = U V^\top$. This maps every nonzero singular value to one. MuCon is the clipped-Muon variant studied here: it applies singular-value clipping to the same Muon matrix, $D^{\mathrm{MuCon}}\_τ(B) = \operatorname{MClip}\_τ(B) = U \operatorname{diag}\bigl(\min\{σ\_i,τ\}\bigr) V^\top, \qquad τ> 0$.

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 Muon 类优化器里的一个关键问题：polar Muon 会把矩阵更新的所有非零奇异值都变成 1，操作过于激进；是否可以只截断过大的奇异值，同时保留小奇异值中的幅度信息，并且让这个操作在大模型训练中有可实现的近似算法。
summary.importance: 这是一篇偏优化器基础构件的论文，对预训练的价值在于更新谱控制。Muon 的吸引力来自对矩阵更新方向做正交化，从而控制隐藏层矩阵的算子尺度；但 polar step 会丢掉全部奇异值大小，可能破坏优化信号。MuCon 把这个操作改成 spectral clipping：只限制谱范数，不抹平所有方向。这个改动更接近“约束更新大小”而不是“重写更新几何”。它与 SpectralP/CompleteP 这类宽度-深度联合缩放参数化连接紧密，目标是让小模型调参更容易迁移到大模型。
summary.technical_approach: 给定 Muon 矩阵 B_t 的紧 SVD B_t=UΣV^T，标准 Muon 使用 canonical partial polar factor UV^T，也就是把每个非零奇异值替换为 1。MuCon 使用 MClip_τ(B_t)=U min(Σ,τI) V^T，默认 τ=1。这个算子有一个干净的几何解释：它是把矩阵投影到谱范数不超过 τ 的闭球上，投影度量是 Frobenius norm。它也有低秩校正形式：只对超过阈值的奇异方向做修正，MClip_τ(M)=M-U_>(Σ_>-τI)V_>^T。因此，如果超过阈值的奇异值数量 k_> 很少，partial SVD、Lanczos 或 randomized subspace method 是自然选择；如果 k_> 很多，全局矩阵函数迭代可能更合适。论文还把 clipping 写成 polar/absolute-value 形式，指出阈值附近的特征值会带来数值不稳定，因为 clip 函数在阈值处不可光滑。最后，作者分析了用于 clipped positive-semidefinite factor 的 rational Newton iteration，并强调它只是 spectral filter，不是完整的免 SVD 算法。
summary.experiments: 给定材料主要是数学和数值算法分析，没有提供完整训练实验表。可确认的实验相关设定是：MuCon 被放在 SpectralP 参数化下讨论，隐藏二维矩阵参数组使用 Muon/MuCon 的谱控制更新，标量、向量、embedding、unembedding 等参数组仍使用 AdamW companion groups。SpectralP 的动机来自 CompleteP 的宽度-深度联合 scaling：希望 hidden matrix updates 的谱尺度可控，从而支持 hyperparameter transfer。文中没有可核验的模型规模、token 数、loss 曲线或下游性能数字，因此阅读时应把它视为优化器 primitive 和数值近似报告，而不是已完成的大规模训练 recipe 论文。
summary.reading_guide: 精读建议优先看 Introduction 中对 MClip_τ、MuCon、SpectralP 三者的区分。这一点很重要：MClip 是数学算子，MuCon 是把该算子放进 Muon pipeline 的 optimizer primitive，SpectralP 是隐藏矩阵参数组的缩放参数化。其次看投影定理和低秩校正恒等式，它们决定了近似算法该怎么设计。然后看 polar/absolute-value formulation 和 rational Newton iteration，重点不是公式复杂度，而是它为什么只能作为 spectral filter，以及阈值特征值为什么难处理。Background 的 CompleteP/μP 部分建议细读到学习率和 residual depth scaling 的规则，因为这解释了为什么谱控制更新与宽深缩放迁移有关。若只关心工程落地，重点检查后续是否有 partial SVD、Lanczos、randomized method 与 Newton-style filter 的实际开销比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a core optimizer primitive for Muon-style training. Standard polar Muon maps every nonzero singular value of a matrix update to one, which is a strong intervention. MuCon asks whether one can instead clip only the singular values that exceed a threshold, preserve the remaining magnitude information, and approximate this operation well enough for LLM training.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pre-training is update spectrum control. Muon is attractive because it constrains matrix-valued hidden updates through an orthogonalized direction, but the polar step discards all singular-value magnitudes. MuCon changes the operation from full polar normalization to spectral clipping. This is closer to constraining update size than replacing the entire update geometry. The connection to SpectralP and CompleteP matters because the intended use case is hyperparameter transfer under simultaneous width and depth scaling: tune small, train larger, while keeping hidden matrix update spectra under control.
summary_en.technical_approach: For a Muon matrix B_t with compact SVD B_t=UΣV^T, polar Muon uses the canonical partial polar factor UV^T, replacing every nonzero singular value by one. MuCon uses MClip_τ(B_t)=U min(Σ,τI) V^T, with τ=1 as the default. The operator has a clean variational meaning: it is the Frobenius projection of the matrix onto the spectral-norm ball of radius τ. It also admits a low-rank correction identity, MClip_τ(M)=M-U_>(Σ_>-τI)V_>^T, where only the singular directions above the threshold are modified. This identity gives the algorithmic split: when the number of violating singular values is small, partial SVD, Lanczos, or randomized subspace methods are natural; when many singular values violate the threshold, global matrix-function iterations may be competitive. The paper also derives a polar/absolute-value formulation and explains why eigenvalues near the clipping threshold are numerically delicate. Its rational Newton iteration for the clipped positive-semidefinite factor should be read as a spectral filter, not as a complete SVD-free optimizer implementation.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content is primarily mathematical and numerical-analysis oriented, and does not expose full training experiment tables. The confirmed training context is SpectralP MuCon: hidden two-dimensional matrix groups use the Muon/MuCon spectral update class, while scalar, vector, embedding, and unembedding groups remain AdamW companion groups. The motivation comes from CompleteP-style joint width-depth scaling, where controlled hidden-matrix update spectra are expected to help hyperparameter transfer. No verifiable model sizes, token counts, loss curves, or downstream metrics are available in the supplied text, so the paper should be treated as an optimizer-primitive and approximation report rather than a complete large-scale training recipe.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully the early definitions that separate MClip_τ, MuCon, and SpectralP. MClip is the mathematical clipping map, MuCon is the optimizer primitive that inserts this map into the Muon pipeline, and SpectralP is the scaling parameterization for hidden matrix groups. Then focus on the projection theorem and the low-rank correction identity; these determine which numerical approximations are sensible. The polar/absolute-value formulation and rational Newton analysis are worth reading for their failure modes: the threshold is nonsmooth, and the Newton iteration is only a spectral filter. The CompleteP/μP background is useful because it explains why spectral update control is tied to width-depth hyperparameter transfer. For engineering use, the key missing evidence to look for is wall-clock cost and accuracy tradeoffs among partial SVD, Lanczos, randomized methods, and Newton-style filters inside an optimizer loop.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看正文实验表：若 MuCon 在同等 compute 下少掉 Muon 的谱失真和 spike，内部 optimizer ablation 值得复现。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental tables first: if MuCon reduces Muon’s spectral distortion and spikes at matched compute, it deserves an internal optimizer ablation.

paper.title: MONA: Muon Optimizer with Nesterov Acceleration for Scalable Language Model Training
paper.abstract: The Muon optimizer has recently offered a promising alternative to AdamW for large language model training, leveraging matrix orthogonalization to produce geometry-aware updates. However, like all first-order methods, Muon can become trapped in sharp local minima. In this work, we present MONA, an optimizer that bridges Muon's orthogonalization framework with curvature-aware acceleration. MONA adds an acceleration term directly into Muon's gradient processing pipeline. This term is calculated fr

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题是：在 Muon 已经通过矩阵正交化改善大模型训练效率的前提下，进一步引入对曲率和尖锐极小值更敏感的更新信号，避免优化过程只依赖一阶动量方向。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的价值主要在优化器设计。Muon 已经开始进入大规模 MoE 训练实践，MONA 试图回答一个实际问题：能否在不破坏 Muon 谱范数约束和 Newton-Schulz 正交化流程的情况下，加入类似 ALTO 的梯度差分加速项。贡献量级偏工程增量，但方向有用，因为它直接作用于大规模预训练的收敛速度、稳定性和下游能力。
summary.technical_approach: MONA 的核心做法是把梯度差分的指数滑动平均作为加速项，先加到原始梯度中，再进入 Muon 的动量和正交化流程。梯度差分 g_k - g_{k-1} 可近似为 Hessian 乘以参数位移，因此包含局部曲率信息。论文强调这个加速项必须放在正交化之前。如果放在正交化之后，会破坏 Muon 依赖的矩阵几何结构；如果只作为外部 adaptor，也会和 Muon 的非线性 Newton-Schulz 变换产生不清晰的耦合。对矩阵参数，MONA 沿用 Muon 的矩阵级更新：动量缓冲、Newton-Schulz 近似极分解、谱范数约束和 RMS 缩放。对 embedding、bias 等向量参数，则回退到 AdamW。理论部分在非凸光滑假设和有界方差随机梯度假设下给出收敛分析，并讨论加速项帮助离开尖锐区域的机制。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个 MoE 规模：MOE-1B-A0d2B、MOE-6B-A0d5B 和 MOE-68B-A3B。最大模型训练到 1T tokens。论文称 MONA 在预训练收敛上优于 Muon 和 AdamW，并在 MOE-68B-A3B 上继续做 SFT，评测通用能力、数学推理和代码生成，结果保持优势。给出的正文片段没有完整列出各 benchmark 的具体分数和提升幅度，因此精读时应重点核对预训练 loss 曲线、token efficiency、不同规模下的稳定性，以及 SFT 后能力是否来自更低的预训练 loss，还是来自优化器改变了表示质量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20-30 分钟。建议先看 Algorithm 1，确认加速项和 Muon 正交化的插入位置；再看理论部分的假设是否和真实大规模训练相差过大；最后看三个 MoE 规模的 loss 曲线和下游表格。需要特别留意两点：一是 MONA 相比 Muon 是否引入了额外超参敏感性，例如加速系数 alpha 和记忆系数 beta_a；二是实验是否控制了学习率、batch size、warmup、cooldown 和 weight decay，否则优化器对比容易受到 recipe 差异影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical optimizer question: given Muon’s matrix orthogonalization benefits for large-scale language model training, can one add curvature-sensitive acceleration without disrupting Muon’s spectral-norm update geometry?
summary_en.importance: The relevance is mainly in pretraining optimization. Muon has become a serious alternative to AdamW in large MoE training, and MONA explores whether gradient-difference acceleration can improve convergence and downstream quality while keeping Muon’s core update structure. The contribution is incremental but practically aligned with current large-scale training needs: better token efficiency, fewer sharp-minimum failures, and stable behavior under large-batch regimes.
summary_en.technical_approach: MONA adds an acceleration term computed from an exponential moving average of gradient differences. Since g_k - g_{k-1} approximates H_k times the parameter displacement, it provides a cheap proxy for local curvature. The key design choice is to inject this term before Muon’s momentum accumulation and Newton-Schulz orthogonalization. Injecting it after orthogonalization would break the orthogonal update structure; treating it as a generic external adaptor would leave its interaction with Muon’s nonlinear polar-decomposition approximation unclear. Matrix parameters follow the Muon-style pipeline with momentum, Newton-Schulz orthogonalization, spectral-norm-like control, and RMS scaling. Vector parameters such as embeddings and biases fall back to AdamW. The theory analyzes convergence under standard non-convex smoothness and bounded stochastic-gradient variance assumptions, and interprets the acceleration term as a mechanism for moving away from sharp regions.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study covers three MoE settings: MOE-1B-A0d2B, MOE-6B-A0d5B, and MOE-68B-A3B. The largest model is trained on 1T tokens. The paper reports better pretraining convergence than Muon and AdamW, followed by supervised fine-tuning of the MOE-68B-A3B model and evaluation on general capability, math reasoning, and code generation. The provided text does not include the full benchmark tables or exact deltas, so the most important checks are the loss curves, token-efficiency comparisons, scaling consistency across model sizes, and whether post-SFT gains track the pretraining loss improvement.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, roughly 20-30 minutes. Focus on Algorithm 1 to verify where the acceleration term enters the Muon pipeline. Then inspect the convergence assumptions and the MoE training curves. The main technical questions are hyperparameter sensitivity for the acceleration coefficient and memory decay, and whether optimizer comparisons use matched learning-rate schedules, batch sizes, warmup, cooldown, and regularization.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在跟 Muon，这篇该读；不是因为理论多新，而是它终于给了较大规模 MoE 证据。先盯 optimizer fairness 和 loss 曲线，别急着信“逃离 sharp minima”的解释。
recommendation.en: If you are tracking Muon, read this; not because the theory is especially new, but because it finally brings larger-scale MoE evidence. Focus on optimizer fairness and loss curves before buying the sharp-minima story.

paper.title: Mapping the Schedule x Bit-Width Boundary in Sub-100M Quantisation-Aware Training
paper.abstract: We test whether the optimal learning-rate schedule depends on bit-width during from-initialisation quantisation-aware training (QAT) for sub-100M decoder language models. A 720-run factorial grid (Phase 2) over bit-width x warmdown fraction x LR magnitude x model size x seed (FP16/INT8/INT6, 15M-100M, 5 seeds) finds the optimal warmdown is 33% at every (bit-width, size) cell. The primary hypothesis -- that INT6 QAT requires a different schedule than higher-precision training -- is falsified at F

summary.core_problem: 这项工作检验一个很具体的 QAT 训练配方问题：在 sub-100M decoder LM 从零开始量化感知训练时，学习率 warmdown 长度是否需要随 bit-width 改变。作者重点验证一个常见经验判断：低比特，尤其 INT6/INT4，可能需要更长的后期降学习率阶段来稳定训练。
summary.importance: 对大规模预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对小模型、边缘部署和低比特从零训练有实用参考。主要价值在于它把一个常被经验化处理的超参交互做成了较系统的网格实验。结论也比较干净：FP16、INT8、INT6 在 15M–100M 范围内不需要单独调 warmdown；INT4 只有在 50M 以上才表现出明确的 wd33 偏好，50M 以下 schedule 差异基本被 seed 噪声淹没。
summary.technical_approach: 方法不是提出新量化算法，而是做受控 factorial study。Phase 2 覆盖 FP16/INT8/INT6、4 种 warmdown fraction、3 个学习率幅度、4 个模型尺寸、5 个 seed，共 720 个训练单元，每个训练 9000 iterations。Phase 5 继续做鲁棒性检查：把优化器从 Muon 换成 AdamW；把线性 warmdown 换成 cosine；把训练长度扩展到 27k 和 81k；把尺寸外推到 5M、8M、175M、250M、350M；加入 INT4 从 3M 到 100M 的 sweep；最后用权重到 INT6 quantization grid 的距离做机制探针。它和常见小规模调参的区别在于，作者没有只报告最优配置，而是直接检验 bit-width × schedule 的交互项是否存在。
summary.experiments: 核心结果是：在 FP16、INT8、INT6，15M–100M 的所有 size 和 bit-width cell 中，最优 warmdown fraction 都是 33%。这个结论在 Muon/AdamW、linear/cosine schedule、9k–81k iterations 下都保持。INT6 的质量损失随模型尺寸呈 log-linear 关系，Phase 2 拟合出的曲线能预测 5M 到 350M held-out sizes，落在 95% CI 内。INT4 呈现两个区间：50M 及以上 wd33 明确最优，paired z 约 12–15，10/10 seeds 一致；3M–30M 范围内各 size 没有显著 schedule preference。INT4 penalty 明显大于 INT6，大约 15–40 mBPB，而 INT6 约 3 mBPB。训练长度方面，30M wd33 下 INT6 penalty 从 9k iterations 的 +3.0 mBPB 增长到 81k iterations 的 +6.5 mBPB，说明 schedule 交互不存在不等于量化代价不随训练进程变化。机制探针否定了一个简单解释：INT6 QAT 权重并没有在 warmdown 前更快贴近量化网格；FP16、INT8、INT6 的 weight-to-grid distance 差异在 4% 以内。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看实验设置和结果部分：Phase 2 的 factorial design 决定了结论可信度；Figure 2 看 INT6 penalty 的尺寸外推；Figure 3 看 INT4 在 30M–50M 附近的 regime transition；Figure 5 看训练长度如何放大量化 penalty；Figure 6 看为什么 grid-snapping 解释不成立。对预训练研究员来说，最值得带走的是实验设计方式，而不是具体的 sub-100M 最优超参。

summary_en.core_problem: The work asks a narrow but useful QAT recipe question: during from-scratch quantisation-aware training of sub-100M decoder LMs, should the learning-rate warmdown length be tuned separately for each bit-width? It directly tests the common intuition that aggressive quantisation, especially INT6 or INT4, needs a longer late-stage decay to remain stable.
summary_en.importance: The result is more relevant to small-model training and edge deployment than to frontier-scale pretraining. Its value lies in turning a practitioner heuristic into a controlled hyperparameter interaction study. The main practical conclusion is simple: for FP16, INT8, and INT6 in the 15M–100M range, the FP16 schedule transfers. For INT4, wd33 becomes clearly preferred only at 50M and above; below that, schedule differences are largely within seed noise.
summary_en.technical_approach: The contribution is an experimental mapping rather than a new quantisation method. Phase 2 runs a 720-cell factorial grid over FP16/INT8/INT6, four warmdown fractions, three LR magnitudes, four model sizes, and five seeds, with 9000 iterations per cell. Phase 5 probes the null result along several axes: Muon versus AdamW, linear versus cosine warmdown, longer training at 27k and 81k iterations, held-out model sizes from 5M to 350M, an INT4 sweep from 3M to 100M, and a mechanism probe based on distance from weights to the INT6 quantisation grid. The design is aimed at measuring the bit-width × schedule interaction directly, rather than only selecting a best recipe.
summary_en.experiments: For FP16, INT8, and INT6, the best warmdown fraction is 33% in every tested size and bit-width cell from 15M to 100M. This remains true across optimiser choice, schedule shape, and 9k–81k training lengths. The INT6 quality penalty scales roughly log-linearly with model size, and a fit from Phase 2 predicts held-out sizes from 5M to 350M within the reported 95% confidence interval. INT4 has two regimes: at 50M and above, wd33 is decisively best, with paired z around 12–15 and agreement across 10/10 seeds; from 3M to 30M, no individual size shows a statistically significant schedule preference. The INT4 penalty is much larger than the INT6 penalty, roughly 15–40 mBPB versus about 3 mBPB. At fixed 30M wd33, the INT6 penalty grows from +3.0 mBPB at 9k iterations to +6.5 mBPB at 81k iterations. The mechanism probe rules out a simple grid-snapping story: before warmdown, weight-to-INT6-grid distances are nearly the same for FP16, INT8, and INT6-trained models, within about 4%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the experimental design and the main result figures. Figure 2 is the key evidence for the INT6 penalty scaling curve and held-out size prediction. Figure 3 shows the INT4 transition around the 30M–50M range. Figure 5 is useful for separating schedule robustness from the growth of absolute quantisation cost with training length. Figure 6 is the main negative mechanism result. The most transferable lesson is the controlled way the study tests a training-recipe interaction, not the exact sub-100M hyperparameter choice.

recommendation.zh: 实验很干净，结论也够具体：若你在做低精度预训练，先把“INT6 需要特殊 schedule”这个 prior 放下，再看 INT4 边界在哪儿崩。
recommendation.en: The setup is clean and the conclusion is specific: if you work on low-precision pretraining, drop the prior that INT6 needs a special schedule, then focus on where the INT4 boundary actually breaks.

paper.title: EMA-Nesterov: Stabilizing Nesterov's Lookahead for Accelerated Deep Learning Optimization
paper.abstract: Lookahead-based acceleration methods, such as Nesterov's momentum, are widely used in optimization, but they often become unreliable in deep learning training mainly due to stochastic gradient noise and non-convex loss landscapes. In particular, standard lookahead relies on short-horizon update signals (e.g., differences between consecutive iterates), which are inherently noisy and can lead to unstable extrapolation directions. This work revisits Nesterov's acceleration from a trajectory perspec

summary.core_problem: 解决 Nesterov lookahead 在深度学习随机、非凸训练中容易被短期梯度噪声带偏，导致加速方向不稳定的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是优化器改进与训练稳定性分析。它对 LLM 预训练的直接价值取决于是否能在 AdamW/large-batch/混合精度/长程训练中成立；仅从摘要看，还不是大模型训练 recipe 级结果。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从参数轨迹角度重新解释 Nesterov 加速，认为有效加速不应依赖相邻两步参数差这种高噪声信号，而应利用优化轨迹中的低频趋势。方法上用参数更新的指数滑动平均替代标准 Nesterov 的 lookahead 方向，形成更平滑的外推方向。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 或提升幅度。关键信息需要看正文是否包含 Transformer/LLM、AdamW 兼容性、训练 loss spike、泛化误差和 wall-clock 收敛对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the instability of Nesterov-style lookahead updates in stochastic, non-convex deep learning optimization, where one-step extrapolation directions can be dominated by noise.
summary_en.importance: This is an optimizer and training-stability contribution. Its relevance to LLM pretraining depends on whether the effect survives AdamW, large batches, mixed precision, and long training runs; the abstract alone does not establish it as an LLM-scale recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper reinterprets Nesterov acceleration from a trajectory perspective. Instead of extrapolating from consecutive iterates, EMA-Nesterov uses an exponential moving average of parameter updates to capture lower-frequency movement in the optimization path and produce a more stable lookahead direction.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The key checks are whether the full paper includes Transformer or LLM experiments, compatibility with AdamW, loss-spike behavior, generalization, and wall-clock convergence.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 optimizer ablation 备选；先看大模型实验是否存在，没有 Transformer 结果就别改训练栈。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an optimizer-ablation candidate; check for real Transformer-scale evidence before touching a pretraining stack.

paper.title: Max-Window Scale Estimation for Near-Lossless HiF8 W8A8 Quantization-Aware Training
paper.abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) with low-bit floating-point formats enables efficient LLM deployment, yet introduces subtle failure modes invisible to standard training metrics. We present a systematic study of HiF8 W8A8 QAT for OpenPangu-Embedded-1B through the lens of Delayed Tensor Scaling (DTS). Across eight controlled experiments, we identify and disentangle two orthogonal failure modes: (i)amax saturation, where delayed scale estimates silently corrupt knowledge-sensitive representations

summary.core_problem: HiF8 W8A8量化感知训练（QAT）存在两种训练损失无法检测的失效模式：延迟张量缩放（DTS）的amax饱和导致前向传播裁剪损坏知识相关表示，以及过高的学习率导致预训练常识知识被灾难性遗忘，二者独立发生但共同导致下游性能下降。
summary.importance: 明确了FP8 QAT中缩放策略和学习率的交互作用是核心设计轴，给出的近无损QAT方案可直接用于边缘端LLM部署的量化训练，对预训练后低比特适配的工程实践有明确参考价值。
